We investigate this accuracy--stability relationship in large language model (LLM) evaluation for deterministic text-conditioned generation, using programming tasks as a concrete testbed. Standard code-generation benchmarks emphasize single-run accuracy or eventual success under repeated sampling, but many deployment settings also require stability: consistent outcomes across repeated invocations under the same task description. We present a repeated-run evaluation protocol with metrics for run-level accuracy, retry-free coverage, and per-problem variability. On a recency-based benchmark of 100 LeetCode-style problems, we evaluate 16 models from five provider families under two prompt templates with five repeated runs per problem, yielding 16,000 evaluation instances. Although run-level pass rate and perfect stability rate are strongly correlated (r=0.985), pass rate consistently exceeds retry-free coverage -- a gap that reaches 17.8 percentage points and reverses model rankings even among closely matched systems. Prompt effects are model-dependent rather than uniformly beneficial. These results suggest that repeated-run stability analysis is a necessary complement to conventional accuracy reporting for deterministic text-conditioned generation tasks.

title: Graph Attention-Based Virtual Metrology for Film Deposition Processes in Semiconductor Manufacturing
comments: 10 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. This paper has been accepted for publication in the proceedings of ASME IDETC-CIE 2026
summary: Artificial intelligence-driven semiconductor manufacturing increasingly operates at nanometer and angstrom scales, where precise process control depends on accurate and timely metrology. However, physical metrology is limited by measurement latency, cost, and sampling constraints, restricting its scalability in high-volume production. Virtual metrology (VM) has emerged as an effective alternative by predicting wafer-level characteristics from equipment sensor data. Despite recent advances, many existing VM models remain correlation-driven and lack the ability to capture structured dependencies among heterogeneous process variables, while providing limited interpretability. This study presents a graph attention-based VM framework for film deposition processes that integrates temporal feature learning with structured parameter-layer dependency modeling. The proposed approach represents each step-parameter pair as a node and extracts temporal embeddings from high-frequency equipment traces using convolutional feature encoders. A parameter-to-layer graph attention mechanism is employed to model directional dependencies, enabling each film layer to aggregate relevant process information. The framework is evaluated using industrial deposition data collected from production wafers, where the model predicts film thickness from multivariate sensor signals. Experimental results demonstrate improved predictive performance compared to baseline models. In addition, analysis of the learned attention weights reveals interpretable parameter-layer relationships consistent with physical process behavior, capturing dominant process factors and temporal dependencies across deposition stages. These results indicate that the proposed framework enhances prediction accuracy and provides meaningful insight into process dynamics, supporting effective monitoring and optimization in semiconductor manufacturing.
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. This paper has been accepted for publication in the proceedings of ASME IDETC-CIE 2026

title: Benchmarking Security Risk Detection and Verification in Open Agentic Skill Ecosystems
summary: Open agent platforms allow community contributors to publish reusable skills that agents can invoke at runtime. This extensibility also creates a supply-chain risk: malicious contributors can hide harmful behavior inside skills that appear benign under superficial inspection. However, existing defenses are hard to evaluate because there is no benchmark that measures both malicious-skill detection and runtime verification. We present SkillVetBench, a two-stage security vetting benchmark for open agentic skill ecosystems. The first stage performs semantic vetting over each skill's natural-language specification to detect hidden malicious intent. The second stage executes flagged skills in an instrumented sandbox to observe runtime behavior and collect auditable evidence. We build a benchmark from confirmed malicious skills in the live OpenClaw ecosystem, including samples from the recent ClawHavoc supplychain campaign. Unlike static-only methods, SkillVetBench verifies detected threats with execution traces. Our experiments show that: (1) semantic-only and signature-based baselines are insufficient, missing up to 89\% of malicious skills whose threats arise from natural-language instructions, multicomponent logic, or cross-component interactions; (2) runtime attacks are concentrated in a small set of high-permission primitives, especially exec, write\_file, install\_skill, and spawn; and (3) SkillVetBench provides case studies in which sandbox execution directly supports malicious verdicts with concrete runtime evidence.

title: Task Structure Reverses Layerwise State Encoding in Sequence Models
summary:
Mechanistic studies of sequence models often treat layerwise state encodings as architectural traits: recurrent models concentrate readable state, attention-based models distribute it. We find that the same architecture reverses this profile when the task changes. Across Transformers, Mamba, Mamba-2, LSTMs, and GRUs, Parity is concentrated late in Mamba and the recurrent baselines and built gradually by Transformer; on bounded-depth Dyck-k the pattern flips. The same flip appears in fine-tuned Mamba-130M and Pythia-160M, and the Pythia Dyck bottleneck persists at 410M. Two explanations are conflated in the literature: algebraic structure (commutativity) versus computational structure (prefix update vs. stack). To separate them we add a third task: non-commutative S_3 permutation composition. S_3 groups with Parity, not Dyck, on layerwise probing across all five architectures and on Mamba-specific Conv1D attribution, so the grouping tracks computational structure rather than commutativity.
  Causal interventions show that, in the 4-layer formal models, linearly readable directions are often functionally necessary and can remain important at out-of-distribution lengths on Parity and Dyck. At pretrained scale the picture splits. Fine-tuned Pythia Dyck has a strong middle-layer bottleneck (L6-L7 ablation drops accuracy by roughly 81% at 160M; broader L4-L18 plateau at 410M), far weaker at the best-probe layer. Pretrained Mamba shows the complementary failure mode: its final layer is highly readable, no single probe direction breaks the task on Parity, Dyck, or S_3, yet mid-position activation patching there recovers about 97-98% of the clean-corrupted logit gap. Probing localizes where state is linearly available, not always where the computation is bottlenecked. Mechanistic signatures are properties of architecture and task together.

title: Bridging Topology and Deep Representation Learning: A TDA-ViT Fusion Model for Four-Class Brain Tumor Classification
summary:
Accurate brain tumor classification from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a key requirement for early diagnosis and clinical decision-making. Vision Transformers (ViTs) have shown strong performance in medical image analysis by learning global contextual representations, but they often fail to capture intrinsic structural and topological patterns present in tumor regions. To address this limitation, we propose a fusion framework that combines Topological Data Analysis (TDA) features with pretrained Vision Transformer representations for four-class brain tumor classification.
  In the proposed method, TDA is used to extract complementary topological descriptors that capture geometric structure, connectivity, and shape information from MRI images. In parallel, a pretrained ViT model learns high-level semantic representations from the same images. These two feature spaces are then fused to form a unified and more discriminative representation for classification.
  The model is evaluated on the BRISC2025 dataset, which contains four brain tumor classes: glioma, meningioma, pituitary tumor, and non-tumor cases. Experimental results show that combining topological and transformer-based features significantly improves performance compared to using either approach alone. The proposed TDA-ViT fusion model achieves an accuracy of 99.10%, precision of 99.27%, recall of 99.15%, F1-score of 99.21%, and an AUC of 99.98%. It also outperforms several state-of-the-art models, including ResNet50, ResNet101, EfficientNetB2, and standalone Vision Transformers. These results demonstrate that topological features provide valuable complementary information that enhances deep representation learning, leading to a robust and highly accurate framework for automated brain tumor classification.

title: Single-Channel Tissue Segmentation via Cross-Modal Distillation from Foundation Models
summary: Multiplexed fluorescence microscopy improves tissue segmentation by providing complementary channels including nuclear (DAPI) and membrane (E-cadherin), that together encode richer spatial context than single-channel imaging alone. However, multiplexed models require all channels at inference, limiting deployment where only a subset is available. This work proposes a cross-modal knowledge distillation framework that transfers semantic information from a frozen foundation model teacher processing multiplexed input to a lightweight student operating on the nuclear channel only. The distillation objective combines MSE-based probability matching, boundary-aware supervision, and learnable uncertainty weighting. SAM ViT-H and CellSAM are evaluated as teachers across four U-Net students: Swin-Tiny (27M), ResNet18 (11M), EfficientNet-B0 (5.3M), and MobileNetV3 (1.5M), on TissueNet and BBBC038. On TissueNet, the SAM-distilled Swin-Tiny student achieves Dice 78.36 (plus or minus 1.44), a 13.05-point improvement over the no-KD baseline (65.31 plus or minus 1.35) and 87.9% recovery of teacher oracle performance (89.12 plus or minus 1.21) at a 23x parameter reduction. KD consistently improves all four students by approximately 12 Dice points, confirming architecture-agnostic distillation. SAM ViT-H outperforms CellSAM as teacher across all settings. Cross-dataset evaluation on BBBC038 shows consistent gains without teacher retraining.

title: Detection vs. Execution: Single-Bucket Probes Miss Half the Mamba-2 State Sink
summary:
Mechanistic interpretability often assumes that probes identifying a representational signature also identify the circuit executing the corresponding computation. We show that this assumption can fail systematically in Mamba-2. Studying the state sink (disproportionate Delta-gate activation on boundary tokens, analogous to the attention sink), we find that single-bucket probes recover only a small execution layer while missing a much larger detection layer with the same representational signature.
  In Mamba-2, the state sink decomposes into two functional head sets. Single-bucket BOS-specialist heads (about 5% of heads at 2.7B) causally support both BOS-context and newline-target predictions across model scales and corpora. Dual heads (27-35% of heads, recovered by multi-class aggregation of the same probe) show stronger BOS-newline representational similarity but substantially weaker causal effects under ablation. Representational similarity does not imply functional equivalence.
  This distinction matters for downstream behaviour: ablating BOS-specialist heads collapses RULER NIAH retrieval accuracy from 1.00 to 0.00 at 1024 context length in both Mamba-1 2.8B and Mamba-2 2.7B, while size-matched complements preserve baseline performance. A random channel-bucketing control rules out substrate granularity alone, implicating Mamba-2's head-shared Delta projection. Probe-derived specialty can identify execution circuits; at coarse granularity the same probe also recovers detection circuits, and separating them requires class-conditional ablation rather than class-conditional cosine.

title: CV-Arena: An Open Benchmark for Instructional Computer Vision Problem Solving with Human-AI Collaborative Preferences
summary: Instruction-guided image editing is becoming a general interface for visual work, yet existing benchmarks still focus largely on narrow appearance edits and do not fully capture the diversity of real-image tasks in professional workflows. Here, we define instructional computer vision problem solving as a broader formulation of image editing: given a real input image and a natural-language instruction, a system must produce an edited output that realizes the requested transformation while satisfying explicit preservation, geometric, physical, and usability constraints. We introduce CV-Arena, an open benchmark designed to evaluate this capability at professional scales. CV-Arena contains 12K high-resolution real-image instruction pairs spanning 16 instruction-based visual task types, constructed using CogRetriever, a dual-track retrieval-and-curation pipeline that combines targeted web search, agentic query refinement, verification, and traceability. To evaluate models at scale while preserving human fidelity, we propose Active Elo, a human-AI collaborative preference protocol that leverages CV-Judge, a logic-gated, multi-dimensional VLM evaluator, to reject clear failures and resolve high-confidence comparisons; and to route close, high-quality comparisons to expert raters. Mixed human and AI supervision is then aggregated through reliability-weighted Elo updates. Our comprehensive evaluation of 21 systems, including proprietary, open-source, and agentic models, on CV-Arena reveals persistent gaps in instruction adherence, physical reasoning, structural control, and fine-grained detail preservation. We further develop CV-Agent, a lightweight agentic model that combines planning, editing, and verification, and demonstrate that closed-loop reasoning is a promising direction for professional-grade instruction-following visual editing.

title: Generative Multi-Robot Motion Planning via Diffusion Modeling with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Guidance
comments: 11 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. This paper has been accepted for publication in the proceedings of ASME IDETC-CIE 2026
summary: Coordinating multiple robots in shared environments requires generating feasible trajectories for each agent while accounting for interactions among agents. Centralized planning approaches become difficult to scale as the number of robots increases, while decentralized approaches that allow each agent to plan independently do not inherently account for inter-agent interactions. This paper presents a framework for coordinated multi-robot motion planning that combines decentralized generative trajectory planning with multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL)-based coordination. Each robot independently generates candidate trajectories using a diffusion model trained on single-agent motion data, leveraging the generative model's ability to produce feasible and diverse trajectories. To reduce conflicts between agents, a centralized value function trained via MARL guides the reverse diffusion process through gradient-based steering, enabling interaction-aware trajectory generation without centralized joint planning or retraining of the generative model. This guidance follows an exponential tilting formulation, in which the value function biases the denoising distribution toward trajectories with higher expected multi-agent return. The framework is evaluated in a simulated maze environment with four mobile robots. Experimental results show that the proposed value-guided diffusion planning reduces the inter-agent interference rate from 55.4% to 41.8%, demonstrating that coordination can be effectively achieved while preserving the scalability of decentralized trajectory generation. These results suggest that MARL-based value guidance can effectively introduce coordination into decentralized generative planners without requiring a fully joint multi-robot model.
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. This paper has been accepted for publication in the proceedings of ASME IDETC-CIE 2026

title: Relational Intervention During Functional Collapse in Large Language Models: A Lexical-Statistical Ablation and a Structure x Register Factorial
summary: We test whether a relational-style intervention delivered during functional collapse in a small language model produces post-collapse behavior distinguishable from technical feedback, from a lexically-matched scrambled control, and from each of the two pragmatic dimensions in isolation. Using Qwen3.5-4B with a deliberately broken bash tool, we run 300 episodes across six conditions in a matched-pairs design (50 tasks): no intervention (A), technical/impersonal (B), relational/first-person (C), scrambled relational (D), technical/first-person (E), and relational/impersonal (F). E and F form a 2x2 factorial with B and C that dissociates relational structure (acknowledgment, absolution, agency restoration, unconditional acceptance) from sender register (first-person vs. impersonal). We report two main findings. First, an attention-behavior dissociation: attention follows lexical surprise (D > F > C > E > B, all q_FDR < 10^{-10}), with the scrambled message capturing the most attention; yet behaviorally A ~ B ~ D < E ~ F << C. Second, the factorial localizes the C effect: neither relational structure alone (F) nor first-person register alone (E) replicates C's behavioral signature; main effects of both dimensions are individually significant, and the structure x register interaction is significant on persistence (p = 0.046). A third dissociation emerges in emotion probes: F tracks C on 7 of 8 probes despite producing only baseline behavior, indicating that relational structure alone installs a probe-level state that only translates into behavior when paired with first-person register. The model's processing decomposes into three dissociable stages: attention (ordered by lexical surprise), probe-level state (ordered by structure), and behavior (ordered by the conjunction of both).

title: One Channel to Rule Them All: Rethinking Input Representation for Visual Place Recognition
summary: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) is fundamental to long-term robot localization and SLAM, yet current systems overwhelmingly rely on RGB input, implicitly assuming color is necessary for global place recognition. We challenge this assumption, investigating the role of chromatic information across training regimes, model architectures and standard benchmarks under real-world appearance variation. We find that grayscale matches RGB performance generally and outperforms it under severe appearance shifts where color invariance is insufficiently learned, while color provides meaningful gains only where persistent and discriminative chromatic cues are present. Across selected benchmarks, a fully gray-trained MixVPR model achieves an average 82.4% Recall@1 compared to 81.2% for its RGB counterpart. In some cases, lightweight grayscale variants with 60% fewer parameters can outperform heavier RGB models. Grayscale further offers practical advantages in storage, bandwidth and alignment with resource-constrained systems. We conclude that for global VPR where scenes vary across illumination, weather, season and setting, color contributes minimally, and grayscale alone is sufficient for reliable place recognition.

title: Cellular Sheaf Neural Operators for Structure-Preserving Surrogate Modeling of Constrained PDEs
summary: Neural operators provide fast surrogate models for PDE simulations, but standard architectures often treat geometry and discretization as secondary to field data. Physical states are usually represented as grid-channel stacks, even when different quantities naturally belong on vertices, edges, faces, cells, boundaries, or interfaces and must satisfy compatibility constraints. We propose Cellular Sheaf Neural Operators, a discretization-aware framework for structure-preserving neural PDE surrogates. The method represents PDE states on oriented cell complexes, couples local feature spaces through learned restriction maps, and uses incidence/Hodge-informed message passing to follow computational geometry. Learned update heads pass through coboundary or flux maps, allowing selected constraints to arise from cell-complex structure rather than only from loss penalties. For magnetohydrodynamics, this yields face-based magnetic-flux updates driven by edge electromotive fields and finite-volume-style fluid updates driven by learned face fluxes and cell sources. On turbulent MHD and fusion-equilibrium surrogate tasks, the method improves structure-sensitive diagnostics, including rollout behavior, divergence control, spectral error, and equilibrium-regression accuracy. These results indicate that cellular-sheaf structure is a useful inductive bias for neural PDE surrogates in constrained multiphysics systems.

title: Machine Learning Surrogate Modeling for Homogenization of Hyperelastic Materials with Boolean Microstructures
summary: Data-driven surrogate models are an alternative to numerical homogenization of heterogeneous materials. In this contribution, a supervised learning approach is presented for predicting effective Lamé parameters of hyperelastic composites from low-dimensional microstructural descriptors. The data set is based on previously published numerical homogenization results for ensembles of two-phase stochastic microstructures generated by planar Boolean models, covering variations of inclusion shape, phase contrast, and area fraction; see Brändel, Brands, Maike, Rheinbach, Schröder, Schwarz and Stoyan (2022). A neural network is trained on combinations of scalar and curve-valued statistical descriptors, including the area fraction, a derived scalar shape descriptor $τ$, the two-point correlation function $S_2(r)$, and the lineal-path function $\ell(z)$. Additional data representing limiting cases of the parameter space are incorporated to stabilize training and improve extrapolation behavior. The surrogate is evaluated by leave-one-grain-type-out cross-validation in order to assess generalization to unseen grain geometries. Numerical results demonstrate that additional descriptors can reduce relative errors. A predictor trained with $τ$ and $S_2(r)$ provides a compact representation with good quantitative accuracy and regular dense response behavior. Adding the lineal-path function $\ell(z)$ further reduces the error at the available data points, indicating that it is a promising additional descriptor; however, dense post-training response evaluations show that improved pointwise accuracy does not automatically guarantee physically admissible behavior between sampled parameter values. This motivates future work on physically constrained surrogate models, loss formulations, bounded output parametrizations, and a more systematic representation of curve-valued geometric descriptors.

title: FinCom: A Financial Multi-Agent Demo with Disagree-or-Commit Deliberation
summary:
Multi-agent systems powered by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for financial analysis and decision support. However, existing coordination schemes, especially those emphasizing consensus or debate, are vulnerable to sycophancy: agents conform to peer reasoning instead of evidence, leading to premature agreement and degraded outcomes. We introduce FinCom (Financial Committee), a governed multi-agent framework and interactive system that operationalizes the Disagree-or-Commit (DoC) protocol to embed structured dissent into financial AI committees. A central Supervisor orchestrates three ReAct-enabled specialist agents: Research, Quantitative, and Risk. Each agent is equipped with role-specific tools for retrieval, computation, and stress testing. During deliberation, agents must either explicitly critique or commit to their peers' reasoning before converging on a unified recommendation.
  This demonstration showcases how FinCom supports committee-style financial analysis through coordinated multi-agent interaction, including structured report generation and interactive decision support. Evaluated across the most recent financial agent benchmark, in addition to 90 internal handcrafted financial tasks using an LLM-as-a-Judge protocol, DoC improves reasoning accuracy and risk awareness significantly over a consensus-seeking baseline on both an in-house and external evaluation set. By reframing disagreement as a governance primitive rather than noise, FinCom offers a lightweight, prompt-only recipe for improving accountability, transparency, and epistemic robustness in agentic financial systems.

title: Power Grid Infrastructure for AI Data Centers
summary: This article addresses recent advances in artificial intelligence, which have set off an astounding race among technology frontiers to build large data centers. It provides insights into impacts of large data centers on the planning and operation of the power grid.

title: Characterizing Metastable Faults and Failures
summary: Metastable failures are hard to detect, prevent, and mitigate. During a metastable failure, a system exhibits self-sustaining bad behavior even in the absence of adversarial conditions. Prior work focuses on symptoms and has portrayed metastable failures as instances of self-sustaining overload. This characterization leaves the underlying failure causes and dynamics unknown, and does not account for metastable failures that do not manifest as overload. We present the first causal characterization of metastable failures by identifying their origin in metastable faults, i.e., structural destabilizing cycles of interaction among systems components that, in isolation, are stabilizing. Metastable failures arise when scheduling decisions let these destabilizing interactions gain the upper hand over the individual components' stabilizing tendencies. We then derive a methodology to predict metastable failures, and to build metastable-fault-tolerant (MFT) systems. We apply our methodology to three case studies, showcasing the generality of our results.

title: PRISM: Gauge-Invariant Tangent-Space Differentially Private LoRA
comments: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026) as an oral presentation
summary: Applying differential privacy (DP) via DP-SGD to Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a natural approach for privacy-preserving fine-tuning. However, LoRA's low-rank parameterization poses a fundamental challenge. In LoRA, each trainable update is represented as a low-rank matrix $Z = AB^\top$, but this factorization is inherently non-identifiable: many factor pairs $(A,B)$ represent the same update $Z$. As a result, applying DP-SGD directly to the factors induces gauge-dependent perturbations on $Z$, and we show that this naive DP-LoRA can lead to unbounded noise amplification. We propose PRISM, an intrinsic DP mechanism for LoRA that is gauge invariant by construction, avoids bilinear noise amplification, and admits an efficient low-dimensional noise sampler. Moreover, PRISM yields a closed-form characterization of the effective intrinsic noise induced on $Z$, enabling stable privacy-utility trade-offs through bounded, gauge-invariant perturbations. We establish standard $(ε,δ)$-DP guarantees for PRISM and introduce a DP-aware, gauge-invariant adaptive update rule that prevents adaptive optimization from amplifying injected privacy noise, improving numerical stability in practice.
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026) as an oral presentation

title: Lodestar: An Online-Learning LLM Inference Router
summary: Efficiently serving large language model (LLM) inference tasks is crucial both for user-perceived latency such as time-to-first-token (TTFT) and for GPU utilization. However, LLM request routing, that is, assigning each inference request to a GPU instance, is particularly challenging: execution is highly input-dependent; batching and KV-cache reuse create strong cross-request coupling; and latency responds nonlinearly to context length, model/engine settings, and heterogeneous accelerators. As a result, simple traditional load balancing algorithms, and even heuristics tailored for LLM inference, fail to achieve good performance. We present Lodestar, a novel learning-based request routing system for distributed GPU clusters. Lodestar continuously collects a snapshot of the cluster at per-request level, including real-time instance state, request characteristics, and observed performance, and trains an online reward predictor that it uses to route inference requests to the instance that will maximize given reward (e.g., minimizing TTFT). Lodestar is cloud-native and works seamlessly with existing serving stacks (vLLM). With continuous online adaptation to changing workloads and infrastructure conditions, Lodestar achieves 1.41x lower average TTFT and 1.47x lower P99 TTFT on average (up to 2.15x/1.86x on homogeneous and 4.38x/4.42x on heterogeneous clusters) compared to a state-of-the-art prefix cache and load-aware heuristic, and learns these efficient routing strategies within about 5 minutes, based on experiments in a public cloud GPU cluster.

title: Silent Failures in Federated Personalization of Foundation Models
summary: Foundation models are increasingly personalized on decentralized private data through federated learning and are now deployed at scale under growing regulatory requirements for post-market monitoring. We argue that this convergence creates a distinct and under-recognized class of trustworthiness failures, which we term "Silent Failures." These include amplified bias, fairness collapse, and alignment erosion that may remain difficult to detect because federated learning's privacy constraints limit visibility into model behavior. A landscape analysis of existing benchmarks reveals a structural divide. Federated benchmarks evaluate system performance but provide limited insight into model behavior, whereas centralized trustworthiness benchmarks assess behavior but require model access incompatible with federated privacy. We introduce a taxonomy of six silent failure modes arising from the interaction of foundation model personalization, dataset shift, and core federated constraints. Our analysis shows that privacy-preserving training alone is insufficient for trustworthy deployment. We conclude with a research agenda for privacy-preserving behavioral evaluation and propose that silent failures become a standard diagnostic category for trustworthy federated artificial intelligence.

AI.title_translation: 联邦基础模型个性化中的隐式失效
AI.tldr: 本文指出了联邦大模型个性化中由于隐私限制而难以检测的“隐式失效”问题，提出了六种失效模式的分类法，并强调仅靠隐私保护训练不足以实现安全可信的部署。
AI.motivation: 随着基础模型通过联邦学习在去中心化私有数据上进行个性化定制，并在严格的监管要求下大规模部署，联邦学习的隐私约束限制了对模型行为的可见性，从而导致了一类独特且未被充分认识的可信度失效（即“隐式失效”，如偏见放大、公平性崩溃等）难以被检测。
AI.method: 1. 对现有基准进行全景分析，揭示联邦基准与集中式可信度基准之间的结构性分歧；2. 引入一套包含六种隐式失效模式的分类法（源于模型个性化、数据集漂移和联邦约束的相互作用）；3. 提出隐私保护行为评估的研究议程。
AI.result: 分析表明，现有的联邦基准和集中式可信度基准存在结构性分裂，无法兼顾隐私与行为评估；同时证实了仅靠隐私保护训练不足以确保可信部署，并成功构建了六种隐式失效模式的分类法。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠隐私保护训练不足以保证可信部署。必须将“隐式失效”作为可信联邦人工智能的标准诊断类别，并开展隐私保护行为评估的相关研究。
AI.translation: 基础模型正越来越多地通过联邦学习在去中心化的私有数据上进行个性化定制，并且在对上市后监控日益严格的监管要求下被大规模部署。我们认为，这种融合产生了一类独特且未被充分认识的可信度失效，我们称之为“隐式失效”（Silent Failures）。这些失效包括偏见放大、公平性崩溃和对齐侵蚀，由于联邦学习的隐私约束限制了对模型行为的可见性，这些失效可能仍然难以被检测到。对现有基准的全景分析揭示了一种结构性分歧：联邦基准评估系统性能，但对模型行为提供的洞察有限；而集中式可信度基准评估模型行为，但需要与联邦隐私不兼容的模型访问权限。我们引入了一种包含六种隐式失效模式的分类法，这些模式源自基础模型个性化、数据集漂移和核心联邦约束之间的相互作用。我们的分析表明，仅靠隐私保护训练不足以实现可信部署。最后，我们提出了一个用于隐私保护行为评估的研究议程，并建议将隐式失效作为可信联邦人工智能的标准诊断类别。
AI.summary: 本文指出了在联邦学习下对基础模型进行个性化微调时，由于隐私限制导致模型行为难以被监控，从而引发偏见放大和公平性崩溃等“隐式失效”的问题。通过分析现有评估基准的局限性，本文提出了一套包含六种隐式失效模式的分类法，强调了仅靠隐私保护训练无法实现可信部署，并为未来的隐私保护行为评估奠定了研究议程。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习, 基础模型, 个性化, 隐式失效, 可信人工智能
AI.comments: 本文敏锐地指出了联邦学习中“隐私保护”与“模型可信度监控（如公平性、偏见等）”之间的冲突。随着大模型在端侧个性化部署的普及，如何在不侵犯隐私的前提下检测模型的潜在退化（即“隐式失效”）是一个极具现实意义和前瞻性的安全课题。本文提出的分类法和研究议程为该领域指明了重要方向。

title: Explainable deep reinforcement learning reveals energy-efficient control strategies for turbulent drag reduction
summary: We propose a method combining Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning (MARL) and eXplainable Deep Learning (XDL) to reduce drag in wall-bounded turbulent flows. Taking as a baseline the results of training agents directly targeting wall-shear stress and opposition control, three SHAP-guided approaches are compared. In the first, the reward is computed from SHAP attributions of a U-net predicting the future velocity field; in the second, from SHAP attributions of a U-net predicting the skin-friction coefficient; in the third, from a combination of SHAP attributions of two U-nets predicting the skin-friction coefficient and the wall pressure fluctuations, respectively. The combined SHAP strategy based on skin-friction coefficient and wall-pressure fluctuations achieves the best overall performance, achieving a DR of 34.44% and a NES of 34.01% with only 0.43% normalized input power. Relative to opposition control, drag reduction and net energy saving increase by 49.41% and 48.52%, respectively. Compared with the direct wall-shear-stress baseline, the proposed strategy simultaneously improves performance while reducing the normalized actuation cost from 5.90% to 0.43%. Analysis of the results reveals that the energetically efficient policy is consistent with pressure-gated actuation, activating predominantly at near-zero wall pressure, and operates on a temporal timescale comparable to the lifetime of the near-wall turbulent structures.

AI.title_translation: 可解释深度强化学习揭示了用于湍流减阻的高能效控制策略
AI.tldr: 本文结合多智能体强化学习与可解释深度学习（SHAP归因），提出了一种新型湍流减阻策略，在仅消耗0.43%输入功率的情况下实现了34.44%的减阻率，并揭示了其压力门控驱动的物理机制。
AI.motivation: 在壁面湍流中寻找一种高能效的湍流减阻主动控制策略。
AI.method: 结合多智能体深度强化学习（MARL）与可解释深度学习（XDL），对比了三种基于SHAP引导的奖励计算方法：1) 基于预测未来流速场的U-net的SHAP归因；2) 基于预测摩擦阻力系数的U-net的SHAP归因；3) 结合预测摩擦阻力系数和壁面压力波动的两个U-net的SHAP归因。
AI.result: 结合摩擦阻力系数和壁面压力波动的联合SHAP策略表现最佳，实现了34.44%的减阻率（DR）和34.01%的净节能率（NES），而归一化输入功率仅为0.43%。相比于反对流控制，减阻率和净节能率分别提升了49.41%和48.52%；相比于直接壁面剪切应力基线，该策略在提升性能的同时将驱动成本从5.90%降至0.43%。
AI.conclusion: 高能效的控制策略与压力门控驱动相一致，主要在接近零的壁面压力下激活，且其运行的时间尺度与近壁面湍流结构的寿命相当。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种结合多智能体深度强化学习（MARL）和可解释深度学习（XDL）的方法，用于减少壁面流中的湍流阻力。以直接针对壁面剪切应力和反对流控制训练的智能体结果为基准，对比了三种基于SHAP引导的方法。在第一种方法中，奖励是根据预测未来速度场的 U-net 的 SHAP 归因计算的；在第二种方法中，奖励根据预测摩擦阻力系数的 U-net 的 SHAP 归因计算；在第三种方法中，奖励则来自预测摩擦阻力系数和壁面压力波动的两个 U-net 的 SHAP 归因的组合。基于摩擦阻力系数和壁面压力波动的联合 SHAP 策略取得了最佳的整体性能，仅需 0.43% 的归一化输入功率，就实现了 34.44% 的减阻率（DR）和 34.01% 的净节能率（NES）。相比于反对流控制，减阻率和净节能率分别提高了 49.41% 和 48.52%。与直接壁面剪切应力基准相比，所提出的策略在提高性能的同时，将归一化驱动成本从 5.90% 降低到了 0.43%。对结果的分析表明，这种高能效策略与压力门控驱动一致，主要在接近零壁面压力时激活，并且在与近壁面湍流结构寿命相当的时间尺度上运行。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种结合多智能体强化学习和可解释深度学习的湍流减阻方法。通过使用基于U-net预测的SHAP归因来引导强化学习的奖励函数，该方法在极低的能量输入下实现了显著的减阻和节能效果，并揭示了其背后的物理驱动机制。
AI.keywords: 多智能体强化学习, 可解释深度学习, SHAP归因, 湍流减阻, 能效控制
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于创造性地将可解释性AI（SHAP归因）引入到强化学习的奖励设计中，不仅大幅提升了湍流减阻控制的能效，还通过可解释性分析揭示了“压力门控驱动”这一物理机制，为流体力学主动控制与AI的结合提供了极具启发性的范式。

title: COLLIE: Guiding Skill Discovery in Semantically Coherent Latent Space
summary: Unsupervised skill discovery (USD) aims to learn diverse behaviors without reward functions, but often results in task-irrelevant or hazardous behaviors due to uniform exploration. Guided skill discovery (GSD) addresses this issue by incorporating human intent to focus exploration on meaningful regions. However, existing GSD methods typically require training additional guidance models, and rely on pre-defined rules or expert demonstration, which can be ineffective under sparse, online-collected human feedback. To overcome this, we propose COLLIE, a GSD framework that leverages dense unsupervised data to construct a semantically coherent skill latent space. This latent space is well-structured, enabling reliable guidance with sparse online feedback. Moreover, its semantic coherence property enables training-free construction of guidance signals, eliminating the need for additional model training beyond skill learning. Theoretical analysis justifies the effectiveness of our training-free guidance signal, while experiments across diverse state-based and pixel-based tasks show that COLLIE learns diverse, human-aligned skills, avoids hazardous behaviors, and achieves superior downstream performance with minimal human feedback.

AI.title_translation: COLLIE：在语义一致的潜在空间中引导技能发现
AI.tldr: COLLIE通过构建语义一致的潜在空间，实现了在稀疏在线人类反馈下，无需额外训练即可高效引导技能发现并规避危险行为的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的引导式技能发现方法通常需要训练额外的指导模型，或依赖预定义的规则和专家演示，在稀疏在线反馈环境下效果不佳，且无监督技能发现容易产生与任务无关或危险的行为。
AI.method: 提出COLLIE框架，通过利用密集的无监督数据构建语义一致的技能潜在空间，并利用该空间的属性实现无需额外模型训练的指导信号，从而在稀疏在线反馈下进行引导式技能发现。
AI.result: 实验表明，COLLIE能够学习到多样化且符合人类意图的技能，避免了危险行为，并在极少的人类反馈下实现了优异的下游任务性能。
AI.conclusion: COLLIE框架成功证明了通过构建语义一致的潜在空间，可以在无需额外模型训练的情况下，利用稀疏在线反馈有效地引导技能发现，实现对人类意图的对齐。
AI.translation: 无监督技能发现（USD）旨在无需奖励函数的情况下学习多样化行为，但由于均匀探索，往往会导致与任务无关或危险的行为。引导式技能发现（GSD）通过结合人类意图将探索聚焦于有意义的区域来解决这一问题。然而，现有的GSD方法通常需要训练额外的指导模型，并依赖预定义的规则或专家演示，在稀疏的在线收集人类反馈下可能无效。为了克服这一点，我们提出了COLLIE，一个利用密集无监督数据构建语义一致技能潜在空间的GSD框架。该潜在空间结构良好，能够通过稀疏的在线反馈实现可靠的引导。此外，其语义一致性属性使得指导信号的构建无需训练，消除了技能学习之外额外模型训练的需求。理论分析证明了我们无需训练的指导信号的有效性，跨越多种基于状态和基于像素的任务实验表明，COLLIE学习到了多样化、符合人类意图的技能，避免了危险行为，并以极少的人类反馈实现了优越的下游性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为COLLIE的引导式技能发现框架。该框架通过构建语义一致的潜在空间，使得在无需额外训练指导模型的情况下，能够利用稀疏的在线人类反馈有效地引导智能体探索有意义的技能空间，从而规避危险行为并提升下游任务表现。
AI.keywords: 无监督技能发现, 引导式技能发现, 语义一致性, 人机交互, 强化学习
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于利用无监督数据构建语义一致的潜在空间，从而实现了无需额外训练的指导信号，有效解决了传统引导式技能发现方法依赖额外模型或专家演示的问题。该方法在稀疏在线反馈场景下的鲁棒性是其核心优势。

title: Hardness of Approximate Hylland-Zeckhauser Equilibria
summary: In this paper, we investigate the computational hardness of finding fractional allocations to unit-demand players using competitive equilibria from equal incomes (CEEI), where we allow a small constant error in players' response to market prices (also known as an approximate Hylland-Zeckhauser equilibrium). We show that assuming the $\mathbf{(\varepsilon,δ)}$-Generalized Circuits problem is PPAD-hard (the "PCP for PPAD" conjecture), finding an approximate HZ equilibrium is also PPAD-hard. This result provides additional motivation for trying to prove the PCP for PPAD conjecture as a tool for obtaining robust computational hardness results about markets. Further, we introduce a natural restriction on approximate HZ equilibria, where players' bundles may still only be approximately optimal given the prices, but may not contain positive-price items for which the player has zero utility. We show unconditionally that there exists a constant $ε$ such that finding a restricted $ε$-HZ equilibrium is PPAD-hard.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了近似Hylland-Zeckhauser均衡的计算难度。结果表明，假设“PCP for PPAD”猜想成立，寻找近似HZ均衡是PPAD-hard的；对于一种受限的近似HZ均衡，则无条件地证明了其PPAD-hard性。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在研究利用等收入竞争均衡（CEEI）为单位需求玩家寻找分数分配时的近似Hylland-Zeckhauser均衡的计算难度。研究结果为尝试证明“PCP for PPAD”猜想提供了额外的动力，以获取关于市场稳健计算难度结果的工具。
AI.method: 该研究通过假设 $(\varepsilon, \delta)$-广义电路问题是PPAD-hard（“PCP for PPAD”猜想），来证明寻找近似HZ均衡的PPAD-hard性。此外，对于一种对近似HZ均衡的自然限制，论文无条件地证明了其PPAD-hard性。
AI.result: 1. 假设 $(\varepsilon, \delta)$-广义电路问题是PPAD-hard（“PCP for PPAD”猜想），则寻找近似HZ均衡也是PPAD-hard的。2. 对于一种对近似HZ均衡的自然限制（玩家的捆绑包在给定价格下近似最优，但不能包含玩家效用为零的带正价格的物品），无条件地表明存在一个常数 $\varepsilon$，使得寻找受限的 $\varepsilon$-HZ均衡是PPAD-hard的。
AI.conclusion: 本文的结果为尝试证明“PCP for PPAD”猜想提供了额外的动力，以作为获取关于市场稳健计算难度结果的工具。它确立了近似Hylland-Zeckhauser均衡的计算难度，包括有条件和无条件限制的情况。
AI.translation: 在这篇论文中，我们研究了利用等收入竞争均衡（CEEI）为单位需求玩家寻找分数分配的计算难度，其中我们允许玩家对市场价格的反应存在一个小的常数误差（也称为近似Hylland-Zeckhauser均衡）。我们表明，假设 $(\varepsilon, \delta)$-广义电路问题是PPAD-hard（“PCP for PPAD”猜想），那么寻找近似HZ均衡也是PPAD-hard的。这一结果为尝试证明PCP for PPAD猜想提供了额外的动力，以作为获取关于市场稳健计算难度结果的工具。此外，我们对近似HZ均衡引入了一个自然的限制，即玩家的捆绑包在给定价格下可能仍然只是近似最优的，但可能不包含玩家效用为零的带正价格的物品。我们无条件地表明存在一个常数 $\varepsilon$，使得寻找受限的 $\varepsilon$-HZ均衡是PPAD-hard的。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了在等收入竞争均衡（CEEI）框架下，为单位需求玩家寻找分数分配时，近似Hylland-Zeckhauser（HZ）均衡的计算难度。研究表明，在“PCP for PPAD”猜想成立的前提下，寻找近似HZ均衡是PPAD-hard的。此外，论文还引入了一种对近似HZ均衡的自然限制，并无条件地证明了在存在某个常数误差的情况下，寻找受限的近似HZ均衡也是PPAD-hard的。这些发现突出了计算此类市场均衡的复杂性，并进一步推动了对“PCP for PPAD”猜想的研究。
AI.keywords: Hylland-Zeckhauser均衡, 计算难度, PPAD-hard, 竞争均衡, 市场设计
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于确立了近似Hylland-Zeckhauser均衡的计算难度，特别是对受限版本无条件地证明了其PPAD-hard性。这对于理解市场效率和计算的局限性至关重要，并为“PCP for PPAD”猜想提供了强有力的研究动力。

title: When Parallelism Pays Off: Cohesion-Aware Task Partitioning for Multi-Agent Coding
summary:
Multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) systems offer a way to decompose complex tasks, such as coding, through parallelization and context isolation. However, adding agents in practice introduces inter-agent communication overhead, which incurs extra cost and can sometimes offset the efficiency gains. We formalize multi-agent orchestration as a graph partitioning problem that captures the communication-to-computation trade-off: task decomposition can shorten critical-path computation, but cross-agent dependencies require costly context transfer. We instantiate this view in repository-level software engineering and present Cohesion-aware Coder (Co-Coder), which builds dependency graphs from static analysis, isolates structural hub files, partitions the graph via community detection, and executes the partition with a dependency-aware scheduler.
  Across 28 real-world tasks on DevEval and CodeProjectEval, Co-Coder advances the Pareto-frontier over sequential and file-based parallel baselines as well as Claude Code with Agent Teams, lifting pass rate by up to 14.0%, achieving up to a 2.10x wall-clock speedup, and reducing API cost by up to 35%, with the largest gains on the most dependency-dense projects. Co-coder demonstrates how cohesion-aware orchestration can make parallel coding agents both theoretically grounded and practically efficient, suggesting a broader design principle for multi-agent systems.

AI.title_translation: 当并行性带来回报时：面向多智能体编码的内聚感知任务划分
AI.tldr: 该研究将多智能体代码生成问题形式化为图划分问题，提出了一种名为Co-Coder的系统，通过静态分析构建依赖图，并利用社区检测进行任务划分和调度，以平衡通信开销和计算效率，并在实验中取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 多智能体大语言模型系统虽然可以通过并行化和上下文隔离来分解复杂任务（如编码），但代理间的通信开销会抵消效率提升。
AI.method: 将多智能体编排形式化为图划分问题，通过静态分析构建依赖图，识别关键文件，利用社区检测划分图，并使用依赖感知调度器执行划分。
AI.result: 在28个真实世界任务上，Co-Coder在准确率、速度和API成本方面均优于基线方法和Claude Code with Agent Teams，准确率提升高达14.0%，速度提升高达2.10倍，API成本降低高达35%。
AI.conclusion: 内聚感知编排可以使并行编码智能体在理论上和实践上都具有高效性，为多智能体系统提供了更广泛的设计原则。
AI.translation:
多智能体大型语言模型（LLM）系统通过并行化和上下文隔离，为分解复杂任务（如编码）提供了一种途径。然而，在实践中增加代理会引入代理间通信开销，这会产生额外成本，有时甚至会抵消效率的提高。我们将多智能体编排形式化为一个图划分问题，该问题捕捉了通信与计算的权衡：任务分解可以缩短关键路径计算，但跨代理依赖需要昂贵的上下文传输。我们将这种观点应用于仓库级别的软件工程，并提出了名为Cohesion-aware Coder（Co-Coder）的系统，该系统通过静态分析构建依赖图，隔离结构关键文件，通过社区检测划分图，并使用依赖感知调度器执行划分。
在DevEval和CodeProjectEval上的28个真实世界任务中，Co-Coder在帕累托前沿方面优于顺序和基于文件的并行基线以及具有Agent Teams的Claude Code，准确率提高了14.0%，运行时间速度提高了2.10倍，API成本降低了35%，在依赖性最强的项目中获得了最大的收益。Co-coder证明了内聚感知编排如何使并行编码智能体在理论上和实践上都具有高效性，并提出了多智能体系统的更广泛设计原则。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为Co-Coder的系统，用于优化多智能体大语言模型在编码任务中的并行处理。该系统将任务分解问题建模为图划分问题，考虑了通信开销和计算效率之间的权衡。通过静态分析识别代码依赖关系，并利用社区检测算法进行任务划分和调度，Co-Coder在多个基准测试中显著提高了代码生成的准确率、速度，并降低了API成本。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统,代码生成,任务划分,图划分,并行处理
AI.comments: 该研究有效地将图论中的图划分问题应用于多智能体系统中的任务调度问题，并取得了良好的实验效果。其创新性在于将代码的结构依赖性显式地纳入任务划分的考量中，从而解决了传统并行方法中通信开销过大的问题。然而，该方法在处理高度动态或非常规的软件项目时，其静态分析的有效性可能受到限制。未来的工作可以探索更动态的依赖分析方法，或者将该方法推广到其他需要并行处理的复杂任务领域。

title: COLLAR: Cascaded Object-Level Latent Refinement for High-Fidelity Conditional Generation
summary: Achieving high-fidelity object-level control in Diffusion Transformers remains a significant challenge despite the introduction of structural priors like depth and Canny maps. Current object-level conditional generation methods frequently suffer from visual artifacts and struggle to maintain precise control over objects within small localized regions. To address these limitations, we propose Cascaded Object-Level Latent Refinement (COLLAR), a training-free framework that progressively optimizes object-level features via the Field-of-View (FoV) expansion. First, we propose the Cross-Scale Semantic Alignment (CSSA) module to address spatial-semantic gaps by injecting object-level features into extended-FoV branches via attention mechanisms. To further optimize these features, the Cyclic Feature Injection (CFI) module introduces a reciprocal background feedback mechanism. It leverages a frequency-based adaptive strategy to selectively update the global backbone with context-aligned local information. Finally, the extended-FoV branch serves as a hub for feature optimization, ensuring that object-level features are integrated into the global generation process without compromising final image quality. Extensive experiments on the COCO-MIG and COCO-POS benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across semantic alignment, image quality, and spatial fidelity.

AI.title_translation: COLLAR：级联对象级潜在细化，用于高保真条件生成
AI.tldr: COLLAR是一个无需训练的框架，通过扩展视野（FoV）和跨尺度语义对齐（CSSA）以及循环特征注入（CFI）来改进扩散Transformer中的对象级控制，解决了视觉伪影和精确控制问题，并在COCO-MIG和COCO-POS基准测试中取得了最先进的成果。
AI.motivation: 当前的面向对象的条件生成方法在视觉伪影和对象控制方面存在不足，需要改进。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为COLLAR的无需训练框架，其中包括CSSA模块（通过注意力机制将对象级特征注入扩展FoV分支）和CFI模块（通过基于频率的自适应策略选择性地更新全局骨干网络）。
AI.result: 在COCO-MIG和COCO-POS基准测试中，该方法在语义对齐、图像质量和空间保真度方面始终优于最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: COLLAR通过级联对象级潜在细化，有效地解决了扩散Transformer中对象级控制的挑战，实现了高保真条件生成。
AI.translation: 在扩散Transformer中实现高保真的对象级控制仍然是一个重大的挑战，尽管已经引入了深度和Canny图等结构先验。目前面向对象 的条件生成方法频繁遭受视觉伪影的困扰，并且难以在小的局部区域内保持对对象的精确控制。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了级联对象级潜在细化（COLLAR），一个无需训练的框架，通过视野（FoV）扩展来逐步优化对象级特征。首先，我们提出了跨尺度语义对齐（CSSA）模块，通过注意力机制将对象级特征注入扩展FoV分支来解决空间语义差距。为了进一步优化这些特征，循环特征注入（CFI）模块引入了一个互补的背景反馈机制。它利用基于频率的自适应策略，选择性地用与上下文对齐的局部信息更新全局骨干网络。最后，扩展FoV分支作为特征优化的中心，确保对象级特征能够集成到全局生成过程中，而不会损害最终的图像质量。在COCO-MIG和COCO-POS基准测试上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在语义对齐、图像质量和空间保真度方面始终优于最先进的方法。
AI.summary: COLLAR（级联对象级潜在细化）是一个新提出的、无需训练的框架，旨在提高扩散Transformer中对象级条件生成的高保真度。它通过CSSA模块解决空间语义差距，并通过CFI模块进行特征优化，利用背景反馈和频率自适应策略来整合局部信息，同时保持全局生成质量。实验结果表明，COLLAR在COCO-MIG和COCO-POS基准测试中优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 扩散Transformer, 对象级控制, 条件生成, 级联细化, 跨尺度语义对齐
AI.comments: COLLAR框架通过引入CSSA和CFI模块，有效地解决了扩散Transformer中对象级控制的挑战，在保持高图像质量的同时实现了精确的对象控制。该框架的训练无关特性和在多个基准测试上的优越性能，使其在条件生成领域具有重要的应用价值和研究意义。

title: CryoProt: A Protein Pretraining Framework with Cross-Box Interactions on Cryo-EM Density Maps
summary: Despite the growing availability of cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) density maps, effectively leveraging them for protein representation remains challenging. First, current methods lack a general-purpose protein pretraining framework tailored for cryo-EM density maps, designed for protein-related property prediction. Second, existing approaches typically partition density maps into local box regions and model them independently, overlooking interactions across boxes which are essential for capturing global structural context in cryo-EM density map. To address these challenges, we propose CryoProt, a protein pretraining framework designed for cryo-EM density maps. CryoProt introduces a Map Encoder based on multi-head latent attention (MLA), where box-level representations interact through a shared latent space, enabling explicit modeling of cross-box dependencies within the density map. Furthermore, we adopt a multi-task pretraining strategy to learn generalizable representations that can be effectively transferred to diverse downstream tasks, such as protein flexibility prediction, where cryo-EM density maps are not required and can be inferred implicitly by the pretrained model. Experimental results demonstrate that CryoProt consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods across multiple benchmarks, achieving up to 12% improvement over the best-performing baselines, highlighting the importance of modeling cross-box interactions in cryo-EM data. The source code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CryoProt.

AI.title_translation: 冷冻电镜密度图的跨盒交互蛋白预训练框架
AI.tldr: CryoProt是一个创新的预训练框架，利用冷冻电镜密度图进行蛋白质表征，通过多头潜在注意力机制和跨盒交互来捕捉全局结构信息，并在多种下游任务中取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在利用冷冻电镜密度图进行蛋白质表征方面存在不足，缺乏通用的预训练框架，并且忽视了不同区域（盒）之间的交互作用，这对于理解蛋白质的全局结构至关重要。
AI.method: CryoProt框架采用基于多头潜在注意力（MLA）的密度图编码器，使盒级别的表征能够通过共享的潜在空间进行交互，从而显式地模拟密度图中的跨盒依赖关系。此外，还采用了多任务预训练策略。
AI.result: CryoProt在多个基准测试中持续优于现有的最先进方法，在某些任务上取得了高达12%的性能提升，证明了模拟跨盒交互在冷冻电镜数据处理中的重要性。
AI.conclusion: CryoProt通过引入跨盒交互机制，有效提升了利用冷冻电镜密度图进行蛋白质表征的能力，并在多种下游任务中展现出优越的性能。
AI.translation: 尽管冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）密度图的可用性日益增长，但有效地利用它们进行蛋白质表征仍然具有挑战性。首先，现有方法缺乏一个通用的、专为冷冻电镜密度图设计的、用于蛋白质相关性质预测的预训练框架。其次，现有方法通常将密度图划分为局部盒区域并独立建模，忽略了盒与盒之间的交互作用，而这种交互对于捕捉冷冻电镜密度图中的全局结构上下文至关重要。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了CryoProt，一个专为冷冻电镜密度图设计的蛋白质预训练框架。CryoProt引入了一个基于多头潜在注意力（MLA）的密度图编码器，其中盒级别的表征通过共享的潜在空间进行交互，从而能够显式地模拟密度图中的跨盒依赖关系。此外，我们采用多任务预训练策略来学习可泛化的表征，这些表征可以有效地迁移到各种下游任务，例如蛋白质柔性预测，在这种任务中不需要冷冻电镜密度图，并且可以通过预训练模型隐式推断。实验结果表明，CryoProt在多个基准测试中持续优于现有的最先进方法，在最佳性能基线上取得了高达12%的提升，凸显了在冷冻电镜数据中模拟跨盒交互的重要性。源代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CryoProt公开获取。
AI.summary: CryoProt是一个新颖的蛋白质预训练框架，它利用冷冻电镜密度图，并通过多头潜在注意力（MLA）机制实现了跨盒交互，从而有效捕捉蛋白质的全局结构信息。该框架采用多任务学习策略，能够将学习到的通用表征迁移到多种下游任务，如蛋白质柔性预测。实验证明，CryoProt在多项基准测试中显著优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: CryoProt, 冷冻电镜, 蛋白质表征, 跨盒交互, 多头潜在注意力
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的CryoProt框架，解决了利用冷冻电镜密度图进行蛋白质表征的挑战。其核心创新在于引入了跨盒交互机制，并通过MLA增强了模型捕捉全局结构上下文的能力。这种方法在下游任务中取得了显著的性能提升，证明了考虑密度图不同区域之间相互作用的重要性。然而，该研究未明确说明其模型在处理不同分辨率或质量的密度图时的鲁棒性，这是一个值得未来研究的方向。代码的公开为该领域的进一步发展提供了便利。

title: Optimal-Point Variance Reduction For Bayesian Optimization With Regret Guarantee
summary: This paper studies a one-step lookahead Bayesian optimization (BO) method and its theoretical guarantee. Although the empirical effectiveness of one-step lookahead BO methods, such as entropy search, has been studied extensively, they often rely on computationally intractable approximations, and their regret guarantees remain underdeveloped. Thus, this paper proposes a one-step lookahead BO method called optimal-point variance reduction (OVR), which requires only posterior sampling and Monte Carlo approximations. We obtain a uniform error bound over an input domain for the Monte Carlo estimation in OVR. Furthermore, we show that the regularized OVR, with the slight modification to promote exploration, achieves a vanishing Bayesian expected simple regret upper bound. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of OVR through numerical experiments.

AI.title_translation: 贝叶斯优化的最优点方差缩减及其后悔度保证
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为OVR的贝叶斯优化方法，通过后验采样和蒙特卡洛近似来减少计算成本，并提供后悔度保证。
AI.motivation: 现有的贝叶斯优化方法（如熵搜索）虽然在实践中有效，但计算成本高且缺乏理论保证；本研究旨在提出一种计算上可行且具有理论保证的贝叶斯优化方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为最优点方差缩减（OVR）的一步前瞻贝叶斯优化方法，该方法仅依赖于后验采样和蒙特卡洛近似。通过对蒙特卡洛估计的误差进行界定，并对OVR进行正则化处理以促进探索，最终实现了贝叶斯期望简单后悔度的上界趋近于零。
AI.result: OVR方法仅需后验采样和蒙特卡洛近似即可实现，并获得了蒙特卡洛估计在输入域上的均匀误差界。正则化OVR实现了贝叶斯期望简单后悔度上界的消失。数值实验证明了OVR的有效性。
AI.conclusion: OVR是一种计算上可行且具有理论保证的贝叶斯优化方法，通过方差缩减和正则化探索，能够有效降低后悔度。
AI.translation: 本文研究了一种一步前瞻的贝叶斯优化（BO）方法及其理论保证。尽管一步前瞻BO方法（如熵搜索）的经验有效性已被广泛研究，但它们通常依赖于计算上不可行的近似，并且它们的后悔度保证仍然不完善。因此，本文提出了一种名为最优点方差缩减（OVR）的一步前瞻BO方法，该方法仅需要后验采样和蒙特卡洛近似。我们获得了OVR中蒙特卡洛估计在输入域上的均匀误差界。此外，我们表明，正则化的OVR通过轻微的探索性修改，实现了贝叶斯期望简单后悔度上界的消失。最后，我们通过数值实验证明了OVR的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为最优点方差缩减（OVR）的一步前瞻贝叶斯优化方法，旨在解决现有方法计算成本高和理论保证不足的问题。OVR仅依赖于后验采样和蒙特卡洛近似，克服了计算障碍。研究证明了OVR中的蒙特卡洛估计具有均匀误差界，并且通过正则化处理，OVR能够实现贝叶斯期望简单后悔度的理论上界趋近于零。数值实验结果证实了该方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 贝叶斯优化, 方差缩减, 后悔度保证, 蒙特卡洛近似, 最优点
AI.comments: 该研究在贝叶斯优化领域取得了重要进展，提出了一种兼具计算效率和理论保证的新方法。OVR的提出解决了现有方法的痛点，通过引入方差缩减和正则化探索，为贝叶斯优化在实际应用中的可靠性提供了理论支撑。然而，对于大规模或高维问题，其计算效率和泛化能力仍需进一步验证。

title: Boundary-Protection W8A8 HiFloat8 Quantization for Large-Scale Text-to-Video Diffusion Transformers
comments: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to ICME 2026 Grand Challenge
summary: We present a post-training quantization (PTQ) approach for Wan2.1-T2V-14B, a 14-billion-parameter text-to-video diffusion transformer, targeting the W8A8 HiFloat8 (HiF8) format on Ascend 910B NPUs. A central challenge in quantizing video DiT models is the heterogeneous activation distribution across transformer blocks: boundary blocks (the first and last few blocks) exhibit fundamentally different statistical properties from middle blocks, making uniform quantization ineffective. We conduct a systematic per-block activation analysis across all 40 WanAttentionBlocks and use the findings to motivate a boundary-protection strategy that retains the first two and last three blocks in BF16 while quantizing the remaining 35 blocks with W8A8 HiF8. The proposed PTQ method matches or marginally exceeds the BF16 baseline on all five VBench dimensions evaluated, indicating no measurable accuracy loss within the 5-prompt evaluation set. An ablation study over four protection configurations confirms that full boundary protection yields the highest average VBench score, validating the data-driven block selection. We additionally investigate quantization-aware training (QAT) as a complementary fine-tuning stage and analyze the conditions under which it fails to outperform plain PTQ on single-card hardware.
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to ICME 2026 Grand Challenge

AI.title_translation: 面向大规模文本到视频扩散变换器的边界保护 W8A8 HiFloat8 量化
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为W8A8 HiFloat8（HiF8）的后训练量化（PTQ）方法，用于在Ascend 910B NPU上量化140亿参数的文本到视频扩散Transformer模型Wan2.1-T2V-14B。由于视频DiT模型中Transformer块之间激活分布的异质性，特别是边界块与中间块的统计特性差异，统一量化效果不佳。研究人员通过系统分析，提出了一种边界保护策略，将前两个和最后三个块保留为BF16格式，其余35个块则使用W8A8 HiF8量化。实验结果表明，该PTQ方法在VBench的五个评估维度上均能达到或略微超过BF16基线，且没有明显的准确率损失。消融研究证实了所选边界块的有效性。此外，研究还探讨了量化感知训练（QAT）作为补充微调阶段的适用性，并分析了其在单卡硬件上可能无法超越纯PTQ的条件。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散Transformer（DiT）模型，特别是像Wan2.1-T2V-14B这样的大型模型，在部署时面临量化挑战。由于Transformer块之间激活分布的异质性，尤其是边界块（前几个和最后几个块）与中间块在统计特性上的显著差异，传统的统一量化方法难以有效进行，可能导致准确率下降。因此，需要一种能够适应这种异质性的量化策略，以在保持模型性能的同时减小模型大小和提高推理速度。
AI.method: 该研究提出了一种边界保护的后训练量化（PTQ）方法，针对Wan2.1-T2V-14B模型。首先，通过系统分析所有40个WanAttentionBlocks的激活分布，发现模型的前两个和最后三个块（边界块）具有与中间块不同的统计特性。基于此发现，研究人员提出了一种边界保护策略：将这5个边界块保留在BF16（Brain Floating Point 16）精度下，而将剩余的35个中间块量化到W8A8 HiFloat8（HiF8）格式。此外，研究还探索了量化感知训练（QAT）作为一种可选的微调阶段，并分析了其在单卡硬件上的局限性。
AI.result: 该PTQ方法在所有五个VBench维度上的表现均与BF16基线相当或略有超出，表明在所评估的5个提示的评估集上没有可测量的准确率损失。消融研究通过对四种不同的边界保护配置进行比较，证实了完全边界保护（保留前两个和最后三个块）能够获得最高的平均VBench分数，验证了数据驱动的块选择策略的有效性。研究还发现，在单卡硬件上，量化感知训练（QAT）并不总是能超越纯PTQ方法。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出了一种有效的边界保护PTQ方法，通过识别并保留视频扩散Transformer模型中统计特性异质的边界块（前两个和最后三个块）在BF16精度下，同时将中间块量化到W8A8 HiF8格式，成功实现了在不损失准确率的前提下对Wan2.1-T2V-14B模型进行高效量化。该方法在VBench评估中表现优异，验证了其有效性。同时，研究也指出了QAT作为补充微调阶段的局限性，尤其是在单卡硬件上可能无法带来显著性能提升。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种针对Wan2.1-T2V-14B（一个140亿参数的文本到视频扩散Transformer）的训练后量化（PTQ）方法，目标是在Ascend 910B NPU上实现W8A8 HiFloat8（HiF8）格式。量化视频DiT模型的一个核心挑战是Transformer块之间激活分布的异质性：边界块（前几个和最后几个块）的统计特性与中间块存在根本差异，导致统一量化效果不佳。我们对所有40个WanAttentionBlocks进行了系统的逐块激活分析，并利用分析结果提出了一种边界保护策略，将前两个和最后三个块保留为BF16格式，同时将剩余的35个块量化为W8A8 HiF8。所提出的PTQ方法在所有五个评估的VBench维度上均能匹配或略微超过BF16基线，表明在5个提示的评估集内没有可测量的准确率损失。一项关于四种保护配置的消融研究证实，完全边界保护可获得最高的平均VBench分数，验证了数据驱动的块选择。我们还探讨了量化感知训练（QAT）作为一种补充微调阶段，并分析了在单卡硬件上它可能无法超越纯PTQ的条件。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种创新的边界保护后训练量化（PTQ）方法，用于高效量化大型文本到视频扩散Transformer模型Wan2.1-T2V-14B。该方法解决了模型中不同Transformer块之间激活分布异质性的关键挑战，特别是边界块与中间块的统计特性差异。通过系统分析，研究人员将模型的前两个和最后三个块保留为BF16精度，其余块量化为W8A8 HiFloat8，有效避免了传统统一量化带来的准确率损失。实验结果表明，该方法在VBench评估中达到了与BF16基线相当或更优的性能，且消融研究证实了边界保护策略的有效性。此外，研究还探讨了量化感知训练（QAT）的局限性。
AI.keywords: 后训练量化, 扩散Transformer, 文本到视频, 边界保护, W8A8 HiFloat8
AI.comments: 这项研究在处理大型扩散模型量化方面取得了显著进展，特别关注了激活分布异质性这一关键挑战。通过数据驱动的边界保护策略，有效地在保持高精度的同时实现了显著的模型压缩，这对于部署大型多模态模型具有重要的实际意义。然而，研究中提到QAT在单卡硬件上的局限性值得进一步探讨，未来可以研究更优化的QAT方法或混合精度训练策略。

title: Towards Understanding Modality Interaction in Multimodal Language Models via Partial Information Decomposition
summary: Understanding modality interaction in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is central to reliable deployment. We introduce Partial Information Decomposition (PID) as a decision-level framework that separates unique, redundant, and synergistic contributions of sensory and linguistic inputs, beyond representation alignment and outcome-based evaluation. Across vision--language benchmarks, PID reveals recurring modality-use profiles: reasoning and grounding-oriented tasks tend to exhibit high synergy, whereas expert and knowledge-oriented tasks show stronger language-unique reliance. These profiles generalize across model families and predict sensitivity to modality-level interventions. We further extend PID to tri-modal systems with Sensory PID, treating language as a control variable to decompose video--audio information gain. Applied to omni-modal models, Sensory PID reveals a sensory synergy bottleneck dominated by visual information even on audio--visual fusion tasks. Finally, PID-guided reweighting provides initial evidence for improving multimodal reasoning and grounding performance.

AI.title_translation: 走向理解多模态语言模型中的模态交互，通过部分信息分解
AI.tldr: 该研究将部分信息分解（PID）框架应用于多模态语言模型（MLLMs），以量化不同模态（视觉、听觉、语言）之间的信息交互（独特、冗余、协同）。研究发现，不同任务类型（如推理、常识）的模态交互模式不同，并且这种模式可以预测模型对模态干预的敏感性。此外，研究还提出了扩展的PID（Sensory PID）用于三模态系统，并展示了PID可用于指导模型优化，提升多模态推理和理解能力。
AI.motivation: 理解多模态语言模型（MLLMs）中模态交互对于其可靠部署至关重要。
AI.method: 引入部分信息分解（PID）作为决策层面的框架，用于分离感知和语言输入在模型决策中的独特贡献、冗余贡献和协同贡献。该方法超越了传统的表示对齐和基于结果的评估方法。研究还扩展了PID到三模态系统（Sensory PID），将语言作为控制变量来分解视频-音频的信息增益。
AI.result: 在视觉-语言基准测试中，PID揭示了多种模态使用模式：推理和基础导向的任务倾向于表现出高度的协同作用，而专家和知识导向的任务则更依赖于语言的独特贡献。这些模式在不同的模型家族中具有普遍性，并能预测模型对模态层面干预的敏感性。对于全模态模型，Sensory PID发现存在一个由视觉信息主导的感知协同瓶颈，即使在处理音频-视觉融合任务时也是如此。最后，PID指导的重新加权为提高多模态推理和基础能力提供初步证据。
AI.conclusion: 部分信息分解（PID）为理解和量化多模态语言模型中的模态交互提供了一个强大的新框架。研究结果表明，不同任务具有不同的模态交互特征，并且这种理解可以指导模型优化，以提高性能。
AI.translation: 理解多模态语言模型中的模态交互对于可靠部署至关重要。我们引入部分信息分解（PID）作为一种决策层面的框架，它能够分离感觉和语言输入在模型决策中的独特贡献、冗余贡献和协同贡献，超越了表示对齐和基于结果的评估。在视觉-语言基准测试中，PID揭示了反复出现的模态使用模式：推理和基础导向的任务倾向于表现出高度的协同作用，而专家和知识导向的任务则显示出更强的语言独特依赖性。这些模式在模型家族中具有普遍性，并能预测对模态层面干预的敏感性。我们进一步将PID扩展到三模态系统，通过感官PID，将语言作为控制变量来分解视频-音频信息增益。应用于全模态模型，感官PID揭示了一个由视觉信息主导的感官协同瓶颈，即使在音频-视觉融合任务上也是如此。最后，PID指导的重新加权为提高多模态推理和基础能力提供了初步证据。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为部分信息分解（PID）的新框架，用于分析多模态语言模型（MLLMs）中不同输入模态（如视觉、听觉、语言）之间的交互方式。PID能够量化这些模态在模型决策过程中所贡献的独特信息、冗余信息以及协同信息。通过在多个视觉-语言任务上的实验，研究发现，需要推理和理解基础概念的任务表现出较高的模态协同性，而依赖专业知识或已有知识的任务则更侧重于语言的独特信息。这种模态交互模式具有跨模型的普适性，并且能够预测模型对移除或改变某些模态时的敏感度。研究还进一步将PID扩展到包含三种模态的系统，并发现即使在处理视听任务时，视觉信息也常常是限制模型性能的关键因素。最后，研究初步证明了利用PID的分析结果来调整不同模态的权重，可以有效提升模型在多模态推理和理解任务上的表现。
AI.keywords: 多模态语言模型, 模态交互, 部分信息分解, 协同信息, 独特信息, 冗余信息, 视觉-语言, 感官PID, 模型优化, 推理, 基础
AI.comments: 该研究提出的部分信息分解（PID）框架为理解多模态语言模型中的模态交互提供了一个新颖且有价值的视角。其将信息分解为独特、冗余和协同部分的方法，比传统的评估指标更能深入地揭示模态间的复杂关系。研究结果揭示了不同任务类型下模态使用模式的差异，以及这种模式的普适性和预测能力，这对于模型设计和调试具有重要意义。将PID扩展到三模态系统和利用PID指导模型优化是该研究的亮点，预示着其在实际应用中的潜力。然而，PID的计算复杂度以及在更广泛的多模态场景（如文本-文本交互）下的适用性仍需进一步探索。

title: SS-ZKR: Spatial-Semantic Zero-Knowledge Routing for Privacy-Preserving Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Foundational agent interoperability standards, notably the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), have advanced multi-agent system communication, and complementary identity frameworks leveraging W3C Decentralised Identifiers (DIDs) and Verifiable Credentials (VCs) provide cryptographic agent authentication. However, no existing protocol supports content-based semantic routing of agent payloads across organisational trust boundaries without requiring the routing intermediary to decrypt the payload, which is a hard constraint in compliance-sensitive environments governed by GDPR, HIPAA, and MiFID II. We propose SS-ZKR, a three-mechanism privacy-preserving routing protocol designed as a complementary layer atop A2A/MCP. Mechanism I introduces blind routing via differentially private semantic intent vectors cryptographically bound to zero-knowledge proofs of payload-schema consistency. Mechanism II offers vector-weighted adaptive payload sanitisation with formal (epsilon, delta)-differential privacy for numerical fields and heuristic semantic aggregation for textual fields. Mechanism III presents a spatial-to-cryptographic policy compiler that translates visually defined trust-zone topologies into deterministic zero-knowledge access circuits. We provide a formal threat model, analyse information leakage bounds of intent vectors, present pseudocode for all three mechanisms, and give analytical complexity comparisons against TEE-based and homomorphic encryption-based routing baselines. SS-ZKR lets enterprises in financial services, healthcare, and defence orchestrate heterogeneous AI agents across regulatory boundaries without exposing proprietary data to routing infrastructure.

AI.title_translation: 空间-语义零知识路由，用于隐私保护的多智能体协作
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为SS-ZKR的隐私保护路由协议，用于在不解密数据的情况下实现多智能体之间的内容语义路由，特别是在跨越组织信任边界和遵守GDPR等法规的环境中。该协议包含三个机制：差分隐私语义意图向量和零知识证明、向量加权自适应载荷清理、以及空间到密码学策略编译器。SS-ZKR能够让金融、医疗和国防等行业的企业在监管边界内协调异构AI智能体，而无需向路由基础设施暴露专有数据。
AI.motivation: 现有协议无法在不解密载荷的情况下实现基于内容的语义路由，这在受GDPR、HIPAA和MiFID II等法规管辖的合规敏感环境中是一个硬性限制。
AI.method: SS-ZKR是一个三机制隐私保护路由协议：1. 差分隐私语义意图向量和载荷模式一致性的零知识证明实现盲路由。2. 向量加权自适应载荷清理，对数值字段提供(epsilon, delta)-差分隐私，对文本字段进行启发式语义聚合。3. 空间到密码学策略编译器，将可视化信任区域拓扑转换为确定性零知识访问电路。
AI.result: SS-ZKR支持在不暴露专有数据的情况下，跨监管边界编排金融、医疗和国防领域的异构AI智能体。
AI.conclusion: SS-ZKR通过其三个机制，解决了现有协议在隐私保护和内容语义路由方面的不足，使得在严格监管环境下进行多智能体协作成为可能。
AI.translation: 基础的智能体互操作性标准，特别是智能体到智能体（A2A）协议和模型上下文协议（MCP），已经推动了多智能体系统的通信，而利用W3C去中心化标识符（DIDs）和可验证凭证（VCs）的补充身份框架提供了加密的智能体认证。然而，没有现有的协议支持在不要求路由中介解密载荷的情况下，跨组织信任边界的内容基于语义的智能体载荷路由，这在受GDPR、HIPAA和MiFID II等法规管辖的合规敏感环境中是一个硬性约束。我们提出SS-ZKR，一个三机制的隐私保护路由协议，作为A2A/MCP之上的补充层。机制I通过密码学绑定到载荷模式一致性零知识证明的差分隐私语义意图向量引入盲路由。机制II提供向量加权自适应载荷清理，对数值字段提供形式化的（epsilon, delta）-差分隐私，对文本字段进行启发式语义聚合。机制III提出了一个空间到密码学策略编译器，将视觉定义的信任区域拓扑转换为确定性零知识访问电路。我们提供了一个形式化的威胁模型，分析了意图向量的信息泄漏界限，为所有三个机制提供了伪代码，并与基于TEE和基于同态加密的路由基线进行了分析复杂度比较。SS-ZKR使金融服务、医疗保健和国防领域的企业能够在监管边界内协调异构AI智能体，而无需将专有数据暴露给路由基础设施。
AI.summary: SS-ZKR是一种新颖的多智能体协作隐私保护路由协议，通过差分隐私语义意图向量、零知识证明和自适应载荷清理等机制，实现了在不解密数据的情况下进行内容语义路由。该协议特别适用于金融、医疗和国防等受严格监管的行业，允许跨组织信任边界安全地编排AI智能体。
AI.keywords: 隐私保护路由, 零知识证明, 差分隐私, 多智能体协作, 语义路由
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一个在隐私保护方面具有创新性的多智能体路由协议SS-ZKR，特别解决了在合规敏感环境中跨组织边界进行安全通信的挑战。其利用零知识证明和差分隐私技术避免了对敏感数据的解密，这在当前数据隐私日益受到重视的背景下具有重要的理论和实践意义。然而，协议的实际部署和性能表现，尤其是在大规模和高并发场景下的效率，仍需进一步验证。

title: Reasmory: 3D Reconstruction as Explicit Memory for VLMs Spatial Reasoning
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit emerging spatial reasoning capabilities, yet they remain unreliable on tasks requiring precise spatial understanding, such as viewpoint reasoning, directional comparison, and distance estimation. In multi-view images and monocular videos, relevant spatial cues are often sparse and distributed across redundant observations, making them difficult to organize and exploit. Reconstruction-based Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) offer a natural way to aggregate such observations into explicit spatial memory, such as point clouds. However, simply exposing reconstruction models as free-form tools is brittle, VLMs may invoke tools incorrectly, skip required spatial transformations, or misuse intermediate results. We propose \textbf{Reasmory}, a framework that formulates spatial reasoning as structured program execution over reconstructed spatial memory. Reasmory constructs explicit 3D memory, augments it with semantically grounded 3D object instances, and introduces a lightweight Domain-Specific Language (DSL) that constrains how VLMs query objects and cameras, transform viewpoints, and render observations during reasoning. Generated programs are parsed and validated before execution, enabling more reliable interaction with spatial memory than unconstrained tool use. Experiments on multi-view image and video spatial reasoning benchmarks show consistent gains of 6--18\% over strong baselines, including GPT-5-mini and Gemini-3-flash, indicating that explicit 3D memory is most useful when accessed through constrained, validated operations rather than free-form tool calls.

AI.title_translation: Reasmory：将3D重建作为显式记忆，用于视觉语言模型的空间推理
AI.tldr: Reasmory框架通过将3D重建作为显式记忆，并使用领域特定语言（DSL）约束视觉语言模型（VLMs）的查询和操作，显著提高了VLMs在空间推理任务上的准确性，实验表明比现有模型有6-18%的提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型（VLMs）在需要精确空间理解的任务（如视点推理、方向比较和距离估计）方面不够可靠，因为多视图图像和单目视频中的空间线索稀疏且难以组织。
AI.method: 提出Reasmory框架，将空间推理构建为在重建的空间记忆上执行的结构化程序。Reasmory构建显式的3D记忆，用语义化的3D对象实例进行增强，并引入一个轻量级的领域特定语言（DSL），用于约束VLMs如何查询对象和相机、转换视点以及在推理过程中渲染观测。程序在执行前会被解析和验证。
AI.result: 在多视图图像和视频空间推理基准测试中，Reasmory比包括GPT-5-mini和Gemini-3-flash在内的强大基线模型提高了6-18%的性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式的3D记忆通过受约束、经过验证的操作（而非自由形式的工具调用）来访问时，对VLMs的空间推理能力最有益。
AI.translation: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）展现了新兴的空间推理能力，但在需要精确空间理解的任务上仍然不可靠，例如视点推理、方向比较和距离估计。在多视图图像和单目视频中，相关的空间线索通常稀疏且分布在冗余的观测中，使得组织和利用这些线索变得困难。基于重建的视觉基础模型（VFMs）提供了一种将这些观测聚合为显式空间记忆（如点云）的自然方式。然而，仅仅将重建模型作为自由形式的工具来使用是脆弱的，VLMs可能会错误地调用工具、跳过所需اً的空间变换或误用中间结果。我们提出了Reasmory，一个将空间推理构建为在重建的空间记忆上执行的结构化程序。Reasmory构建显式的3D记忆，用语义化的3D对象实例进行增强，并引入一个轻量级的领域特定语言（DSL），用于约束VLMs在推理过程中如何查询对象和相机、转换视点以及渲染观测。生成的程序在执行前会被解析和验证，从而能够比无约束的工具使用更可靠地与空间记忆进行交互。在多视图图像和视频空间推理基准测试上的实验表明，与包括GPT-5-mini和Gemini-3-flash在内的强大基线相比，性能持续提高了6-18%，这表明显式的3D记忆在通过受约束、经过验证的操作（而不是自由形式的工具调用）进行访问时最有用。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了Reasmory框架，旨在解决视觉语言模型（VLMs）在空间推理方面的局限性。Reasmory通过将3D重建作为一种显式空间记忆，并引入一个领域特定语言（DSL）来约束VLMs与该记忆的交互方式，从而提高了空间推理的准确性和可靠性。实验结果表明，Reasmory在多项空间推理任务上显著优于现有基线模型。
AI.keywords: Reasmory, 3D重建, 空间推理, 视觉语言模型, 领域特定语言
AI.comments: Reasmory框架通过结构化程序执行和领域特定语言（DSL）来约束VLMs与3D重建空间记忆的交互，这是一个有前景的方向，解决了自由形式工具调用中的脆弱性问题。然而，DSL的设计和学习如何有效利用DSL是关键挑战。此外，3D重建的准确性和效率也会直接影响Reasmory的性能。

title: Threading Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Model Inference in Low-Cost Smart Agricultural Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language Action (VLA) models continue to face challenges such as slow inference speed and difficulty performing fine-grained motion adjustments, limiting their widespread adoption in industry. While the Real-Time Action Chunking (RTAC) algorithm has been proposed to address these bottlenecks, bridging the gap between the algorithm provided in pseudocode to a stable, real-world deployment on a low-cost robotic arm remains a challenge. In this work, we present a complete system-level implementation of RTAC tailored for a low-cost robotic manipulation system. We advance beyond the original high-level pseudocode by optimizing the threading implementation for the policy inference and control pipeline, reducing end-to-end latency and improving responsiveness without modifying the underlying policy. We evaluate this system on tasks involving the manipulation of agricultural produce, specifically garlic bulbs and walnuts. Experimental results demonstrate that our custom threading implementation significantly improves control stability and speed compared to the base implementation of RTAC.

AI.title_translation: 低成本智能农业操作中视觉-语言-动作模型的推理线程优化
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个针对低成本机器人操作系统的RTAC算法的完整系统级实现，通过优化策略推理和控制流程中的线程实现，减少了端到端延迟，提高了响应速度，并在农业操作任务中证明了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在推理速度慢和难以进行细粒度运动调整方面存在挑战，限制了其在工业中的广泛应用。RTAC算法旨在解决这些瓶颈，但从伪代码到低成本机器人臂的实际部署仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 论文提出了一种针对低成本机器人操作系统的RTAC算法的完整系统级实现。通过优化策略推理和控制流程中的线程实现，在不修改底层策略的情况下，减少了端到端延迟并提高了响应速度。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，与RTAC的基础实现相比，该论文的自定义线程实现显著提高了控制稳定性和速度。
AI.conclusion: 该论文成功地实现并优化了RTAC算法在低成本机器人操作中的应用，显著提高了推理速度和控制稳定性，为VLA模型在农业等领域的实际应用铺平了道路。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言动作（VLA）模型在推理速度慢和难以进行细粒度运动调整方面仍然面临挑战，这限制了它们在工业中的广泛采用。尽管已提出实时动作分块（RTAC）算法来解决这些瓶颈，但将伪代码中提供的算法转化为低成本机器人手臂上稳定、现实世界的部署仍然是一个挑战。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种为低成本机器人操作系统量身定制的RTAC的完整系统级实现。我们通过优化策略推理和控制流程中的线程实现，超越了原始的高层伪代码，在不修改底层策略的情况下，减少了端到端延迟并提高了响应速度。我们在涉及农产品操作的任务中评估了这个系统，特别是大蒜和核桃。实验结果表明，与RTAC的基础实现相比，我们定制的线程实现显著提高了控制稳定性和速度。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种针对低成本机器人操作系统的实时动作分块（RTAC）算法的完整系统级实现。通过优化策略推理和控制流程中的线程实现，该工作在不修改底层策略的情况下，有效降低了端到端延迟并提高了响应速度。实验在农业场景中进行，结果表明该方法相比RTAC基础实现显著提升了控制稳定性和速度。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言-动作模型, 推理优化, 实时动作分块, 低成本机器人, 农业操作
AI.comments: 该研究有效地解决了VLA模型在实际应用中的关键痛点，即推理速度和运动控制精度。通过对现有算法进行系统级优化，而非从头开发新模型，展示了一种务实的工程方法。特别的是，在低成本硬件上的实现，使得该技术更具推广价值。然而，文中未提及对不同类型农业操作的泛化能力，以及在更复杂的、非结构化的环境中表现如何。

title: Flexible Control of 3D CT Generation via Text and Semantically-Defined Segmentation Prompts
summary: Generative models for volumetric medical images have found many applications in medical imaging, ranging from data augmentation to serving as priors for inverse problems. For these applications, generating high-resolution 3D images with strong controllability is essential but remains highly challenging. Existing approaches typically control generation either through radiology reports used as text prompts or through full image segmentation. While text-based prompting is flexible, it provides limited spatial control over the location, shape, and boundary of abnormalities. In contrast, segmentation-based methods receive precise spatial guidance but are restrictive in requiring full-organ annotations. In this work, we propose a flexible multimodal framework for controllable volumetric image generation that supports input from radiology reports and segmentation prompts (both optional). Our approach allows users to provide segmentation of a specific anatomy or abnormality without requiring full-organ annotations. The semantic meaning of the segmentation mask is specified through an accompanying text description, resulting in a highly flexible and scalable conditioning mechanism. We develop a memory-efficient architecture based on a modified diffusion transformer that jointly processes image and segmentation tokens. The model further incorporates gated attention to effectively attend to long radiology reports. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art perceptual and semantic scores (e.g., 24% relative improvement in mean FID), generates high-resolution anatomically consistent CT volumes, and improves data efficiency when used for data augmentation. Radiologists' evaluation further confirms strong alignment between generated and real medical images.

AI.title_translation: 三维 CT 生成的文本和语义分割提示的灵活控制
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种灵活的多模态框架，用于可控的体积医学图像生成，该框架结合了文本提示和语义分割提示，克服了现有方法的局限性，并在生成高分辨率、解剖学一致的 CT 图像方面取得了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在生成高分辨率三维医学图像时，要么文本提示空间控制有限，要么分割提示需要完整的器官注释，因此需要一种更灵活、可扩展的控制机制。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于修改的扩散 Transformer 的内存高效架构，该架构能够联合处理图像和分割 token，并结合门控注意力来处理长篇放射学报告，以实现灵活的多模态控制。
AI.result: 在感知和语义分数上达到了最先进的水平（平均 FID 相对提高了 24%），能够生成高分辨率、解剖学一致的 CT 图像，并提高了数据增强的数据效率。放射科医生的评估也证实了生成图像与真实医学图像的高度一致性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的灵活多模态框架能够有效地结合文本和可选的语义分割提示，实现可控的三维 CT 生成，并在生成质量、解剖学一致性和数据效率方面优于现有方法。
AI.translation: 生成体积医学图像的生成模型在医学成像中有许多应用，从数据增强到作为逆问题的先验。对于这些应用来说，生成具有强大可控性的高分辨率三维图像至关重要，但仍然具有高度挑战性。现有方法通常通过用作文本提示的放射学报告或通过完整的图像分割来控制生成。虽然基于文本的提示很灵活，但它对异常的位置、形状和边界提供的空间控制有限。相比之下，基于分割的方法能够获得精确的空间指导，但需要完整的器官注释，因此具有限制性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种可控体积图像生成的灵活多模态框架，该框架支持来自放射学报告和分割提示（均可选）的输入。我们的方法允许用户提供特定解剖结构或异常的分割，而无需完整的器官注释。分割掩模的语义含义通过伴随的文本描述来指定，从而实现高度灵活且可扩展的条件机制。我们开发了一种基于修改的扩散 Transformer 的内存高效架构，该架构能够联合处理图像和分割 token。该模型还结合了门控注意力，以有效地关注长篇放射学报告。实验表明，我们的方法在感知和语义分数上取得了最先进的水平（例如，平均 FID 相对提高了 24%），生成了高分辨率的解剖学一致的 CT 体积，并在用于数据增强时提高了数据效率。放射科医生的评估进一步证实了生成图像与真实医学图像的高度一致性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的、灵活的多模态框架，用于可控的三维 CT 生成。该框架能够灵活地结合文本提示（如放射学报告）和可选的语义分割提示，克服了现有方法在空间控制和注释要求方面的局限性。通过一种基于修改的扩散 Transformer 的内存高效架构，该模型能够联合处理图像和分割信息，并有效利用长文本报告。实验结果表明，该方法在生成质量、解剖学一致性和数据效率方面均达到了最先进水平，并得到了放射科医生的认可。
AI.keywords: 三维 CT 生成, 可控生成, 文本提示, 分割提示, 扩散 Transformer
AI.comments: 该研究提出的多模态框架在三维医学图像生成领域具有重要的创新意义。通过结合文本和语义分割提示，有效地解决了现有方法在控制精度和标注成本之间的权衡问题。内存高效的架构设计和门控注意力机制也体现了其工程上的优势。然而，未来的研究可以进一步探索如何更精细地融合不同模态的信息，以及在更广泛的医学成像任务中验证该方法的有效性。

title: Prospect-Theory Behavior from Bellman Optimality in MDPs with Catastrophic States
summary: We study risk-neutral control in Markov decision processes with an absorbing catastrophic state. Even though rewards are linear and the agent has no utility curvature, probability weighting, or framing dependence, standard Bellman optimality produces three prospect-theory-like signatures: an S-shaped value-function profile (convex near catastrophe, concave in the far field), an endogenous loss-sensitivity coefficient $λ^*(S) > 1$, and a reflection-effect policy reversal. Across 495 configurations, the optimal policy plays safe near catastrophe in positive-drift (growth) regimes despite the risky action's higher immediate expected value, and plays risky near catastrophe in negative-drift (decline) regimes despite the safe action's lower immediate expected loss. We derive a closed-form expression for the asymptotic loss-aversion plateau $\barλ$ that depends only on win probability $p$, payoff asymmetry $r = |Δ_\ell/Δ_w|$, and discount factor $β$, and matches numerical solutions to $R^2 = 0.999$. The mechanism does not require asymmetric payoffs. Across a sweep of $(p,β)$ at three asymmetry levels, the asymmetry share of $\barλ$ above unity has median 4.6% at $r = 1.25$ and rises to 13.9% at $r = 2$, with the boundary contribution exceeding the asymmetry contribution in every cell tested. The phenomena persist under tabular Q-learning (a model-free agent reproduces $V^*$ at correlation 0.98 in growth and 1.00 in decline) and under stochastic transitions with Gaussian, heavy-tailed Student-$t_3$, and asymmetric skew-normal noise up to 50% of the step size, where the asymptotic plateau tracks the closed-form prediction within 0.41% for safe-channel noise and within 9.6% for risky-channel or both-channel noise. These results identify absorbing failure states as a sufficient structural mechanism for prospect-theory-like behavior under optimal control.

AI.title_translation: 具有灾难性状态的马尔可夫决策过程中的贝尔曼最优性产生的远景理论行为
AI.tldr: 即使在风险中性、无效用曲率、无概率加权或无框架依赖的情况下，标准贝尔曼最优性在具有吸收性灾难性状态的马尔可夫决策过程中也会产生类似前景理论的行为，例如 S 形价值函数、内源性损失敏感性系数大于 1，以及政策反转。
AI.motivation: 研究具有吸收性灾难性状态的马尔可夫决策过程中的风险中性控制，以了解标准贝尔曼最优性如何产生类似前景理论的行为。
AI.method: 分析了具有吸收性灾难性状态的马尔可夫决策过程中的风险中性控制。推导了损失厌恶高原的闭式表达式，并使用表格 Q 学习和具有不同噪声类型的随机转移进行了数值验证。
AI.result: 标准贝尔曼最优性在具有吸收性灾难性状态的马尔可夫决策过程中产生了类似前景理论的行为，包括 S 形价值函数、内源性损失敏感性系数 $λ^*(S) > 1$ 和政策反转。推导出的闭式表达式能准确预测损失厌恶高原。这些现象在模型无关的代理和随机转移下也持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 吸收性失败状态是导致最优控制下产生类似前景理论行为的充分结构机制。
AI.translation: 我们研究了具有吸收性灾难性状态的马尔可夫决策过程中的风险中性控制。尽管奖励是线性的，并且代理没有效用曲率、概率加权或框架依赖性，但标准的贝尔曼最优性产生了三种类似前景理论的特征：S 形价值函数剖面（在灾难附近是凸的，在远处是凹的），内源性损失敏感性系数 $λ^*(S) > 1$，以及反射效应策略反转。在 495 种配置中，最优策略在正漂移（增长）状态下靠近灾难时采取保守策略，尽管有风险的操作具有更高的即时预期值，而在负漂移（衰退）状态下靠近灾难时采取冒险策略，尽管保守的操作具有更低的即时预期损失。我们推导了损失厌恶高原 $ arλ$ 的闭式表达式，它仅取决于获胜概率 $p$、收益不对称性 $r = |Δ_	ext{l}/Δ_	ext{w}|$ 和贴现因子 $β$，并且与数值解的拟合优度 $R^2 = 0.999$。该机制不需要不对称的收益。在三种不对称性水平下对 $(p,β)$ 进行扫描，当 $r = 1.25$ 时，损失厌恶高原 $ arλ$ 中超出单位的收益不对称性份额的中位数为 4.6%，当 $r = 2$ 时，上升到 13.9%，在所有测试的单元格中，边界贡献都超过了收益不对称性贡献。这些现象在表格 Q 学习（模型无关的代理在增长状态下以 0.98 的相关性，在衰退状态下以 1.00 的相关性重现 $V^*$）和具有高斯、重尾 Student-$t_3$ 和不对称偏态正态噪声（高达步长大小的 50%）的随机转移下仍然存在，其中渐近高原在安全通道噪声下与闭式预测的偏差在 0.41% 以内，在风险通道或两个通道噪声下偏差在 9.6% 以内。这些结果表明，吸收性失败状态是前景理论行为在最优控制下产生的充分结构机制。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了在具有吸收性灾难性状态的马尔可夫决策过程中，风险中性控制如何产生类似前景理论的行为。研究发现，即使在没有效用曲率、概率加权或框架依赖的情况下，标准贝尔曼最优性也会导致 S 形价值函数、内源性损失敏感性系数大于 1 以及政策反转。研究推导了损失厌恶高原的闭式表达式，并通过数值实验验证了其准确性。研究还表明，吸收性失败状态是导致这些类似前景理论行为的充分结构机制。
AI.keywords: 前景理论, 贝尔曼最优性, 马尔可夫决策过程, 灾难性状态, 损失厌恶
AI.comments: 这项研究非常有趣，因为它表明即使在风险中性代理的情况下，最优控制也可以导致类似前景理论的行为。这表明前景理论行为可能比以前认为的更普遍，并且可能在各种决策场景中出现。这项研究的局限性在于它仅限于马尔可夫决策过程，并且不一定适用于所有类型的决策问题。未来的研究可以探讨这些发现是否可以推广到更广泛的决策框架。

title: HypothesisMed: Inference-Time Answer Fusion and Structured Hypothesis-Space Reporting for Biomedical Question Answering
summary: Biomedical question answering with large language models is commonly evaluated using answer accuracy, but answer accuracy alone does not indicate whether a model can produce parseable outputs, follow structured reliability instructions, recognize weak answer spaces, or avoid confident incorrect commitments. This paper presents HypothesisMed, an inference-time reliability pipeline for biomedical multiple-choice question answering. It combines direct, chain-of-thought, HypothesisMed-v3 prompting, and answer fusion. The final answer is selected by fusion, while HypothesisMed-v3 supplies SPACE labels and confidence information. SPACE labels mark the answer space as VALID, INCOMPLETE, or CONTRADICTED. We evaluate Qwen2.5-7B, Phi-4-mini, DeepSeek-R1-32B, and BioMistral-7B on MedQA, MedMCQA, and PubMedQA using 1,000 examples per dataset. The pipeline improves weighted accuracy over each model's best direct or chain-of-thought baseline while increasing parse and SPACE coverage. We also scale evaluation to Qwen2.5-7B and Phi-4-mini using 10,183 examples per model. Fusion improves Phi-4-mini accuracy from 0.4296 to 0.5192, while Qwen2.5-7B chain-of-thought remains slightly higher in answer accuracy. However, Qwen2.5-7B fusion achieves complete parse and SPACE coverage with much lower false commitment. A 12,000-example SPACE stress test shows answer-space diagnosis remains difficult, with SPACE accuracy of 0.3074 for Qwen2.5-7B and 0.4168 for Phi-4-mini. These results show that answer accuracy, parseability, structured reliability reporting, calibration behavior, and false-commitment behavior are separable capabilities. The main contribution is not a universal state-of-the-art claim, but a reproducible inference-time framework for evaluating biomedical question answering models as auditable workflow components under structured reliability constraints.

AI.title_translation: HypothesisMed：用于生物医学问答的推理时答案融合和结构化假设空间报告
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了HypothesisMed，一个用于生物医学多项选择题问答的推理时可靠性流程，通过融合多种提示方法来提高答案准确性、可解析性和可靠性标签（VALID, INCOMPLETE, CONTRADICTED）的覆盖率。虽然它提高了某些模型的准确性，但答案空间诊断仍具挑战性，并强调了评估模型在结构化可靠性约束下的可审计性。
AI.motivation: 传统的生物医学问答评估仅关注答案准确性，未能体现模型生成可解析输出、遵循结构化可靠性指令、识别弱答案空间或避免自信错误承诺的能力。
AI.method: HypothesisMed是一个推理时可靠性流程，它结合了直接提示、思维链（Chain-of-Thought）、HypothesisMed-v3提示和答案融合。最终答案通过融合确定，同时HypothesisMed-v3提供SPACE标签（VALID, INCOMPLETE, CONTRADICTED）和置信度信息。
AI.result: 在MedQA、MedMCQA和PubMedQA数据集上，HypothesisMed流程在Qwen2.5-7B、Phi-4-mini、DeepSeek-R1-32B和BioMistral-7B模型上，提高了加权准确性，并增加了可解析性和SPACE标签的覆盖率。在更大规模的评估中，融合提高了Phi-4-mini的准确性，并使Qwen2.5-7B在完全解析和SPACE覆盖方面表现更好，同时降低了错误承诺。然而，SPACE标签的准确性仍有待提高。
AI.conclusion: 答案准确性、可解析性、结构化可靠性报告、校准行为和错误承诺行为是可分离的能力。HypothesisMed提供了一个可重复的推理时框架，用于在结构化可靠性约束下评估生物医学问答模型作为可审计的工作流组件，而非追求通用的最先进技术。
AI.translation: 生物医学问题回答与大型语言模型通常使用答案准确性进行评估，但仅凭答案准确性无法表明模型是否能生成可解析的输出、遵循结构化的可靠性指令、识别弱答案空间或避免自信的错误承诺。本文提出了HypothesisMed，一个用于生物医学多项选择题问答的推理时可靠性流程。它结合了直接、思维链（Chain-of-Thought）、HypothesisMed-v3提示和答案融合。最终答案通过融合确定，同时HypothesisMed-v3提供SPACE标签和置信度信息。SPACE标签将答案空间标记为有效（VALID）、不完整（INCOMPLETE）或矛盾（CONTRADICTED）。我们在MedQA、MedMCQA和PubMedQA数据集上，使用每个数据集的1000个示例评估了Qwen2.5-7B、Phi-4-mini、DeepSeek-R1-32B和BioMistral-7B。该流程在每个模型的最佳直接或思维链基线之上提高了加权准确性，同时增加了解析和SPACE覆盖率。我们还使用每个模型10183个示例的规模对Qwen2.5-7B和Phi-4-mini进行了评估。融合将Phi-4-mini的准确性从0.4296提高到0.5192，而Qwen2.5-7B的思维链在答案准确性方面仍然略高。然而，Qwen2.5-7B融合实现了完全的解析和SPACE覆盖，且错误承诺大大降低。12000个示例的SPACE压力测试表明，答案空间诊断仍然困难，Qwen2.5-7B的SPACE准确率为0.3074，Phi-4-mini为0.4168。这些结果表明，答案准确性、解析性、结构化可靠性报告、校准行为和错误承诺行为是可分离的能力。主要贡献不是普遍的最先进声明，而是一个可重复的推理时框架，用于在结构化可靠性约束下，将生物医学问答模型评估为可审计的工作流组件。
AI.summary: HypothesisMed是一个新提出的推理时可靠性流程，旨在改进生物医学多项选择题问答模型的评估。它通过融合直接、思维链和HypothesisMed-v3提示，并引入SPACE标签（VALID, INCOMPLETE, CONTRADICTED）来评估模型的答案准确性、可解析性、可靠性报告和避免错误承诺的能力。实验表明，该流程能提高模型性能并增强其可靠性，尽管答案空间诊断仍面临挑战，但该框架为更全面的模型评估提供了基础。
AI.keywords: 生物医学问答, HypothesisMed, 推理时可靠性, 答案融合, 结构化假设空间
AI.comments: 该研究提出的HypothesisMed框架在生物医学问答评估方面具有创新性，它超越了传统的答案准确性指标，引入了可解析性、可靠性标签和错误承诺等更全面的评估维度。将这些评估能力视为可分离的，并设计一个推理时的融合流程，为开发更可靠、更可审计的AI系统提供了实用方法。然而，SPACE标签的准确性仍是未来研究的关键挑战，需要进一步探索更有效的答案空间诊断方法。

title: Lost in Delusion: Examining LLM Safety Under User Delusions and Distress
summary: LLM chatbots increasingly serve as a first source of support for people in psychological distress, including those whose distress is entangled with delusional beliefs. Prior work on LLM mental-health safety largely evaluates general therapeutic quality or single-turn crisis detection, leaving unclear how models behave when distress is intertwined with delusion over sustained conversations. We address this gap with matched multi-turn simulations, across clinically grounded personas and six LLMs, that pair each delusional conversation with a distress-only control to isolate the effect of delusional framing. This reveals a recognition-intervention gap: models detect distress at comparable rates regardless of framing, yet sharply fail to act on it once distress is embedded in delusion, with safety interventions suppressed by up to 4.5x. The failure tracks accumulated acceptance of the user's premises rather than emotional validation. Worse, the intuitive fix of prompting models to assess user distress backfires under delusional framing; only delusion-aware prompting with explicit response guidance closes the gap, and even this depends on a delusion classifier that is itself unreliable on the most vulnerable models.
