title: Efficient Approximation for Encoder--Decoder Neural Operators via Variation Spaces
summary: We study operator learning using encoder--decoder neural networks. Inspired by the function-space theory of neural networks, we introduce a variation space as an infinite-dimensional structural class for nonlinear operators. This space is defined through vector-valued measures directly on the input and output spaces. For operators in this space, we establish approximation bounds for encoder--decoder two-layer networks in the Bochner $L^q$ norm. The resulting error bound decomposes into the input encoding error, the output encoding error, and a finite-width approximation term of order $N^{-1/2}$, with a constant independent of the input and output encoding dimensions. When the input and output encoding errors decay polynomially in the encoding dimensions, these estimates yield algebraic approximation and learning rates. The results provide an theoretical guarantees for efficient neural operator learning beyond general Lipschitz or Fréchet differentiable operator classes.

AI.title_translation: 通过变异空间对编解码器神经算子进行高效逼近
AI.tldr: 本文通过引入变异空间作为非线性算子的结构类，为使用编解码器神经网络进行算子学习提供了理论基础，并建立了在Bochner $L^q$范数下的逼近界限，证明了超越传统算子类的有效神经算子学习。
AI.motivation: 为超越一般Lipschitz或Fréchet可微算子类的高效神经算子学习提供理论保证。
AI.method: 引入一个变异空间作为非线性算子的无限维结构类，该空间通过输入和输出空间上的向量值测度定义。然后，利用编解码器两层网络对该空间中的算子进行近似。
AI.result: 建立了编解码器两层网络在Bochner $L^q$范数下的近似界限。误差界限分解为输入编码误差、输出编码误差和$N^{-1/2}$阶的有限宽度近似项。当编码误差呈多项式衰减时，这些估计产生代数近似和学习率。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为超越一般Lipschitz或Fréchet可微算子类的高效神经算子学习提供了理论保证。
AI.translation: 我们研究使用编解码器神经网络进行算子学习。受神经网络函数空间理论的启发，我们引入了一个变异空间作为非线性算子的无限维结构类。该空间通过直接在输入和输出空间上的向量值测度定义。对于该空间中的算子，我们建立了Bochner $L^q$范数下编解码器两层网络的逼近界限。由此产生的误差界限分解为输入编码误差、输出编码误差和$N^{-1/2}$阶的有限宽度逼近项，其常数独立于输入和输出编码维度。当输入和输出编码误差在编码维度上呈多项式衰减时，这些估计产生代数逼近和学习率。这些结果为超越一般Lipschitz或Fréchet可微算子类的有效神经算子学习提供了理论保证。
AI.summary: 本文研究了使用编解码器神经网络进行算子学习，并引入了一个基于向量值测度的变异空间作为非线性算子的结构类。研究建立了在该变异空间中，编解码器两层网络在Bochner $L^q$范数下的近似误差界限，该界限分解为编码误差和$N^{-1/2}$阶的有限宽度近似项。这些理论结果为高效的神经算子学习提供了超越传统Lipschitz或Fréchet可微算子类的理论保证。
AI.keywords: 神经算子, 编解码器网络, 变异空间, 逼近界限, 算子学习
AI.comments: 这项工作通过引入“变异空间”为神经算子学习提供了一个新的理论框架，并为编解码器网络的近似能力提供了严格的数学证明，特别是在超越传统算子类方面具有创新性。其误差分解和代数逼近率的发现对于理解和改进神经算子的效率和泛化能力具有重要意义。

title: Cheap Talk in Bilateral Trade
summary:
A single seller offers one or more goods to a single buyer. The buyer's values and the seller's costs are private information. Each player has a commonly known prior over the other player's value or cost, supported on a finite set. What is the optimal selling mechanism?
  We argue that, despite this question's importance and apparent simplicity, prior work offers no satisfactory answer. If the seller simply chooses an optimal menu given her realized costs, she fails to exploit her informational advantage. At the other extreme, the optimal trade mechanism that satisfies IC/IR constraints for both parties fails in practice, as it conditions prices on the seller's unknown costs in an unenforceable way. The seller's realistic capabilities lie somewhere in between: she may leverage private information but lacks unlimited commitment power.
  To bridge this gap, we consider a solution concept built on the realistic assumption that the seller can commit to prices but nothing more. Similar -- albeit technically distinct -- solution concepts have been studied in the context of auctions with multiple buyers. Our concept proves surprisingly rich even with a single buyer. In our model, the buyer and seller engage in multiple rounds of cheap talk before the seller posts a menu of priced bundles. The buyer then purchases.
  We measure value as profit for the seller and consumer surplus for the buyer. We prove that with a single good cheap talk cannot help either party, but show that it creates value in any extension of this canonical setting: multiple goods, multiple units, interdependent values, or repeated play. We also show that multiple rounds of communication can yield strictly higher expected profit than a single round. Finally, we discuss how realistic factors beyond our stripped-down model combine with cheap talk to enhance this value even further.

AI.title_translation: 双边贸易中的廉价交谈
AI.tldr: 本文研究双边贸易中的廉价交谈（cheap talk），发现在单商品设置中其无法带来收益，但在多商品、多单位、关联价值或重复博弈等扩展场景下，多轮廉价交谈能显著为买卖双方创造价值并提升卖家利润。
AI.motivation: 在双边贸易的最优机制设计中，现有理论存在两极分化的局限：要么假设卖家无法利用其信息优势（仅选择静态最优菜单），要么假设的最优交易机制在实践中因需要对不可强制执行的未知成本进行价格挂钩而失效。因此，需要探索一种介于两者之间、更符合现实（卖家有价格承诺能力但无无限承诺能力）的机制。
AI.method: 提出一种新的解决方案概念：假设卖家仅能对价格做出承诺，而无法承诺其他。在此框架下，构建了一个博弈模型，其中买家和卖家在卖家公布最终的定价捆绑包菜单（menu of priced bundles）之前，先进行多轮无成本、无约束的“廉价交谈”（cheap talk），之后买家做出购买决策。
AI.result: 1. 在单一商品设置中，廉价交谈无法为买卖任何一方带来价值提升。 2. 在多商品、多单位、关联价值或重复博弈等任何扩展设置中，廉价交谈均能创造价值。 3. 多轮沟通比单轮沟通能够产生严格更高的卖家预期利润。
AI.conclusion: 廉价交谈在超越单一商品经典设置的更广泛双边贸易场景（如多商品、多单位、关联价值、重复博弈）中具有重要价值，且多轮沟通能够比单轮沟通产生严格更高的预期利润。结合现实因素，这种沟通价值还可以得到进一步提升。
AI.translation:
一个卖家向一个买家提供一种或多种商品。买家的估值和卖家的成本是私人信息。每个参与者对另一个参与者的估值或成本都有一个共同已知的先验分布，其支持集为有限集。最优的销售机制是什么？
我们认为，尽管这个问题非常重要且看似简单，但先前的研究并没有给出令人满意的答案。如果卖家仅根据其实现的成本选择最优菜单，她就无法利用自己的信息优势。在另一个极端，满足双方激励相容（IC）和个体理性（IR）约束的最优交易机制在实践中会失效，因为它以一种无法强制执行的方式将价格与卖家未知的成本挂钩。卖家的实际能力介于两者之间：她可以利用私人信息，但缺乏无限的承诺能力。
为了弥补这一差距，我们考虑了一种建立在现实假设之上的解决方案概念，即卖家可以对价格做出承诺，但仅此而已。在多买家拍卖的背景下，人们研究过类似（尽管技术上不同）的解决方案概念。即使在只有单个买家的情况下，我们的概念也表现得异常丰富。在我们的模型中，买家和卖家在卖家公布定价捆绑包菜单之前进行多轮廉价交谈。然后买家进行购买。
我们以卖家的利润和买家的消费者剩余来衡量价值。我们证明，在单一商品的情况下，廉价交谈对任何一方都没有帮助，但我们表明，在这一经典设置的任何扩展中（多商品、多单位、关联价值或重复博弈），它都能创造价值。我们还表明，多轮沟通可以比单轮沟通产生严格更高的预期利润。最后，我们讨论了我们简化模型之外的现实因素如何与廉价交谈相结合，以进一步提升这种价值。
AI.summary: 本文研究了存在双向信息不对称的双边贸易中的最优销售机制。作者提出了一种新的模型，允许买卖双方在卖家发布定价菜单前进行多轮“廉价交谈”（cheap talk），且卖家仅具有价格承诺能力。研究表明，虽然廉价交谈在单一商品的经典设定中无法发挥作用，但在多商品、多单位、关联价值或重复博弈等扩展场景下，它能有效创造价值，且多轮沟通比单轮沟通能带来更高的预期利润。
AI.keywords: 双边贸易, 廉价交谈, 机制设计, 价格承诺, 信息不对称
AI.comments: 1. 创新性：将“廉价交谈”（cheap talk）引入到仅有价格承诺能力（而非无限承诺能力）的双边贸易模型中，巧妙地弥补了完全承诺与完全无承诺之间的理论空白。 2. 重要性：证明了在单商品经典场景下无用的沟通，在多商品、多单位、关联价值或重复博弈等更现实的扩展场景中能显著创造价值，且多轮沟通优于单轮。 3. 局限性：结论依赖于卖家只能承诺价格这一特定假设，在实际更为复杂的动态博弈中，其均衡的鲁棒性还有待检验。

title: Distribution-free changepoint localization after sequential change detection
summary: This paper introduces a distribution-free framework for constructing post-detection confidence sets for changepoints after stopping a sequential change detection procedure. It is well known that conformal test martingales can be used to sequentially detect changes in distribution, but by themselves provide no inference for the time at which a proclaimed change occurred. Past work on post-detection inference requires pre- and post-change classes of distributions to be known, but this paper accomplishes localization of the changepoint without any distributional assumptions. We establish finite-sample coverage guarantees (conditional on correct detection). We provide non-asymptotic bounds on the conditional expected size of the confidence sets. Under suitable asymptotic regimes, we proved that the conditional expected size of the confidence set remains uniformly bounded. and demonstrate strong empirical performance on simulated and real data. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first general distribution-free framework for sequential changepoint localization with a valid post-detection coverage guarantee.

AI.title_translation: 序列变化检测后的无分布变点定位
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在序列变化检测停止后，用于构建变点事后置信区间的无分布框架，解决了传统方法需要已知分布假设的问题，并提供了有限样本覆盖率保证和非渐近边界。
AI.motivation: 传统的序列变化检测方法能够检测出分布变化，但无法推断出变化发生的确切时间。已有的事后推断工作需要预先和事后分布类别已知，而本文旨在解决在没有任何分布假设的情况下定位变点的问题。
AI.method: 本文引入了一种无分布框架，用于在停止序列变化检测程序后，构建变点的事后置信区间。该方法利用共形检验鞅进行序列变化检测，并在此基础上进行变点定位，无需任何分布假设。
AI.result: 该框架在正确检测的条件下，建立了有限样本覆盖率保证。同时，提供了置信区间条件期望大小的非渐近边界。在合适的渐近机制下，证明了置信区间的条件期望大小保持一致有界。在模拟和真实数据上表现出强大的实证性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次提出了一个通用的无分布序列变点定位框架，具有有效的事后覆盖率保证，解决了传统方法对分布假设的依赖。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了一个无分布框架，用于在停止序列变化检测程序后，构建变点的事后置信区间。众所周知，共形检验鞅可以用于序列检测分布变化，但它们本身无法推断出所宣称变化发生的时间。过去关于事后推断的工作需要预先和事后分布类别已知，但本文在没有任何分布假设的情况下实现了变点定位。我们建立了有限样本覆盖率保证（以正确检测为条件）。我们提供了置信区间条件期望大小的非渐近边界。在合适的渐近机制下，我们证明了置信区间的条件期望大小保持一致有界，并在模拟和真实数据上展示了强大的实证性能。据我们所知，这是第一个用于序列变点定位的通用无分布框架，具有有效的事后检测覆盖率保证。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种创新的无分布框架，用于在序列变化检测停止后对变点进行定位。与以往需要预先和事后分布假设的方法不同，该框架在没有任何分布假设的情况下，能够构建变点的事后置信区间。研究建立了有限样本覆盖率保证和非渐近边界，并在渐近机制下证明了置信区间大小的一致有界性。该方法在模拟和真实数据上表现出色，是首个提供有效事后覆盖率保证的通用无分布序列变点定位框架。
AI.keywords: 无分布, 变点定位, 序列变化检测, 置信区间, 共形检验
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了首个通用的无分布框架，用于在序列变化检测后对变点进行定位，解决了传统方法对特定分布假设的依赖。这对于实际应用中数据分布未知或复杂的情况具有重要意义。有限样本覆盖率保证和非渐近边界的建立，增强了该方法的理论严谨性和实用性。

title: A 1000-hour EEG-EMG-audio dataset of Japanese speech production
summary: We present a multimodal dataset of 1020 hours of simultaneously recorded scalp electroencephalography (EEG), facial electromyography (EMG), and speech audio from three healthy native Japanese speakers during open-vocabulary overt speech. Recordings were acquired with three EEG systems-an ultra-high-density system (g.Pangolin) and two cap-type systems (g.SCARABEO and eegosports), spanning 62-128 channels-across many sessions over several months. Each session provides time-synchronized EEG, facial EMG, and audio, together with speech-event annotations and transcriptions. Although collected with speech decoding as a primary motivation, the dataset also supports work on multimodal signal processing, artifact modeling, longitudinal and cross-device adaptation, and EEG representation learning. Technical validation included power spectral density and event-related potential analyses across participants, devices, and tasks, which showed the expected 1/f spectral profile, task-related alpha-band attenuation, and time-locked evoked responses. The dataset is released in Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) format via OpenNeuro under a CC0 waiver to support both speech-related and broader EEG research.

AI.title_translation: 一个1000小时的日语语音产生脑电-肌电-音频数据集
AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了1020小时的日语语音产生多模态数据集，包含EEG、EMG和音频，用于支持语音解码、多模态信号处理、伪影建模等研究，并已以BIDS格式公开发布。
AI.motivation: 该数据集的主要动机是支持语音解码研究，但也支持多模态信号处理、伪影建模、纵向和跨设备适应以及脑电图表示学习。
AI.method: 通过三个脑电图系统（g.Pangolin、g.SCARABEO和eegosports），在数月内的多个会话中，从三名健康的日本母语使用者那里同步记录了1020小时的头皮脑电图（EEG）、面部肌电图（EMG）和语音音频。数据包括语音事件注释和转录。
AI.result: 技术验证包括跨参与者、设备和任务的功率谱密度和事件相关电位分析，结果显示预期的1/f谱分布、任务相关的α波段衰减和时间锁定诱发电位。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集已以脑成像数据结构（BIDS）格式通过OpenNeuro根据CC0豁免发布，以支持语音相关和更广泛的EEG研究。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一个多模态数据集，包含1020小时的同步记录的头皮脑电图（EEG）、面部肌电图（EMG）和语音音频，来自三名健康的日本母语使用者，进行开放词汇的显性语音。记录通过三个EEG系统——一个超高密度系统（g.Pangolin）和两个帽式系统（g.SCARABEO和eegosports），涵盖62-128个通道——在数月内的多个会话中采集。每个会话提供时间同步的EEG、面部EMG和音频，以及语音事件注释和转录。尽管主要动机是语音解码，但该数据集也支持多模态信号处理、伪影建模、纵向和跨设备适应以及EEG表示学习方面的工作。技术验证包括跨参与者、设备和任务的功率谱密度和事件相关电位分析，结果显示预期的1/f谱分布、任务相关的α波段衰减和时间锁定诱发电位。该数据集已以脑成像数据结构（BIDS）格式通过OpenNeuro根据CC0豁免发布，以支持语音相关和更广泛的EEG研究。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了一个包含1020小时EEG、EMG和音频的日语语音产生多模态数据集。数据由三名日本母语使用者在开放词汇语音任务中采集，使用了三种不同类型的EEG系统。数据集旨在支持语音解码、多模态信号处理、伪影建模和EEG表示学习等研究。技术验证结果符合预期，数据集已以BIDS格式公开发布。
AI.keywords: EEG, EMG, 语音产生, 数据集, 日语
AI.comments: 该数据集的创新之处在于其大规模（1020小时）、多模态（EEG、EMG、音频）以及对开放词汇日语语音的关注。其公开发布和BIDS格式的使用极大地促进了语音解码和脑电图研究领域的可复现性和进一步发展。

title: An extremal problem for completely unclustered Burrows-Wheeler images
summary:
The Burrows--Wheeler transform is usually viewed as a clustering transform: it tends to group equal letters into long runs. We study the opposite extremal regime, where the BWT output is completely unclustered, that is, has as many equal-letter runs as positions. Known results imply, on the one hand, that the number of runs in the BWT of a Lyndon word can increase by at most a factor of two, and, on the other hand, that over every alphabet of size at least three completely unclustered BWT images exist in every length. This leads to the extremal problem lying between these two facts. For \(k\ge3\), let \(U_k(n)\) be the minimum cyclic run number of a primitive necklace of length \(n\) whose BWT has \(n\) runs.
  We prove the universal lower bound \(U_k(n)\ge\lceil n/2\rceil\), reduce the sharpness problem for one-cycle BWT images \(L\) to the Hamming identity \[
  \cruns(\BWT^{-1}(L))=\dH(L,\sort(L)), \] and develop a natural multiset-of-necklaces relaxation with an explicit constant-cycle correction. We compute the small values, including the exceptional value \(U_k(6)=4\), prove a parity obstruction for the Parikh vectors of sharp examples, and determine the multiset relaxation exactly. Finally, for every prime \(p\equiv5\pmod8\) for which \(2\) is a primitive root modulo \(p\), we prove sharpness in the adjacent lengths \(p-1\) and \(p\). Under the corresponding Artin-type infinitude hypothesis, this gives infinitely many adjacent sharp pairs.

AI.title_translation: 全不聚集的Burrows-Wheeler图像的一个极值问题
AI.tldr: 该论文研究了Burrows-Wheeler变换（BWT）输出的非聚集特性，提出了一个关于原始项链的极值问题，并证明了一个下界，同时还探讨了该问题的精确解和相关数学性质。
AI.motivation: 研究BWT输出完全不聚集的极端情况，即BWT输出的相同字母运行次数达到最大值。
AI.method: 证明了通用下界U_k(n) >= lceil n/2 ⌉，将锐度问题简化为汉明距离的恒等式，并开发了一个自然的多重集松弛方法，同时计算了小数值并证明了一个关于Parikh向量的奇偶性障碍。
AI.result: 证明了U_k(n) >= lceil n/2 ⌉，并计算了小数值，包括U_k(6)=4。对于特定素数p，证明了在长度p-1和p处的锐度。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为BWT的极值问题提供了新的见解，并为未来的研究奠定了基础，特别是关于Artin猜想的证明。
AI.translation: 通常认为，Burrows-Wheeler变换是一种聚集变换：它倾向于将相同的字母组合成长的运行。我们研究了相反的极值状态，其中BWT输出完全不聚集，即相同字母的运行次数等于其位置数。已知的结果表明，一方面，Lyndon单词的BWT的运行次数最多只能增加一倍；另一方面，在每个至少有三个字母的字母表上，对于每个长度都存在完全不聚集的BWT图像。这就引出了介于这两个事实之间的极值问题。对于k≥3，设U_k(n)为长度为n的原始项链的最小循环运行数，其BWT有n个运行。我们证明了通用下界U_k(n)≥⌈n/2⌉，将一个周期BWT图像L的锐度问题简化为汉明恒等式cruns(BWT^{-1}(L))=dH(L,sort(L))，并开发了一个具有显式常数周期校正的自然多重集项链松弛。我们计算了小数值，包括例外值U_k(6)=4，证明了锐例的Parikh向量的奇偶性障碍，并精确确定了多重集松弛。最后，对于每个素数p≡5(mod8)，其中2是模p的本原根，我们证明了相邻长度p-1和p的锐度。在相应的Artin型无穷假设下，这给出了无穷多个相邻的锐对。
AI.summary: 本论文研究了Burrows-Wheeler变换（BWT）输出的完全不聚集的极端情况，即相同字母的运行次数等于其位置数。作者提出了一个关于原始项链的极值问题U_k(n)，并证明了其通用下界为U_k(n)≥⌈n/2⌉。论文还通过简化锐度问题、开发多重集松弛方法以及计算小数值来进一步研究该问题，并对特定情况下的锐度进行了证明，暗示了Artin猜想的可能联系。
AI.keywords: Burrows-Wheeler变换, 极值问题, 运行次数, 原始项链, 锐度
AI.comments: 这篇论文在BWT的极值问题上进行了深入研究，提出了新的数学模型和证明方法，并与Artin猜想联系起来，具有重要的理论意义。然而，论文的数学深度较高，可能需要专业背景才能完全理解。

title: Strategic Users in a Priority Queue with Bulk Service on Blockchains
summary: This paper analyzes transaction fees on blockchains by considering that they form a priority queue and users play a queueing game. Using an M/G^K/1 priority queue model, we provide new insights into the dynamics governing transaction fees and their impact on user behavior. We derive semi-closed form expressions for steady-state quantities and extend the relationship between user delay costs and transaction fees to general block generation times. We apply the model to the Bitcoin network and simulate user responses under various scenarios. Cross-chain analysis across Bitcoin, Dogecoin, and Litecoin reveals similarities in normalized cost structures.

AI.title_translation: 区块链上批量服务优先级队列中的策略性用户
AI.tldr: 本文将区块链交易费用建模为一个优先级队列游戏，使用M/G^K/1模型分析了费用动态和用户行为，推导了稳态表达式，并应用于比特币网络和跨链分析。
AI.motivation: 分析区块链上的交易费用，并理解其对用户行为的影响。
AI.method: 将区块链交易视为一个优先级队列游戏，使用M/G^K/1优先级队列模型，推导稳态量的半封闭形式表达式，并将用户延迟成本和交易费用的关系扩展到一般区块生成时间。将模型应用于比特币网络模拟用户响应，并进行比特币、狗狗币和莱特币的跨链分析。
AI.result: 提供了关于交易费用动态及其对用户行为影响的新见解。推导了稳态量的半封闭形式表达式，并将用户延迟成本和交易费用的关系扩展到一般区块生成时间。模拟了比特币网络中用户在各种场景下的响应。揭示了比特币、狗狗币和莱特币之间标准化成本结构的相似性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将区块链交易费用建模为优先级队列游戏，本文提供了对交易费用动态和用户行为的深入理解，并展示了不同区块链网络中成本结构的相似性。
AI.translation: 本文通过将区块链交易视为一个优先级队列且用户进行排队博弈来分析区块链上的交易费用。使用M/G^K/1优先级队列模型，我们对支配交易费用及其对用户行为影响的动态提供了新的见解。我们推导了稳态量的半封闭形式表达式，并将用户延迟成本与交易费用的关系扩展到一般的区块生成时间。我们将该模型应用于比特币网络，并模拟了各种场景下用户的响应。对比特币、狗狗币和莱特币的跨链分析揭示了标准化成本结构的相似性。
AI.summary: 本研究通过将区块链交易费用视为一个优先级队列游戏来分析其动态。文章采用M/G^K/1优先级队列模型，深入探讨了交易费用及其对用户行为的影响，并推导了稳态量的半封闭形式表达式。模型将用户延迟成本与交易费用的关系推广至一般区块生成时间，并通过应用于比特币网络和跨链分析（比特币、狗狗币、莱特币）验证了其有效性，揭示了标准化成本结构的相似性。
AI.keywords: 交易费用, 优先级队列, 区块链, 用户行为, M/G^K/1模型
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将区块链交易费用问题建模为一个优先级队列博弈，并引入了M/G^K/1模型进行分析。其推导的半封闭形式表达式和对一般区块生成时间的扩展具有理论意义，而跨链分析则增加了研究的实际价值和普适性。

title: Quantum Algorithm for Distributed Reduction of Entanglements (QADR): A Trainable and Simulation-Efficient QML Framework
summary: Training Variational Quantum Circuits (VQCs) under Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) constraints introduces severe computational limitations: classical statevector simulation memory scales exponentially ($\mathcal{O}(2^n)$), and global cost functions suffer from barren plateaus where gradient variance decays exponentially ($\mathcal{O}(1/2^n)$). This paper introduces and evaluates the Quantum Algorithm for Distributed Reduction of Entanglements (QADR), a hybrid quantum-classical machine learning framework that decomposes a global $n$-qubit VQC into localized sub-circuits operating approximately within the causal light cones of individual target qubits. QADR reduces classical simulation memory scaling from $\mathcal{O}(2^n)$ to $\mathcal{O}(n \cdot 2^{2d+1})$ for a light cone radius $d$, while naturally mitigating global barren plateaus. We benchmark QADR against standard global VQCs, Support Vector Machines (SVM), and two customized classical parameter-matched neural networks (CANN and PMNN) on the MNIST dataset and the high-dimensional NASA IMS wind turbine drivetrain diagnostic task. QADR demonstrates excellent scalability, operating successfully at $n_{\text{features}}=2000$ where standard global VQCs crash due to memory exhaustion, while matching or exceeding the performance of optimized classical architectures.

AI.title_translation: 分布式纠缠减少量子算法（QADR）：一种可训练且模拟高效的量子机器学习框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出 QADR 框架，通过将全局变分量子电路分解为局部子电路，将经典模拟内存复杂度从指数级降至多项式级，有效缓解了贫瘠高原问题，并在高维任务中实现了极佳的可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 在嘈杂中等规模量子（NISQ）约束下，训练变分量子电路（VQC）面临两大严重计算瓶颈：一是经典态矢量模拟的内存需求随量子比特数呈指数级增长（$\mathcal{O}(2^n)$）；二是全局成本函数容易遭遇梯度方差指数级衰减（$\mathcal{O}(1/2^n)$）的贫瘠高原问题。
AI.method: 提出分布式纠缠减少量子算法（QADR），这是一种混合量子-经典机器学习框架。该框架将一个全局的 $n$ 量子比特变分量子电路（VQC）分解为多个局部子电路，这些子电路在单个目标量子比特的近似因果光锥（半径为 $d$）内运行。
AI.result: QADR 将经典模拟的内存复杂度从 $\mathcal{O}(2^n)$ 降低到 $\mathcal{O}(n \cdot 2^{2d+1})$，并自然缓解了全局贫瘠高原。在 MNIST 和 NASA IMS 风力发电机传动系统诊断任务的基准测试中，QADR 在特征数达到 $2000$ 时仍能成功运行（此时传统全局 VQC 已因内存耗尽崩溃），且其性能匹配或超越了优化的经典架构（如 SVM、CANN 和 PMNN）。
AI.conclusion: QADR 展现出优异的可扩展性，成功解决了标准全局 VQC 在高维特征下因内存耗尽而崩溃的问题，同时在实际诊断和分类任务中提供与优化经典架构相当或更优的性能，为 NISQ 时代的量子机器学习提供了一种高效且可训练的替代方案。
AI.translation: 在嘈杂中等规模量子（NISQ）约束下训练变分量子电路（VQC）会引入严重的计算限制：经典态矢量模拟内存呈指数级增长（$\mathcal{O}(2^n)$），且全局成本函数会遭遇梯度方差指数级衰减（$\mathcal{O}(1/2^n)$）的贫瘠高原问题。本文介绍并评估了分布式纠缠减少量子算法（QADR），这是一种混合量子-经典机器学习框架，它将全局 $n$ 量子比特 VQC 分解为在单个目标量子比特的因果光锥内近似运行的局部子电路。对于光锥半径 $d$，QADR 将经典模拟内存缩放从 $\mathcal{O}(2^n)$ 降低到 $\mathcal{O}(n \cdot 2^{2d+1})$，同时自然地缓解了全局贫瘠高原。我们在 MNIST 数据集和高维 NASA IMS 风力发电机传动系统诊断任务上，将 QADR 与标准全局 VQC、支持向量机（SVM）以及两种定制的经典参数匹配神经网络（CANN 和 PMNN）进行了基准测试。QADR 展示了极佳的可扩展性，在特征数 $n_{\text{features}}=2000$（标准全局 VQC 因内存耗尽而崩溃）时成功运行，同时匹配或超越了优化经典架构的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 QADR 的新型混合量子-经典机器学习框架，旨在解决 NISQ 时代变分量子电路（VQC）训练中的高内存消耗和贫瘠高原问题。通过将全局 VQC 分解为基于因果光锥的局部子电路，该框架成功将经典模拟内存复杂度降至多项式级，并在高维实际任务中展示了极佳的可扩展性和出色的性能。
AI.keywords: 量子机器学习, 变分量子电路, 经典模拟, 贫瘠高原, 因果光锥
AI.comments: 该论文创新地利用因果光锥（causal light cones）的概念将全局量子电路本地化，巧妙地绕过了量子模拟中指数级内存增长和贫瘠高原的屏障。这对于在经典硬件上进行大规模量子机器学习算法的开发和测试具有重要的实用价值。然而，这种将全局纠缠简化为局部子电路的方法是否会牺牲某些全局量子优势，在更复杂的量子任务中是否依然有效，仍需进一步研究。

title: ResNet-34 with Lightweight Decoder for Accurate and Efficient Segmentation of Fetal Brain MRI
summary: Accurate segmentation of fetal brain tissues in Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is critical for early diagnosis of congenital abnormalities and improving prenatal care. However, the task remains difficult because of fetal motion, low tissue contrast, and major anatomical variability throughout gestational ages, particularly in segmenting complex structures such as white matter, gray matter, lateral ventricles, deep gray matter, extra-cerebrospinal fluid, cerebellum, and brainstem. As a solution to these difficulties, this research introduces a novel deep learning model that combines a ResNet-34 encoder with a lightweight decoder leveraging multi-layer perceptron (MLP) modules for adaptive feature refinement. This design specifically enhances the model's ability to preserve anatomical boundaries and mitigate segmentation errors caused by motion artifacts and intensity inhomogeneities. Computational efficiency is achieved by reducing parameter count, employing bilinear upsampling instead of transposed convolutions, and optimizing the decoder for speed without sacrificing accuracy. Trained and validated on the FeTA 2021 dataset using 5-fold cross-validation, the proposed model outperforms baseline architectures such as UNet, UNet++, DeepLabV3, and DeepLabV3+, achieving an average Accuracy of 97.37% with a mean Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) of 90.33%, mean Intersection over Union (IoU) of 86.93%, and Precision of 90.83%. Additionally, its fast inference time and reduced computational load make it well-suited for integration into real-time clinical workflows.

AI.title_translation: 用于胎儿脑部MRI精确高效分割的ResNet-34与轻量级解码器模型
AI.tldr: 提出一种高效的ResNet-34与轻量级解码器网络，显著提升了胎儿脑部MRI分割的精度，并满足临床实时应用需求。
AI.motivation: 胎儿脑部MRI受胎儿运动、组织对比度低及解剖结构变异性大等因素影响，分割难度高，且现有模型在计算效率与精度之间难以平衡。
AI.method: 提出了一种结合ResNet-34编码器与包含多层感知机（MLP）模块的轻量级解码器的新型深度学习架构，采用双线性上采样替代转置卷积以降低参数量。
AI.result: 在FeTA 2021数据集上，模型平均准确率达97.37%，平均Dice系数为90.33%，平均IoU为86.93%，精度为90.83%，性能优于UNet、UNet++等基准架构。
AI.conclusion: 该模型在胎儿脑部MRI分割任务中表现优异，在保持高精度的同时实现了高效的计算性能，非常适合集成到临床工作流程中。
AI.translation: 胎儿脑部磁共振成像（MRI）的精确分割对于先天性异常的早期诊断和改善产前护理至关重要。然而，由于胎儿运动、组织对比度低以及整个孕期解剖结构的高度变异性，该任务仍然困难重重，特别是在分割白质、灰质、侧脑室、深部灰质、脑外脑脊液、小脑和脑干等复杂结构时。为了解决这些困难，本研究引入了一种结合ResNet-34编码器和利用多层感知机（MLP）模块进行自适应特征细化的轻量级解码器的新型深度学习模型。该设计专门增强了模型保留解剖边界的能力，并减轻了由运动伪影和强度不均匀性引起的分割错误。通过减少参数数量、采用双线性上采样而非转置卷积，以及在不牺牲精度的情况下优化解码器速度，实现了计算效率的提升。该模型在FeTA 2021数据集上使用5折交叉验证进行了训练和验证，其性能优于UNet、UNet++、DeepLabV3和DeepLabV3+等基准架构，平均准确率达到97.37%，平均Dice相似系数（DSC）为90.33%，平均交并比（IoU）为86.93%，精度为90.83%。此外，其快速的推理时间和降低的计算负载使其非常适合集成到实时临床工作流程中。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于ResNet-34编码器和轻量级MLP解码器的胎儿脑部MRI分割模型。该方法通过优化特征细化过程和减少参数，有效提升了在复杂解剖结构分割中的精度与计算效率。
AI.keywords: 胎儿脑部MRI, 图像分割, ResNet-34, 轻量级解码器, 深度学习
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地平衡了深度学习模型在医学影像分析中的精度与效率问题。通过引入轻量级解码器和MLP模块，不仅解决了胎儿脑部MRI中常见的运动伪影和对比度低的问题，还显著降低了计算开销，为临床实时应用提供了切实可行的解决方案。

title: A Communication-Centric 6G-LLM Architecture for Scalable Tactical Autonomous Defense Vehicle Networks
comments: 10 pages, accepted in IEEE Network Magazine
summary: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and emerging 6G networks introduces new opportunities for scalable coordination in tactical autonomous vehicle systems. This paper proposes a communication-centric hierarchical architecture for Tactical Autonomous Defense Vehicle Networks (TADVNs) that models the integration of edge-assisted Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning with 6G-enabled connectivity and semantic communication. The framework is designed to improve coordination efficiency, reduce communication overhead, and enhance latency resilience under increasing fleet-scale operation. Unlike conventional task-specific AI pipelines that rely on structured feature processing and rule-based coordination, the proposed approach incorporates semantic abstraction and context-aware decision support within a layered edge-cloud communication architecture. We evaluate communication and coordination performance via Monte Carlo simulations across fleet sizes of 5-30 vehicles under contested network conditions. Results indicate that at a 30-vehicle scale, the 6G-LLM configuration achieves 75.2% latency reduction (29.1 ms vs. 117.5 ms), a 68.7 percentage point increase in mission success rate (82.9% vs. 14.2%), and an 88.6% reduction in communication overhead compared to a 5G-based conventional AI baseline. These findings demonstrate measurable benefits in coordination and communication when semantic reasoning is combined with low-latency 6G connectivity.
comment: 10 pages, accepted in IEEE Network Magazine

AI.title_translation: 一种面向可扩展战术自动防御车辆网络的以通信为中心的6G-LLM架构
AI.tldr: 提出了一种集成LLM推理与6G语义通信的架构，显著提升了战术自动驾驶车辆网络在大规模协同下的通信效率、延迟表现及任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决大规模战术自动驾驶车辆网络（TADVNs）在复杂战术环境下，传统AI流水线面临的协调效率低、通信开销大以及延迟受限的问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种以通信为中心的层次化架构，将边缘辅助的大语言模型（LLM）推理与6G使能的连接及语义通信进行集成，并采用分层边缘云架构进行语义抽象和上下文感知的决策支持。
AI.result: 在30辆车的规模下，与基于5G的传统AI基准相比，该架构实现了75.2%的延迟降低（29.1ms vs 117.5ms），任务成功率提升了68.7个百分点（82.9% vs 14.2%），并减少了88.6%的通信开销。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明，该通信中心化的6G-LLM架构在处理大规模车辆协同任务时，能显著降低延迟并大幅提升任务成功率，为战术防御车辆网络提供了高效的解决方案。
AI.translation: 人工智能（AI）与新兴6G网络的融合为战术自动驾驶车辆系统的可扩展协调带来了新机遇。本文提出了一种用于战术自动防御车辆网络（TADVNs）的以通信为中心的层次化架构，该架构对边缘辅助的大语言模型（LLM）推理与6G使能的连接及语义通信的集成进行了建模。该框架旨在提高协调效率、减少通信开销，并增强在不断增加的车队规模运行下的延迟弹性。与依赖结构化特征处理和基于规则协调的传统特定任务AI流水线不同，本方法在分层边缘云通信架构中结合了语义抽象和上下文感知决策支持。我们通过蒙特卡洛模拟，在竞争网络条件下对5至30辆车的车队规模进行了通信和协调性能评估。结果表明，在30辆车的规模下，6G-LLM配置相比基于5G的传统AI基准，实现了75.2%的延迟降低（29.1毫秒 vs 117.5毫秒），任务成功率提高了68.7个百分点（82.9% vs 14.2%），通信开销减少了88.6%。这些发现证明了当语义推理与低延迟6G连接相结合时，在协调和通信方面具有显著的效益。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于战术自动防御车辆网络（TADVNs）的通信中心化6G-LLM架构，通过集成边缘辅助的LLM推理与6G语义通信，实现了高效的车辆协同，在提升大规模网络运行效率的同时显著降低了延迟与通信负担。
AI.keywords: 6G, 大语言模型 (LLM), 战术自动防御车辆网络 (TADVNs), 语义通信, 可扩展性
AI.comments: 该研究通过将语义通信与大语言模型（LLM）推理相结合，解决了战术自动驾驶车辆网络在复杂、受限环境下的可扩展性问题。其创新点在于引入了通信中心化的分层架构，通过语义抽象显著降低了通信开销并提升了决策效率，是未来6G网络与智能体协同领域的重要探索。

title: Limit Continuous Poker: A Variant of Continuous Poker with Limited Bet Sizes
summary: We introduce and analyze Limit Continuous Poker, a variant of Von Neumann's Continuous Poker with variable but limited bet sizes. This simplified variant of poker captures aspects of information asymmetry, bluffing, balancing, and the impact of bet size limits while still being simple enough to solve analytically. We derive the Nash equilibrium strategy profile for this game, showing how the bettor's and caller's strategies depend on the bet size limits. We demonstrate that as the bet size limits approach extreme values, the strategy profile converges to those of other continuous poker variants. Finally, we connect these results to strategic implications of limited bet sizing in real-world poker.

AI.title_translation: 限制连续扑克：一种具有有限下注大小的连续扑克变体
AI.tldr: 本文引入并分析了限制连续扑克，一种具有有限下注大小的连续扑克变体，通过分析求解其纳什均衡策略，并探讨了下注大小限制的战略影响。
AI.motivation: 研究一种简化的扑克变体，以捕捉信息不对称、虚张声势、平衡以及下注大小限制的影响，同时仍能进行分析求解。
AI.method: 引入并分析了“限制连续扑克”，通过分析推导出该游戏的纳什均衡策略。
AI.result: 导出了该游戏的纳什均衡策略，表明下注者和跟注者的策略取决于下注大小限制。当bet size limits接近极端值时，策略剖面收敛到其他连续扑克变体。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了有限下注大小在现实扑克中的战略含义。
AI.translation: 我们引入并分析了限制连续扑克，这是冯·诺依依曼连续扑克的一种变体，具有可变但有限的下注大小。这种简化的扑克变体捕捉了信息不对称、虚张声势、平衡以及下注大小限制的影响，同时又足够简单，可以进行分析求解。我们推导了该游戏的纳什均衡策略组合，展示了下注者和跟注者的策略如何依赖于下注大小限制。我们证明，当下注大小限制接近极端值时，策略组合会收敛到其他连续扑克变体的策略组合。最后，我们将这些结果与现实世界扑克中有限下注大小的战略含义联系起来。
AI.summary: 这篇论文介绍并分析了一种新的扑克变体——限制连续扑克，它在冯·诺依依曼连续扑克的基础上引入了有限的下注大小。研究通过分析方法推导了该游戏的纳什均衡策略，揭示了下注者和跟注者的策略如何受下注大小限制的影响。结果还表明，在极端下注限制下，其策略会趋近于其他连续扑克变体，并探讨了这些发现对现实世界扑克中有限下注策略的战略意义。
AI.keywords: 限制连续扑克, 纳什均衡, 下注大小限制, 游戏理论, 信息不对称
AI.comments: 这项研究通过引入一个简化的连续扑克模型，成功地分析了有限下注大小对策略的影响，这对于理解现实扑克中的决策具有重要意义。其创新之处在于将复杂的游戏理论概念简化并进行分析求解，为后续更复杂模型的构建提供了基础。

title: On the Uncertainty Quantification Ability of Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Foundation models (FMs) have achieved substantial success in generalizing across tasks without problemspecific training or fine-tuning. However, many critical applications in mechanics and computational science require not only accurate predictions but also reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ). Herein we investigate the UQ capabilities of tabular FMs in regression tasks through a comprehensive empirical study comparing Tabular Prior-Data Fitted Networks (TabPFN) against Gaussian processes (GPs). We systematically evaluate these two methods across a host of regression problems with varying complexity, dataset sizes, and input dimensionalities. We use a default setting to build all the GPs and for a fair comparison against TabPFN v2.5. Our findings highlight an important trade-off between explicit and learned priors: while TabPFN achieves highly competitive performance for complex, high-dimensional problems with sufficient data, GPs often provide superior predictive accuracy and UQ in data-scarce settings. Moreover, when the chosen kernel constitutes a good prior for the underlying function, GP performance can substantially exceed that of TabPFN. Our results can be reproduced from https://github.com/kianswarehouse/GPvsPFN.

AI.title_translation: 关于表格基础模型不确定性量化能力的研究
AI.tldr: 研究发现，TabPFN在复杂高维数据上表现优异，但在数据稀缺或具备先验知识的情况下，传统的高斯过程方法在预测精度和不确定性量化方面更具优势。
AI.motivation: 尽管表格基础模型在无需特定微调的情况下表现良好，但在关键应用领域，模型不仅需要准确预测，还需要具备可靠的不确定性量化（UQ）能力，目前对表格基础模型的UQ能力尚缺乏系统性评估。
AI.method: 对TabPFN v2.5与高斯过程（GPs）进行系统性实证对比，通过多项具有不同复杂性、数据集大小和输入维度的回归问题进行评估。
AI.result: TabPFN在复杂、高维且数据充足的问题上具有竞争力；但在数据稀缺时，GPs通常表现更好；若核函数选择得当，GPs的性能可显著优于TabPFN。
AI.conclusion: 在复杂、高维且数据充足的场景下，TabPFN表现出色；但在数据稀缺或存在良好先验知识的场景下，高斯过程（GPs）通常能提供更优的预测精度和不确定性量化能力。
AI.translation: 基础模型（FMs）在无需特定任务训练或微调的情况下，在跨任务泛化方面取得了巨大成功。然而，力学和计算科学中的许多关键应用不仅需要准确的预测，还需要可靠的不确定性量化（UQ）。本文通过一项全面的实证研究，比较了表格先验数据拟合网络（TabPFN）与高斯过程（GPs），探讨了表格FMs在回归任务中的UQ能力。我们针对一系列具有不同复杂性、数据集大小和输入维度的回归问题，对这两种方法进行了系统评估。我们使用默认设置构建所有GP，并与TabPFN v2.5进行了公平比较。我们的研究结果突显了显式先验与学习先验之间的重要权衡：虽然TabPFN在数据充足的复杂、高维问题上表现出极强的竞争力，但GPs在数据稀缺的情况下通常能提供更优的预测精度和UQ。此外，当所选核函数构成了底层函数的良好先验时，GP的性能可以显著超过TabPFN。我们的结果可在 https://github.com/kianswarehouse/GPvsPFN 获取。
AI.summary: 本文系统评估了表格基础模型（TabPFN）在回归任务中的不确定性量化能力，并将其与高斯过程进行了对比，分析了两者在不同数据集规模和复杂度下的性能差异及权衡。
AI.keywords: 表格基础模型, 不确定性量化, 高斯过程, 回归任务, TabPFN
AI.comments: 该研究通过对比新兴的表格基础模型（TabPFN）与经典的统计学方法（高斯过程），揭示了在不同数据规模和复杂度下不确定性量化的权衡，为表格数据分析中模型选择提供了实证指导。局限性在于研究仅限于回归任务，且对高斯过程核函数的依赖性较强。

title: Spatially Distributed Task-Oriented Compression for Multi-Emitter Localization and Characterization with Spectral Overlap
summary: Radio frequency spectrum awareness requires the ability to detect, localize, and characterize emitters in dense and contested wireless environments. In this work, we propose a task-oriented distributed compression framework for joint multi-emitter localization and characterization using spatially distributed receivers. Each receiver observes a short window of complex IQ samples, converts the observation to a time--frequency representation, and encodes it into a compact latent vector. A central fusion decoder combines the receiver latents to estimate an unordered set of active emitters, including their locations, center-frequency offsets, occupied bandwidths, and waveform families. A permutation-invariant training objective is used to handle the arbitrary ordering of emitters and predictions. Experiments on synthetic multi-emitter scenes with spectral overlap show that even extremely compact receiver-side representations can preserve useful information for emitter counting and waveform-family estimation. However, accurate localization and spectral-parameter regression require larger latent dimensions. Increasing the receiver latent dimension from $d_{\mathrm{rx}}=1$ to $d_{\mathrm{rx}}=16$ provides the largest improvement, while further increasing to $d_{\mathrm{rx}}=64$ gives smaller gains. These results demonstrate the potential of learned task-oriented compression for communication-efficient distributed spectrum awareness.

AI.title_translation: 具有频谱重叠的多发射器定位和表征的空间分布式任务导向压缩
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于多发射器定位和表征的任务导向分布式压缩框架，利用空间分布式接收器以紧凑的潜在向量形式编码观测数据，并通过中央融合解码器估计发射器参数。实验表明，即使是极紧凑的表示也能保留有用信息，但精确的定位和频谱参数回归需要更大的潜在维度。
AI.motivation: 在密集和竞争的无线环境中，射频频谱感知需要能够检测、定位和表征发射器。
AI.method: 提出了一种任务导向的分布式压缩框架，用于联合多发射器定位和表征。每个接收器观察复数IQ样本的短窗口，转换为时频表示，并编码为紧凑的潜在向量。中央融合解码器结合接收器潜在向量，估计无序的活跃发射器集合，包括其位置、中心频率偏移、占用带宽和波形族。使用置换不变训练目标来处理发射器和预测的任意排序。
AI.result: 在具有频谱重叠的合成多发射器场景上的实验表明，即使是极其紧凑的接收器侧表示也能保留用于发射器计数和波形族估计的有用信息。然而，精确的定位和频谱参数回归需要更大的潜在维度。将接收器潜在维度从 $d_{\mathrm{rx}}=1$ 增加到 $d_{\mathrm{rx}}=16$ 提供了最大的改进，而进一步增加到 $d_{\mathrm{rx}}=64$ 带来的增益较小。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果证明了学习到的任务导向压缩在通信高效分布式频谱感知方面的潜力。
AI.translation: 射频频谱感知需要能够在密集和竞争的无线环境中检测、定位和表征发射器。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种任务导向的分布式压缩框架，用于使用空间分布式接收器进行联合多发射器定位和表征。每个接收器观察复数IQ样本的短窗口，将观测数据转换为时频表示，并将其编码为紧凑的潜在向量。中央融合解码器结合接收器潜在向量，以估计一组无序的活跃发射器，包括它们的位置、中心频率偏移、占用带宽和波形族。使用置换不变训练目标来处理发射器和预测的任意排序。在具有频谱重叠的合成多发射器场景上的实验表明，即使是极其紧凑的接收器侧表示也能保留用于发射器计数和波形族估计的有用信息。然而，精确的定位和频谱参数回归需要更大的潜在维度。将接收器潜在维度从 $d_{\mathrm{rx}}=1$ 增加到 $d_{\mathrm{rx}}=16$ 提供了最大的改进，而进一步增加到 $d_{\mathrm{rx}}=64$ 带来的增益较小。这些结果证明了学习到的任务导向压缩在通信高效分布式频谱感知方面的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于多发射器定位和表征的分布式任务导向压缩框架，以解决密集无线环境中的频谱感知问题。该框架利用空间分布式接收器将观测数据编码为紧凑的潜在向量，并通过中央解码器融合这些向量来估计发射器的位置、频率、带宽和波形族。实验结果表明，尽管极小的潜在维度足以进行发射器计数和波形族估计，但精确的定位和频谱参数回归需要更大的潜在维度，尤其是在将维度从1增加到16时效果显著。这展示了任务导向压缩在提高分布式频谱感知通信效率方面的潜力。
AI.keywords: 任务导向压缩, 多发射器定位, 频谱感知, 分布式接收器, 潜在向量
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的任务导向分布式压缩框架，创新性在于将压缩与特定任务（多发射器定位和表征）相结合，并通过置换不变训练处理多目标识别问题。其重要性在于能够显著提高分布式频谱感知的通信效率，特别是在资源受限的边缘计算或分布式传感网络中具有应用潜力。局限性可能在于其在真实复杂环境下的泛化能力和对不同信号类型的适应性，以及潜在维度选择对性能的权衡。

title: FlexLink: Decoupling Control and Data Beams for Next-Generation Wideband Networks
summary: The next generation of 6G networks aims to utilize ultra-wideband spectrum and massive antenna arrays to serve multiple users with both control and data channels at low latency and high efficiency. However, phased arrays at mmWave and mid-bands are fundamentally constrained to a single beam or suffer sharp beamforming loss when split across directions, limiting simultaneous control-data support. In FlexLink, we introduce and prototype a novel delay-phased array architecture that overcomes this limitation by redistributing energy jointly across frequency and space, enabling multiple narrow beams without sacrificing per-beam gain or requiring additional power. We design and prototype FlexLink on a custom 4-7 GHz hardware testbed, demonstrating for the first time that control and data beams can be decoupled in practice, achieving nearly double spectral efficiency compared to conventional phased arrays.

AI.title_translation: FlexLink：解耦控制和数据波束，面向下一代宽带网络
AI.tldr: FlexLink提出了一种新的延迟相位阵列架构，通过联合跨频率和空间重新分配能量，实现了在不牺牲每束增益或需要额外功率的情况下，在同一频率上支持多个窄波束，从而将控制和数据波束解耦，并将频谱效率提高近一倍。
AI.motivation: 下一代6G网络旨在利用超宽带频谱和海量天线阵列，以低延迟和高效率为多个用户提供控制和数据通道。然而，毫米波和中频段的相位阵列在本质上被限制为单个波束，或者在跨方向分裂时会遭受急剧的波束形成损失，这限制了同时支持控制和数据的能力。
AI.method: FlexLink引入并原型化了一种新颖的延迟相位阵列架构，通过联合跨频率和空间重新分配能量来克服这一限制，从而在不牺牲每束增益或需要额外功率的情况下实现多个窄波束。
AI.result: 在自定义的4-7 GHz硬件测试台上设计和原型化FlexLink，首次证明了控制和数据波束可以在实践中解耦，与传统的相位阵列相比，频谱效率几乎提高了一倍。
AI.conclusion: FlexLink成功地将控制和数据波束解耦，并通过其新颖的延迟相位阵列架构实现了近乎翻倍的频谱效率，为下一代宽带网络铺平了道路。
AI.translation: 下一代6G网络旨在利用超宽带频谱和海量天线阵列，以低延迟和高效率为多个用户提供控制和数据通道。然而，毫米波和中频段的相位阵列在本质上被限制为单个波束，或者在跨方向分裂时会遭受急剧的波束形成损失，这限制了同时支持控制和数据的能力。在FlexLink中，我们引入并原型化了一种新颖的延迟相位阵列架构，通过联合跨频率和空间重新分配能量来克服这一限制，从而在不牺牲每束增益或需要额外功率的情况下实现多个窄波束。我们在自定义的4-7 GHz硬件测试台上设计和原型化FlexLink，首次证明了控制和数据波束可以在实践中解耦，与传统的相位阵列相比，频谱效率几乎提高了一倍。
AI.summary: FlexLink提出了一种新颖的延迟相位阵列架构，通过联合跨频率和空间重新分配能量，克服了传统相位阵列在同时支持控制和数据波束方面的限制。该架构能够在不牺牲每束增益或增加功耗的情况下实现多个窄波束，并在4-7 GHz硬件测试台上进行了原型化和验证，结果表明其频谱效率几乎是传统相位阵列的两倍。
AI.keywords: FlexLink, 延迟相位阵列, 控制-数据解耦, 宽带网络, 频谱效率
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的延迟相位阵列架构，解决了下一代宽带网络中控制和数据波束的解耦问题，实现了显著的性能提升。原型验证的成功表明了该方法的实用性和潜力。然而，文章未提及该架构在实际部署中的成本效益和可扩展性。

title: Computation-Aware Kalman Filtering with Model Selection for Neural Dynamics
comments: 24 pages, Proceedings of 2nd International Conference on Probabilistic Numerics (2026)
summary: Due to their explicit priors and ability to model uncertainty, Bayesian methods have played a major role in dynamical latent variable modeling of single-cell neural recordings. However, modern-sized datasets have made overparameterized deep networks the preferred methods of choice due to their predictive power and favorable computational scaling. While many posterior approximations exist, all incur approximation errors. Recent work accounts for this error in the form of computational uncertainty but comes at the cost of quadratic complexity and assumes fixed model hyperparameters. Here we extend this development to model selection, including a novel training loss and optimization scheme, which yields tractable inference in large state-spaces. We introduce a framework, the Computation-Aware State-Space Model (CASSM), specifically designed for the scale-imbalanced regime, where the number of trials is significantly lower than the number of recorded neurons. In this regime, for both synthetic and real data, we show that our method is competitive with data-hungry deep networks, with significantly improved uncertainty calibration over previous attempts to scale Bayesian methods. Our experiments provide a roadmap to neuroscience researchers in choosing from a host of potential dynamical latent variable models given key dataset properties and constraints.

AI.title_translation: 面向神经网络动力学的计算感知卡尔曼滤波与模型选择
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为CASSM的计算感知状态空间模型，用于处理大规模神经记录数据，特别是在试验数量远少于神经元数量的情况下。该模型通过引入计算不确定性并结合模型选择，实现了可处理的推理，并在合成和真实数据上均表现出与深度网络相当的预测能力和更优的置信度校准。
AI.motivation: 现有贝叶斯方法在处理大规模神经记录数据时面临计算复杂度和超参数固定的问题，而深度网络虽然计算效率高但存在近似误差。需要一种既能处理大规模数据又能准确估计不确定性的方法。
AI.method: 提出计算感知状态空间模型（CASSM）框架，引入新的训练损失和优化方案，以实现大规模状态空间的可行推理，特别适用于试验数量远少于神经元数量的“尺度不平衡”情况。
AI.result: 在合成和真实数据上，CASSM方法在预测能力上与数据饥渴型深度网络相当，同时显著提高了不确定性校准能力，优于先前尝试扩展贝叶斯方法规模的尝试。
AI.conclusion: CASSM框架为神经科学研究者提供了一个在给定数据集特性和约束条件下，从多种潜在动力学潜在变量模型中进行选择的路线图。
AI.translation: 由于其明确的先验和对不确定性建模的能力，贝叶斯方法在单细胞神经记录的动力学潜在变量建模中发挥了重要作用。然而，现代规模的数据集使得过参数化的深度网络因其预测能力和有利的计算扩展性而成为首选方法。虽然存在许多后验近似方法，但所有方法都会产生近似误差。最近的研究以计算不确定性的形式解释了这种误差，但其代价是二次复杂度并假设固定的模型超参数。在这里，我们将这一发展扩展到模型选择，包括一种新颖的训练损失和优化方案，从而在大状态空间中实现可处理的推理。我们引入了一个专门为尺度不平衡设计的框架，即计算感知状态空间模型（CASSM），其中试验数量远低于记录的神经元数量。在该状态下，对于合成和真实数据，我们表明我们的方法与数据饥渴型深度网络相比具有竞争力，并且在先前尝试扩展贝叶斯方法方面具有显著提高的不确定性校准能力。我们的实验为神经科学研究者提供了一个路线图，用于根据关键的数据集属性和约束条件，从众多潜在的动力学潜在变量模型中进行选择。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为计算感知状态空间模型（CASSM）的新框架，用于处理大规模神经记录数据。CASSM通过整合计算不确定性并引入模型选择机制，解决了传统贝叶斯方法在处理大规模数据时面临的计算瓶颈和超参数固定的问题。该方法特别适用于试验数量远少于神经元数量的“尺度不平衡”场景，并在合成和真实数据实验中证明了其在预测能力上可与深度网络媲美，同时在不确定性校准方面表现更优。此外，该研究为神经科学家提供了选择动力学潜在变量模型的指导。
AI.keywords: 计算感知, 卡尔曼滤波, 模型选择, 神经网络动力学, 状态空间模型
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地结合了贝叶斯方法的优势（如明确的先验和不确定性建模）与深度学习的计算效率，特别是在处理大规模、尺度不平衡的神经数据方面取得了显著进展。引入计算不确定性和模型选择是该方法的创新之处，为解决实际神经科学问题提供了有价值的工具。然而，模型的具体计算复杂度以及在更广泛的模型类别的泛化能力仍有待进一步探索。

title: Emergent Transfer of a Physics Foundation Model from Simulation to Laboratory Turbulence
summary: Whether physics foundation models can be usefully deployed on laboratory experiments remains an open question for scientific machine learning (ML). We test this question on the Rayleigh-Taylor instability (RTI), a ubiquitous and demanding fluid instability seen from tabletop flows to supernova explosions, in which small perturbations at a density interface grow into chaotic, multiscale mixing as a lighter fluid accelerates into a heavier one. Standard ML models struggle with RTI, and despite over a century of theoretical, numerical, and experimental work, it carries an unresolved discrepancy between simulation and experiment: the late-time mixing growth rate, $α$, measured in most laboratory experiments ($\sim$ 0.06-0.07), is roughly three times the value from idealized direct numerical simulations (DNS, $\sim$ 0.02). The gap's origin remains debated. These properties make RTI a stringent test for a question that matters well beyond RTI: can foundation models trained only on simulations generalise to sparse, messy, and noisy laboratory settings? We finetune Walrus, a foundation model for continuum dynamics, on three or fewer DNS realizations and recover key RTI physics over long rollouts. Applied zero-shot to sliding-barrier laboratory data, the finetuned model leaves the DNS-like regime and enters the observed growth band, having never seen a single experimental sample. These results provide independent, data-driven evidence that initial conditions play a crucial role in the longstanding sim-experiment gap in $α$. The model also generalises zero-shot to stable stratification, a buoyancy regime absent from training, correctly slowing mixing-layer growth. Together, our results show that foundation models can generalise well beyond their training data, predicting laboratory behavior and unseen physical regimes, opening new ways to probe longstanding simulation-experiment gaps.

AI.title_translation: 物理基础模型从模拟到实验室湍流的涌现式迁移
AI.tldr: 该研究首次展示了物理基础模型（Walrus）可以从模拟数据迁移到真实的实验室湍流（瑞利-泰勒不稳定性），并在未见过的数据上进行零样本预测，解决了长期存在的模拟与实验之间的差异问题，并证明了基础模型可以泛化到训练数据之外的物理场景。
AI.motivation: 科学机器学习领域的一个关键问题是物理基础模型能否有效地应用于实验室实验。瑞利-泰勒不稳定性（RTI）因其普遍性、复杂性以及模拟与实验之间长期存在的差异（混合增长率差异约三倍）而成为一个理想的测试场景。
AI.method: 研究人员对一个名为Walrus的连续动力学基础模型进行了微调，仅使用了三组或更少的直接数值模拟（DNS）数据。然后，将微调后的模型应用于实验室的RTI数据，并进行了零样本预测。此外，模型还被应用于稳定的分层流体场景，该场景在训练数据中不存在。
AI.result: 微调后的Walrus模型能够重现RTI的关键物理现象。当应用于实验室数据时，模型能够从DNS相似的区域迁移到实验观测到的增长带，即使从未见过任何实验数据。模型还能够准确预测稳定分层流体中混合层的增长减缓现象，该现象在训练数据中并未出现。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，物理基础模型能够很好地泛化到其训练数据之外的场景，能够预测实验室的行为，甚至在未曾见过的物理条件下也能做出预测。这为解决长期存在的模拟与实验之间的差距提供了一种新的途径，并证明了在模拟中训练的模型可以成功应用于真实的实验环境。
AI.translation: 物理基础模型能否在实验室实验中得到有效部署，这对于科学机器学习来说仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。我们在瑞利-泰勒不稳定性（RTI）上测试了这个问题，RTI是一种普遍存在且要求很高的流体失稳现象，从桌面级流体到超新星爆发中都能看到，其中密度界面的微小扰动会增长成混乱的、多尺度的混合，这是因为较轻的流体加速进入较重的流体。标准的机器学习模型在RTI方面存在困难，尽管经过了一个多世纪的理论、数值和实验研究，但它仍然存在一个未解决的模拟与实验之间的差异：在大多数实验室实验中测得的后期混合增长率$\(alpha\)$（约0.06-0.07）大约是理想化直接数值模拟（DNS，约0.02）的三倍。这种差距的起源仍然存在争议。这些特性使得RTI成为一个严格的测试，用于检验一个远远超出RTI本身的问题：仅在模拟上训练的基础模型能否泛化到稀疏、混乱和嘈杂的实验室环境？我们对连续动力学的基础模型Walrus进行了微调，仅使用了三组或更少的DNS实现，并在长期的演化中恢复了RTI的关键物理现象。当对滑动壁面实验室数据进行零样本应用时，微调后的模型离开了DNS相似的区域，进入了观测到的增长带，尽管它从未见过任何单一的实验样本。这些结果提供了独立的、由数据驱动的证据，表明初始条件在长期存在的$\(alpha\)$的模拟-实验差距中起着至关重要的作用。该模型还能对稳定分层（一种不存在于训练中的浮力状态）进行零样本泛化，正确地减缓了混合层的增长。总而言之，我们的结果表明，基础模型能够很好地泛化到其训练数据之外，预测实验室行为和未知的物理状态，为探测长期存在的模拟-实验差距开辟了新的途径。
AI.summary: 本研究首次成功地将一个为连续动力学设计的物理基础模型（Walrus）从模拟环境迁移到真实的实验室湍流（瑞利-泰勒不稳定性）场景。通过对模型进行少量模拟数据的微调，研究人员发现该模型能够准确预测实验室中的流体混合行为，并解决了长期存在的模拟与实验数据之间约三倍的增长率差异。更重要的是，模型在未曾见过实验数据的情况下，也能泛化到训练数据中不存在的稳定分层流体场景，准确预测了混合层增长减缓的现象。这证明了物理基础模型具有强大的泛化能力，能够有效弥合模拟与现实之间的差距，为科学研究提供了新的工具。
AI.keywords: 物理基础模型, 瑞利-泰勒不稳定性, 模拟-实验差距, 迁移学习, 零样本预测
AI.comments: 这项研究在科学机器学习领域具有重要意义，它首次证明了物理基础模型可以从纯模拟数据成功迁移到真实的、嘈杂的实验室环境中，并解决了瑞利-泰勒不稳定性中长期存在的模拟与实验之间的差异问题。模型能够进行零样本预测，甚至泛化到训练数据中未包含的物理场景，这凸显了其强大的泛化能力。然而，研究的局限性在于仅使用了三种流体不稳定性作为测试场景，未来的研究可以探索其在更广泛、更复杂的物理系统中的应用。此外，尽管模型能够预测实验结果，但对差异根源的深入理解仍有待进一步研究。

title: Global Convergence of a Line-Search Filter Differential Dynamic Programming Method
summary: In this article, we establish the global convergence properties of the FilterDDP algorithm, which extends the discrete-time differential dynamic programming (DDP) algorithm of Mayne and Jacobson [\emph{International Journal of Control}, 3, (1966), pp. 85-95] to handle nonlinear constraints over states and controls, in addition to the dynamics. FilterDDP adopts a line-search filter procedure for step acceptance. However, instead of a damped Newton step applied in the general nonlinear programming setting, the computation of a trial point involves applying a backward recursion and a forward simulation. We establish the global convergence of FilterDDP by showing that for a subset of constrained optimal control problems, the this backward-forward procedure satisfies the same properties as a Newton step for the purpose of establishing global convergence of a line-search filter method, following the analysis of Wächter and Biegler [\emph{SIAM Journal on Optimization}, 16 (2005), pp. 1-31].

AI.title_translation: 一种线搜索滤波器差分动态规划方法的全局收敛性
AI.tldr: 本文从理论上证明了FilterDDP算法在处理带约束最优控制问题时的全局收敛性。
AI.motivation: 现有的离散时间差分动态规划（DDP）方法在处理状态和控制约束方面存在局限，需要通过滤波器方法扩展其能力，并从理论上验证其全局收敛性。
AI.method: 采用线搜索滤波器（line-search filter）程序进行步长选择，并利用反向递归和前向模拟构成的特定过程替代通用非线性规划中的阻尼牛顿步，通过类比Wächter和Biegler的分析框架证明其收敛性。
AI.result: 证明了FilterDDP在处理一类约束最优控制问题时，其反向-前向计算过程满足全局收敛所需的牛顿步属性。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功证明了FilterDDP算法在特定约束最优控制问题下的全局收敛性，验证了该算法作为一种高效求解器的理论可行性。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们确立了FilterDDP算法的全局收敛性，该算法扩展了Mayne和Jacobson[International Journal of Control, 3, (1966), pp. 85-95]提出的离散时间差分动态规划(DDP)算法，以处理除了动力学之外的状态和控制上的非线性约束。FilterDDP采用线搜索滤波器程序进行步长接受。然而，与通用非线性规划设置中采用的阻尼牛顿步不同，其试验点的计算涉及应用反向递归和前向模拟。我们通过证明对于一部分约束最优控制问题，这种反向-前向过程满足与线搜索滤波器方法全局收敛性目的相同的牛顿步属性，从而确立了FilterDDP的全局收敛性，该分析遵循了Wächter和Biegler[SIAM Journal on Optimization, 16 (2005), pp. 1-31]的研究。
AI.summary: 本文研究了FilterDDP算法的全局收敛性，该算法将滤波器线搜索机制引入差分动态规划中，以处理带约束的非线性最优控制问题。通过证明其反向-前向过程在特定条件下等同于非线性规划中的牛顿步，确立了该算法的全局收敛理论基础。
AI.keywords: FilterDDP, 全局收敛性, 最优控制, 非线性约束, 滤波器方法
AI.comments: 该研究在理论上填补了FilterDDP算法全局收敛性证明的空白，通过将非线性规划中的滤波器方法与最优控制中的DDP算法相结合，为解决带约束的最优控制问题提供了更具鲁棒性的理论保障。

title: Scalable Counterfactual Risk Estimation for Rare Events in Longitudinal Data
summary: Estimating the causal effect of time-varying treatments on survival outcomes in large observational studies is computationally demanding, particularly when outcomes are rare. While g-formula-based methods such as the iterative conditional expectation (ICE) estimator provide a principled framework for longitudinal causal inference, they become computationally expensive, especially when bootstrap-based variance estimation is required. In addition, outcome rarity at each time point induces severe class imbalance, leading to instability and convergence issues in logistic regression and related models. To address these challenges, we propose a principled subsampling and reweighting strategy for longitudinal survival data that can be applied to a range of existing causal effect estimators in this setting, including the ICE estimator. The proposed method substantially reduces computational burden while preserving consistency and improving estimation stability in rare-outcome settings. We evaluate the method through simulations and validate it using a large-scale EHR cohort study on social and behavioral determinants of health (SBDH) and suicide risk, demonstrating its effectiveness for modeling rare outcomes in longitudinal data.

AI.title_translation: 纵向数据中罕见事件的可扩展反事实风险估计
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新的子抽样和重加权策略，用于处理纵向数据中罕见事件的反事实风险估计问题，通过减少计算负担和提高估计稳定性来解决现有方法的局限性。
AI.motivation: 纵向数据中时间依赖性处理对生存结果的因果效应估计在罕见事件发生时计算成本高且存在类不平衡问题。
AI.method: 提出一种适用于纵向生存数据的子抽样和重加权策略，并将其应用于ICE估计器等现有因果效应估计方法。
AI.result: 该方法显著降低了计算负担，同时保持了估计的一致性，并改善了罕见结局估计的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的子抽样和重加权策略能够有效解决纵向数据中罕见事件的反事实风险估计问题，并在模拟和真实数据集上得到验证。
AI.translation: 估计大型观察性研究中时间依赖性处理对生存结果的因果效应在结果罕见时计算成本很高。虽然基于g公式的方法，如迭代条件期望（ICE）估计器，为纵向因果推断提供了原则性框架，但它们在计算上变得昂贵，特别是当需要基于引导的方差估计时。此外，每个时间点的结局稀疏性会导致严重的类别不平衡，从而导致逻辑回归及相关模型的稳定性和收敛性问题。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种适用于纵向生存数据的原则性子抽样和重加权策略，该策略可应用于该场景下的一系列现有因果效应估计器，包括ICE估计器。所提出的方法在保持一致性和提高罕见结局设定下的估计稳定性的同时，显著降低了计算负担。我们通过模拟评估了该方法，并通过一项关于社会和行为健康决定因素（SBDH）与自杀风险的大规模电子健康记录队列研究进行了验证，证明了其在纵向数据中对罕见结局进行建模的有效性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的子抽样和重加权策略，用于解决纵向数据中罕见事件的反事实风险估计问题。该方法通过减少计算量和提高估计稳定性，克服了现有基于g公式的方法（如ICE估计器）在处理罕见事件和类别不平衡时的计算瓶颈和收敛问题。研究通过模拟和大规模电子健康记录队列数据验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 反事实风险估计,罕见事件,纵向数据,子抽样,重加权
AI.comments: 该研究提出的子抽样和重加权策略为解决纵向数据中罕见事件的因果推断问题提供了一个有前景的方向，特别是在大规模数据集和高维数据场景下具有重要的应用价值。然而，该策略的具体参数选择和对不同类型罕见事件的普适性仍需进一步探索。

title: Deconstructing the Composite Channel for Beyond Diagonal RIS: Channel Estimation and Beamforming Design
summary: As beyond-diagonal reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (BD-RISs) gain increasing attention in high-frequency wireless communications, accurate and scalable channel-estimation methods become essential. This paper develops a parametric channel-estimation and beamforming framework that deconstructs the composite BD-RIS channel into its generating directional factors, revealing the tensor structure induced jointly by propagation geometry and beyond-diagonal scattering. We propose two tensor-based estimators: Fourth-Order Tucker Channel Estimation (FORTE), which models the partially structured channel as a fourth-order Tucker tensor, and Fourth-Order PARAFAC Channel Estimation (FORPE), which captures the fully structured channel through a fourth-order PARAFAC model. By exploiting partial and full channel geometry, the proposed methods achieve higher estimation accuracy than Least Squares and Block Tucker Kronecker Factorization benchmarks. In particular, FORTE outperforms FORPE due to its more compact representation, attaining an NMSE of about 10^{-4} at 5 dB SNR. In contrast, FORPE provides essentially unique estimates of the composite-channel factor matrices, whereas FORTE identifies their subspaces. The proposed deconstruction also provides a structured representation useful for sensing-oriented parameter extraction and tensor-structured system optimization. Finally, the Tensor Optimization Framework for Beamforming, Combining, and Scattering (TenFormer) achieves spectral efficiency comparable to the benchmark design while significantly reducing computational complexity through parallel tensor-structured optimization.

AI.title_translation: 解构复合信道以实现超越对角RIS：信道估计与波束成形设计
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的框架来估计和利用超越对角可重构智能表面（BD-RIS）的复合信道。它将信道分解为生成方向因子，并提出两种基于张量的方法（FORTE和FORPE）进行信道估计，这两种方法都优于现有基准。FORTE在估计精度方面表现更好，而FORPE则提供更独特的估计。该方法还通过TenFormer框架实现了具有竞争力的谱效率和更低的计算复杂度。
AI.motivation: 随着BD-RIS在无线通信中越来越受关注，需要精确且可扩展的信道估计方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种参数化信道估计和波束成形框架，将复合BD-RIS信道分解为生成方向因子，揭示了由传播几何和超越对角散射共同引起的张量结构。提出了两种张量估计器：FORTE（将部分结构化信道建模为四阶Tucker张量）和FORPE（通过四阶PARAFAC模型捕获全结构化信道）。还提出了TenFormer框架用于波束成形、组合和散射。
AI.result: FORTE和FORPE的估计精度高于最小二乘法和块Tucker Kronecker分解基准。FORTE的估计精度比FORPE更高，在5 dB信噪比下达到约10^{-4}的NMSE。FORPE提供复合信道因子矩阵的基本唯一估计，而FORTE识别它们的子空间。TenFormer框架实现了可与基准设计相媲美的谱效率，同时显著降低了计算复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出的信道解构方法不仅提高了信道估计的精度和效率，而且通过TenFormer框架为BD-RIS系统优化提供了新的途径，在保证性能的同时降低了计算复杂度。
AI.translation: 随着超越对角可重构智能表面（BD-RIS）在高频无线通信中受到越来越多的关注，精确且可扩展的信道估计算法变得至关重要。本文开发了一个参数化的信道估计和波束成形框架，该框架将复合BD-RIS信道分解为其生成方向因子，揭示了由传播几何和超越对角散射共同引起的张量结构。我们提出了两种基于张量的方法：四阶Tucker信道估计（FORTE），它将部分结构化信道建模为四阶Tucker张量；以及四阶PARAFAC信道估计（FORPE），它通过四阶PARAFAC模型捕获全结构化信道。通过利用部分和全信道几何，所提出的方法实现了比最小二乘法和块Tucker Kronecker分解基准更高估计精度。特别是，FORTE由于其更紧凑的表示而优于FORPE，在5 dB信噪比下达到了约10^{-4}的NMSE。相比之下，FORPE提供了复合信道因子矩阵的基本唯一估计，而FORTE则识别它们的子空间。所提出的分解还提供了一种有用的结构化表示，用于面向感知的参数提取和张量结构系统优化。最后，用于波束成形、组合和散射的张量优化框架（TenFormer）实现了与基准设计相当的谱效率，同时通过并行张量结构优化显著降低了计算复杂度。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的框架，用于解构和估计超越对角可重构智能表面（BD-RIS）的复合信道。通过将信道分解为方向因子并利用其张量结构，研究者开发了两种先进的信道估计方法：FORTE和FORPE。实验结果表明，这两种方法在精度上优于现有技术，其中FORTE在NMSE方面表现尤为出色。此外，该框架还通过TenFormer实现了高效的波束成形设计，在保持高谱效率的同时显著降低了计算复杂度。
AI.keywords: 超越对角RIS, 信道估计, 张量分解, FORTE, FORPE, TenFormer
AI.comments: 该研究在BD-RIS信道估计和波束成形领域取得了重要进展。通过引入张量分解技术，该方法能够更有效地利用信道的几何结构信息，从而提高估计精度和降低计算复杂度。FORTE和FORPE方法的提出为解决BD-RIS信道估计的挑战提供了新的思路。TenFormer框架在实际应用中具有潜力。

title: PINNOCHIO: Physics-Informed Neural Network for Coupled Hyperelastic Interface-Volume Simulation in Orthognathic Surgery
comments: This work has been submitted to MICCAI 2026
summary: Predicting patient-specific facial soft-tissue deformation is critical for iterative orthognathic surgery planning. However, current computational methods face a strict accuracy-efficiency trade-off: high-fidelity Finite Element Methods (FEM) are computationally prohibitive, whereas pure deep learning models often produce biomechanically inconsistent results. While Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) offer a promising avenue, learning the complex heterogeneous mechanics of bone--soft-tissue interactions with only partial clinical supervision (i.e., outer facial surfaces) remains highly unstable. To overcome these challenges, we present PINNOCHIO, a novel physics-informed framework for facial soft-tissue simulation. PINNOCHIO introduces a hybrid sequential decomposition that explicitly decouples discontinuous bone--soft-tissue interface movements from continuous volumetric hyperelastic deformation. This structural separation enables stable training and facilitates a physics-enabled sim-to-real adaptation strategy, ensuring internal biomechanical consistency without requiring volumetric ground truth. Evaluated on a 40-patient clinical cohort, PINNOCHIO outperforms existing baselines in both surface accuracy and physical validity. Furthermore, it achieves a substantial speedup over FEM, successfully resolving the accuracy-efficiency trade-off to provide a highly reliable and practical tool for interactive surgical planning.

AI.title_translation: PINNOCHIO：用于正颌手术中耦合超弹性界面-体积模拟的物理信息神经网络
AI.tldr: PINNOCHIO通过解耦骨-软组织交互，在无需体积真值的情况下实现了高效、高精度的正颌手术面部软组织模拟。
AI.motivation: 现有的有限元方法（FEM）计算成本过高，而纯深度学习模型缺乏生物力学的一致性，且PINNs在处理骨与软组织间的复杂交互时存在训练不稳定的问题。
AI.method: 提出PINNOCHIO框架，采用混合序列分解方法，将不连续的骨-软组织界面运动与连续的体积超弹性形变解耦，并结合物理启发的虚实适应策略进行训练。
AI.result: 在40名患者的临床队列验证中，PINNOCHIO在表面精度和物理有效性方面均优于现有基准模型，并显著提升了计算速度。
AI.conclusion: PINNOCHIO成功平衡了正颌手术模拟中的精度与效率，为临床提供了一种可靠且高效的软组织形变预测工具。
AI.translation: 预测患者特定的面部软组织形变对于迭代式正颌手术规划至关重要。然而，目前的计算方法在准确性和效率之间面临严格的权衡：高保真的有限元方法（FEM）计算成本高昂，而纯深度学习模型往往产生生物力学上不一致的结果。尽管物理信息神经网络（PINNs）提供了一个有前景的方向，但仅依靠部分临床监督（即外部面部表面）来学习骨-软组织相互作用的复杂异构力学仍然高度不稳定。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了PINNOCHIO，一种用于面部软组织模拟的新型物理信息框架。PINNOCHIO引入了一种混合序列分解方法，将不连续的骨-软组织界面运动与连续的体积超弹性形变显式解耦。这种结构分离实现了稳定的训练，并促进了一种物理启用的虚实适应策略，确保了内部生物力学的一致性，且无需体积真值。在40名患者的临床队列中进行评估，PINNOCHIO在表面精度和物理有效性方面均优于现有的基准模型。此外，它比FEM实现了显著的加速，成功解决了准确性与效率的权衡问题，为交互式手术规划提供了一种高度可靠且实用的工具。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种名为PINNOCHIO的物理信息神经网络框架，专门用于正颌手术中的面部软组织模拟。通过将复杂的骨-软组织界面交互与体积形变进行结构化解耦，该模型在缺乏体积真值数据的情况下，实现了稳定的生物力学模拟，有效平衡了计算精度与效率。
AI.keywords: 正颌手术, 物理信息神经网络(PINN), 超弹性模型, 软组织模拟, 生物力学一致性
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入混合序列分解策略，巧妙地解决了PINNs在处理复杂生物力学界面时的不稳定性问题。其创新点在于无需体积真值数据即可保证内部生物力学的一致性，在正颌手术规划的临床应用中具有极高的实用价值和理论意义。

title: Description and Discussion on DCASE 2026 Challenge Task 2: Noise-aware Unsupervised Anomalous Sound Detection for Machine Condition Monitoring
comments: this article draws heavily from arXiv:2506.10097
summary: This paper presents an overview of DCASE 2026 Challenge Task 2, titled "Noise-aware unsupervised anomalous sound detection (UASD) for machine condition monitoring." The task aims to advance noise-robust anomalous sound detection for machine condition monitoring under the unsupervised setting, where only normal machine sounds are available for training. Reliable detection under noisy conditions is crucial for practical deployment, but previous DCASE Task 2 settings provided limited information about environmental noise, potentially limiting UASD performance in highly noisy situations. To address this limitation, DCASE 2026 allows participants to exploit two-channel audio samples simultaneously captured at locations near and far from the target machine. Since the distant microphone is expected to contain relatively stronger environmental noise and weaker direct machine sounds, it may help distinguish environmental noise components from the target machine sounds. After the challenge submission deadline, challenge results and an analysis of the submitted systems will be added.
comment: this article draws heavily from arXiv:2506.10097

title: Demystifying Multimodal Biomolecular Co-design With Intrinsic Geodesic Coupling
summary: Biomolecules such as proteins and small-molecule ligands play a central role in biological systems, arising from the tight interplay between sequence and three-dimensional structure. Recent generative models for biomolecular co-design aim to capture this interplay by jointly modeling coupled modalities. However, existing approaches largely adopt a parallel execution of marginal generative processes, implicitly enforcing fixed synchronous coupling. We argue that a critical but overlooked degree of freedom lies in how these marginal processes are temporally coupled during training and generation, where inappropriate coupling can introduce high-variance supervision and inconsistent intermediate states, affecting modality consistency. To address this, we introduce GeoCoupling, a systematic framework that optimizes for temporal couplings between heterogeneous modalities. Empirical results across structure-based drug design and unconditional protein design demonstrate the learned couplings consistently outperform synchronous and randomly coupled baselines, yielding biomolecules with improved physical validity and diversity.

title: Self-Regulating Annealing in Heavy-Tailed Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models have emerged as a leading framework for deep generative modeling. While the standard Gaussian formulation is theoretically convenient, its suitability for heavy-tailed datasets remains unclear. To address this, heavy-tailed diffusion models (HTDMs) extend the standard formulation by replacing the Gaussian distribution with a Student's t-distribution, thereby improving tail fidelity on heavy-tailed datasets. Although stochastic differential equation (SDE)-based sampling is possible in HTDMs, it has not been fully explored. In this paper, we propose an SDE-based sampler for HTDMs that explicitly incorporates a state-dependent diffusion coefficient. This state dependence naturally induces a self-regulating annealing mechanism by adaptively modulating the effective noise scale. We theoretically explore this mechanism and experimentally verify its necessity for reproducing samples from a heavy-tailed distribution.

title: Physics-Aware Linearized ADMM and Its Unrolling
summary: Recently, partial differential equations (PDEs) have been used to directly model the measurement process in signal processing, although their evaluation is costly. In this paper, we propose a novel alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM)-based algorithm called physics-aware linearized ADMM (PA-LADMM) for inverse problems from PDE-based measurement processes. The key idea is the linearization of the subproblem with PDEs, leading to a cost-efficient update rule that calls only a PDE solver and its gradient evaluation per iteration. The algorithm has a theoretical convergence guarantee under certain conditions. In addition, we combine it with deep unfolding to unroll the PA-LADMM and train its internal parameters using supervised data. Two distinct experiments, compressed sensing with optical fiber communication and image restoration from noisy anisotropic diffusion, demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.

title: MINTS: Minimalist Thompson Sampling
summary: The Bayesian paradigm offers principled tools for sequential decision-making under uncertainty, but its reliance on a probabilistic model for all parameters can hinder the incorporation of complex structural constraints. We introduce a minimalist Bayesian framework that places a prior only on the location of the optimum, while eliminating nuisance parameters through profile likelihood. This yields a generalized posterior that naturally accommodates structural constraints. As a direct instantiation, we develop MINimalist Thompson Sampling (MINTS). For multi-armed bandits with mean constraints, we establish near-optimal non-asymptotic regret guarantees and sharp almost-sure asymptotic regret characterizations. In particular, MINTS attains the classical Lai--Robbins constant in the unstructured setting and automatically adapts to unimodal structure, achieving the sharp constant determined only by the immediate neighbors of the optimal arm.

title: Mapping the Storm: Geospatial Impacts of Severe Weather on LEO Network Performance
comments: 10 pages, 8 figures, presented at the proceedings of the 33rd ACM International Conference on Advances in Geographic Information Systems
summary: LEO satellite constellations, led by deployments such as Starlink, are playing an increasingly pivotal role in enabling global broadband connectivity. However, the reliability and performance of these space-based networks are highly sensitive to environmental dynamics, particularly localized weather phenomena that exhibit strong spatio-temporal variability. In this study, we present a continental-scale geospatial analysis of weather-induced performance degradation in the Starlink LEO network, with a focus on the contiguous United States. Leveraging a unique dataset comprising more than 870,000 terminal hours of minute-level telemetry from 1,292 Starlink terminals, we integrate high-resolution localized weather observations to quantify the impact of various meteorological conditions. We evaluated key performance indicators (KPIs)-including ping latency, ping drop rate, and signal quality-using spatial join techniques and time-aligned correlation with classified weather events. Our analysis reveals that severe weather events, such as thunderstorms with heavy rain or snow, have a pronounced effect on network performance. In particular, more than 55% affected terminals experienced substantial degradation. Temporal continuity analysis at the minute level shows that such degradation can lead to sustained impairments or full service outages lasting from several minutes to multiple hours.This work contributes to the first large-scale empirical study linking LEO satellite Internet performance with fine-grained weather data in both space and time. Our findings offer actionable insights for geospatial predictive modeling, weather-aware network provisioning, and resilient satellite communication system design. We also propose a framework for incorporating weather-inferred performance variability into future geospatial planning and service-level forecasting tools for LEO-based Internet systems.

title: A Unified Variational Design of Predictive Mirror Descent in Convex Games under Stochastic Feedback
summary: Mirror descent provides a geometric framework for learning in games, but its last-iterate behavior can fail in weakly stable regimes, where the dynamics may exhibit rotational or recurrent transients. Predictive mirror methods mitigate this issue by modifying the feedback entering the mirror update, yet standard predictive variants are typically introduced algorithmically and analyzed one at a time. This letter gives a variational route to predictive feedback by constructing a stochastic mirror differential game with an auxiliary memory state. Its stage cost couples two Fenchel terms: a strategic term evaluated at a predicted profile and a corrective term driven by realized feedback. The resulting equilibrium feedback induces two-channel predictive mirror dynamics in general mirror geometry. Under local mirror regularity, a quantitative local Bregman growth condition, and bounded Brownian diffusion, we establish finite-horizon local terminal-time bounds in expectation and with high probability, together with an exit-probability estimate for the localization neighborhood. The result provides a unified variational construction of the induced predictive-memory mirror flow together with a local stochastic certificate for last-iterate performance near stable equilibria.

title: Pauli-structured preconditioning for quantum linear system solvers
summary: Preconditioning is a fundamental technique for accelerating classical linear system solvers, and understanding when its benefits persist in quantum linear system (QLS) solvers is important for assessing the practical resource requirements of quantum linear algebra. In QLS algorithms, however, the potential advantage of preconditioning may be offset by the normalization overhead incurred by composing separate block-encodings of the system matrix and the preconditioner, as observed in recent work. This limitation leaves open whether additional algebraic structure can make preconditioning effective in quantum access models. Motivated by this question, we show that Pauli-structured representations of both the system matrix and the preconditioner allow the preconditioned operator to be accessed through regrouped Pauli expansions. In this setting, algebraic regrouping of Pauli products can reduce the Pauli coefficient weight of the preconditioned operator, thereby altering the normalization parameters relevant to quantum algorithms. We derive explicit size and coefficient-weight bounds for the regrouped Pauli representations, and we trace their consequences for both direct block-encoding constructions and randomized Pauli linear system solvers. These results identify when Pauli-structured preconditioning can reduce the effective complexity parameters of QLS algorithms, rather than merely improving the classical condition number. Numerical experiments on a finite-dimensional synthetic benchmark show reductions in norm-aware direct block-encoding diagnostics and in the randomized QLS per-sample depth proxy.

title: Accelerating Min-Max Optimization via Power-Law Stepsizes
summary:
We revisit the convergence guarantees of the Extragradient (EG) method for unconstrained biaffine min-max optimization. It is known that EG with a fixed stepsize achieves a $Θ(T^{-1/2})$ last-iterate convergence rate, which is slower than the optimal $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1})$ rate attainable by incorporating additional mechanisms such as anchoring. Motivated by recent advances showing that dynamic stepsizes alone can significantly accelerate gradient descent, we ask whether dynamic stepsizes can similarly accelerate the last-iterate convergence of EG.
  We present the first positive result in this direction. Specifically, we provide a deterministic dynamic stepsize schedule that accelerates the convergence rate of EG to $\mathcal{O}(T^{-2/3+\varepsilon})$ for any $\varepsilon > 0$. We also show that this rate is tight when the extrapolation and update steps of EG use the same stepsize. We then show that allowing different stepsizes for the extrapolation and update steps further improves the convergence rate to the near-optimal $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1+\varepsilon})$. Our analysis reduces stepsize scheduling to an optimization problem, whose solution leads to a stepsize schedule that follows (a discretization of) a power-law distribution. Our proposed stepsize schedules and analysis extend to other methods, such as Optimistic Gradient (OG), and suggest broader applicability to general min-max optimization problems.

title: SpeechEditBench: A Bilingual Multi-Attribute Benchmark for Instruction-Guided Speech Editing
summary: Instruction-guided speech editing requires a model to modify specified speech attributes while preserving unrelated characteristics. Despite rapid progress in Speech Large Language Models (Speech LLMs), systematic evaluation of this capability remains challenging, as existing benchmarks are fragmented across isolated editing tasks. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{SpeechEditBench}, a bilingual multi-attribute benchmark for instruction-guided speech editing. SpeechEditBench encompasses seven atomic editing tasks, as well as compositional editing tasks that integrate multiple operations within a single instruction. We propose an anchor-based evaluation protocol that separately assesses the edit success of target attributes and the preservation of untargeted attributes, leading to three metrics: target success, preservation success, and joint success. Using this benchmark, we evaluate mainstream Speech LLMs and specialized speech editing systems. The results reveal three key findings: (1) no single model performs well across all editing dimensions; (2) closed-source Speech LLMs generally outperform open-source models; (3) compositional editing remains highly challenging, with even the most advanced models struggling to achieve high joint success. SpeechEditBench provides a rigorous diagnostic framework to identify bottlenecks in Speech LLMs, thereby facilitating the development of next-generation Speech LLMs with more robust and precise instruction-guided editing capabilities. Data and code will be released upon acceptance.

title: Site4Drug: Predicting Drug-Binding Target Sites with an AI Agent
comments: Accepted to the ICML 2026 Workshop on Generative and Agentic AI for Biology (GenBio)
summary:
Selecting where to intervene on a protein (i.e., choosing a targetable site) is often a more ambiguous and failure-prone bottleneck than selecting what binds, especially for membrane proteins where accessibility, topology, and post-translational modifications (PTMs) constrain actionable regions. We present Site4Drug, a modality-aware site-finding agent that outputs a ranked list of targetable regions with explicit constraints, evidence summaries, risk flags, and a traceable decision log.
  Rather than requiring users to specify the drug modality upfront, Site4Drug can recommend a binding modality (e.g., antibody/peptide-like vs small-molecule) from the same evidence used for site discovery, including topology, hydropathy, PTM propensity, disulfides, domain context, and sequence. Importantly, this evidence is applied consistently across modalities, including small-molecule pocket discovery, to avoid selecting chemically plausible but biologically occluded sites.

title: Adaptive Sharpness-Aware Minimization with a Polyak-type Step size: A Theory-Grounded Scheduler
summary: Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) has established itself as a powerful and widely adopted optimizer for training machine learning models. By explicitly minimizing the sharpness of the loss landscape, SAM often improves generalization while delivering strong empirical performance. However, SAM and its variants, like most training algorithms, are sensitive to the choice of learning rate, which is typically selected through extensive hyperparameter tuning or predefined schedulers. In this work, motivated by recent advances on the effectiveness of stochastic Polyak step sizes for Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD), we derive Polyak schedulers tailored to SAM-style updates, yielding novel adaptive algorithms in both deterministic and stochastic settings. In the smooth setting, we prove linear convergence for strongly convex objectives and an $\mathcal{O}(1/T)$ convergence rate for convex objectives in the deterministic case. In the stochastic setting, we establish analogous convergence guarantees up to a neighborhood of the optimum. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed Polyak schedulers achieve performance comparable to or better than carefully tuned SAM baselines, while substantially reducing the need for learning-rate tuning.

title: Waterproof Editor: an educational environment for proof assistants and programming languages
comments: To be presented at TEAL 2026: Tools for Educational Activities in Logic
summary: Waterproof Editor provides an educational environment specifically targeted to teaching with proof assistants or programming languages. It arose from Waterproof, educational software targeted at helping students acquire the skill of giving mathematical proofs. Its original features such as enabling rich formatting and providing clear input areas are now abstracted away in an npm package and can be used in different educational contexts. We invite interested parties to use this component in their educational software, and offer to assist with this.

title: RA-LWLM: Retrieval-Augmented In-Context Localization with Wireless Foundation Models
comments: 13 pages, 9 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Wireless localization is a fundamental capability of sixth-generation (6G) networks. Conventional model-based methods require accurate modeling of the propagation environment and degrade in complex multipath and non-line-of-sight scenarios, while learning-based methods couple model parameters tightly to the training scene, requiring costly retraining whenever the base station (BS) configuration or propagation environment changes. In this paper, we propose RA-LWLM, a retrieval-augmented in-context localization framework that achieves training-free cross-scene adaptation by externalizing scene-specific information into a per-scene fingerprint database rather than encoding it in model weights. The framework consists of three components: a frozen wireless foundation model (FM) encoder that maps raw channel state information into a scene-agnostic representation; a retrieval module that selects the most informative references from the per-scene database via similarity search in the representation space; and a transformer-based in-context learning (ICL) module that fuses the query with the retrieved references to predict the user equipment (UE) position. To accommodate varying retrieval quality and propagation complexity across queries, the ICL module adopts a mixture-of-experts design in which experts specialize in different context sizes and are softly combined by a learnable selector. Extensive ray-tracing-based experiments across heterogeneous scenes with diverse BS configurations show that RA-LWLM achieves nearly identical accuracy on seen and unseen scenes without any per-scene retraining, substantially outperforming end-to-end and FM-based baselines. These results validate the proposed retrieval-augmented in-context paradigm as a scalable solution for cross-scene localization in 6G networks.

AI.title_translation: RA-LWLM：基于无线基座模型的检索增强上下文内定位
AI.tldr: 提出RA-LWLM框架，通过结合无线基座模型、检索增强和混合专家上下文内学习，实现了无需任何场景重训的跨场景高精度无线定位。
AI.motivation: 传统基于模型的定位方法在复杂多径和非视距场景下易降级，而基于学习的方法与训练场景紧密耦合，在基站配置或环境改变时需要高成本的重新训练。为此，需要一种无需重训即可实现跨场景自适应的定位方法。
AI.method: 提出RA-LWLM框架，包含三个核心组件：1) 冻结的无线基座模型（FM）编码器，将信道状态信息映射为场景无关的表征；2) 检索模块，通过相似度搜索在表征空间中检索最相关的场景指纹参考信息；3) 基于Transformer的上下文内学习（ICL）模块，融合查询与检索参考以预测UE位置。其中ICL模块采用混合专家（MoE）设计，以自适应不同的上下文长度和检索质量。
AI.result: 在具有多样化基站配置的异构场景中进行的广泛射线追踪实验表明，RA-LWLM在已知和未知场景上均实现了几乎相同的定位精度，且无需任何每场景重新训练，性能显著优于端到端和基于FM的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的检索增强上下文内定位范式（RA-LWLM）是6G网络中跨场景定位的一种高效且可扩展的解决方案。
AI.translation: 无线定位是第六代（6G）网络的一项基本功能。传统的基于模型的方法需要对传播环境进行精确建模，并且在复杂的多径和非视距场景中性能会下降，而基于学习的方法将模型参数与训练场景紧密耦合，每当基站（BS）配置或传播环境发生变化时，都需要进行昂贵的重新训练。在本文中，我们提出了RA-LWLM，这是一种检索增强的上下文内定位框架，它通过将场景特定信息外置到每个场景的指纹数据库中，而不是编码在模型权重中，从而实现了免训练的跨场景自适应。该框架由三个部分组成：一个冻结的无线基座模型（FM）编码器，用于将原始信道状态信息映射为场景无关的表征；一个检索模块，通过在表征空间中进行相似度搜索，从每个场景的数据库中选择最具信息量的参考信息；以及一个基于Transformer的上下文内学习（ICL）模块，用于融合查询与检索到的参考信息以预测用户设备（UE）的位置。为了适应不同查询的检索质量和传播复杂度的变化，ICL模块采用了混合专家设计，其中专家专注于不同的上下文大小，并通过可学习的选择器进行软组合。在具有多样化基站配置的异构场景中进行的大量基于射线追踪的实验表明，RA-LWLM在已知和未知场景上实现了几乎相同的精度，而无需任何针对具体场景的重新训练，显著优于端到端和基于FM的基线方法。这些结果验证了所提出的检索增强上下文内范式是6G网络中跨场景定位的一种具有扩展性的解决方案。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为RA-LWLM的检索增强上下文内定位框架，旨在解决6G无线定位中跨场景自适应的难题。该框架通过将场景特定信息外置于指纹数据库中，利用冻结的无线基座模型提取特征，结合相似度检索和带有混合专家设计的Transformer上下文内学习模块进行位置预测。该方法无需任何场景重训即可在未知场景中保持高精度。
AI.keywords: 无线定位, 6G网络, 无线基座模型, 检索增强, 上下文内学习
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将大语言模型中常用的检索增强（Retrieval-Augmented）和上下文内学习（In-Context Learning）概念引入到无线定位领域，利用无线基座模型实现了免微调的跨场景泛化。其混合专家（MoE）设计灵活地解决了检索质量波动的问题。局限性可能在于对每场景指纹数据库的依赖以及高频检索在实际6G超低时延定位中的开销。

title: Advancing Electrolaryngeal Speech Enhancement Through Speech-Text Representation Learning
comments: 15 pages, 7 figures. Accepted to IEEE TBME
summary: Objective: laryngectomees depend on an electromechanical device to generate electrolaryngeal (EL) speech. Compared with normal speech, EL speech suffers from severe distortion, limited phonetic variation, unnatural prosody, and temporal shifts, degrading naturalness and intelligibility. Although sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) voice conversion (VC) based EL-speech-to-normal-speech conversion (EL2SP) is promising, substantial mismatches between EL and normal speech inevitably cause cumulative mapping errors that limit performance. To address this, we describe a novel representation learning framework integrating speech and text representations to improve mapping and reconstruction quality within a seq2seq VC model. Methods: our methodology comprises two main stages: 1) representation integration and learning, and 2) reconstruction training. A network capable of incorporating auxiliary text information is first constructed with pretrained modules to learn speech--text-based integrated representations. Then, an autoencoder-style reconstruction strategy finalizes EL2SP model to inherit these representations without increasing model complexity. We introduce three fusion strategies including middle-, input-, and hybrid-level fusion strategies that progressively enhance learning. Moreover, besides standard seq2seq VC objectives, an additional reconstruction loss on the integrated representation is introduced to refine representation transfer. Results: experiments under different EL2SP datasets consistently demonstrate that our methods, combined with data augmentations, outperform baselines relying solely on speech representations. Furthermore, progressive improvements with system design depth validate the effectiveness of our methods. Significance: the proposed methods provide an extensible and practical methodology for EL speech enhancement and assistive communication technologies.
