AI.title_translation: 通过语音-文本表征学习改进电子喉语音增强
AI.tldr: 喉切除患者使用的电子喉语音存在严重失真，现有语音转换方法误差大。本文提出一种结合语音和文本表征的学习框架，以改进电子喉语音增强。
AI.motivation: 喉切除患者的电子喉（EL）语音存在严重的失真、语音变化有限、语调不自然和时间偏移，从而降低了自然度和可懂度。现有的基于序列到序列（seq2seq）语音转换（VC）的EL语音到正常语音转换（EL2SP）方法，由于EL语音与正常语音之间存在显著不匹配，导致累积映射误差并限制了性能。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的表征学习框架，该框架在seq2seq VC模型中整合了语音和文本表征。方法包括两个主要阶段：1）表征整合与学习，以及2）重建训练。首先构建一个能够结合辅助文本信息的网络，该网络包含预训练模块，用于学习基于语音-文本的整合表征。然后，采用自编码器风格的重建策略来完成EL2SP模型，使其在不增加模型复杂性的情况下继承这些表征。引入了三种融合策略（中间层、输入层和混合层）。此外，除了标准的seq2seq VC目标，还引入了对整合表征的额外重建损失，以优化表征的迁移。
AI.result: 在不同的EL2SP数据集上的实验一致表明，所提出的方法结合数据增强，优于仅依赖语音表征的基线方法。系统设计深度的逐步改进验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法为电子喉语音增强和辅助通信技术提供了一种可扩展且实用的方法。
AI.translation: 目标：喉切除患者依赖机电设备产生电子喉（EL）语音。与正常语音相比，EL语音存在严重的失真、语音变化有限、语调不自然和时间偏移，从而降低了自然度和可懂度。尽管基于序列到序列（seq2seq）语音转换（VC）的EL语音到正常语音转换（EL2SP）技术前景广阔，但EL语音和正常语音之间显著的不匹配不可避免地导致累积映射误差，从而限制了性能。为了解决这个问题，我们描述了一种新颖的表征学习框架，该框架整合了语音和文本表征，以提高seq2seq VC模型中的映射和重建质量。方法：我们的方法包括两个主要阶段：1）表征整合与学习，以及2）重建训练。首先构建一个能够结合辅助文本信息的网络，该网络包含预训练模块，用于学习基于语音-文本的整合表征。然后，采用自编码器风格的重建策略来完成EL2SP模型，使其在不增加模型复杂性的情况下继承这些表征。我们引入了三种融合策略，包括中间层、输入层和混合层融合策略，这些策略逐步增强了学习效果。此外，除了标准的seq2seq VC目标，还引入了对整合表征的额外重建损失，以优化表征的迁移。结果：在不同的EL2SP数据集上的实验一致表明，我们的方法结合数据增强，优于仅依赖语音表征的基线方法。此外，系统设计深度的逐步改进验证了我们方法的有效性。意义：所提出的方法为EL语音增强和辅助通信技术提供了一种可扩展且实用的方法。
AI.summary: 本文旨在解决喉切除患者使用的电子喉（EL）语音存在的失真和不自然等质量问题。当前的序列到序列语音转换（EL2SP）方法因EL语音与正常语音之间的不匹配而受限。作者提出了一种新颖的两阶段表征学习框架，该框架整合了语音和文本表征。该框架利用预训练模块学习语音-文本的组合表征，并采用自编码器风格的重建策略。它引入了三种融合策略以及对整合表征的额外重建损失。实验结果表明，该方法结合数据增强，显著优于仅依赖语音的基线方法，为EL语音增强提供了一种实用的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 电子喉语音, 语音增强, 语音转换, 表征学习, 语音-文本整合
AI.comments: 创新点：主要创新在于将辅助文本信息与语音表征整合到seq2seq语音转换模型中，用于电子喉语音增强。通过提供更丰富、更鲁棒的表征，解决了仅依赖语音的模型所存在的局限性。多级融合策略和对整合表征的额外重建损失进一步优化了学习过程。重要性：这项工作对于改善喉切除患者的沟通质量至关重要，显著提高了电子喉语音的自然度和可懂度，直接影响他们的生活质量。它为辅助通信技术提供了一种实用且可扩展的方法。

title: An Explicit Scott-Type Bound for Absolutely Maximally Entangled States with Arbitrary Defect
summary: Absolutely maximally entangled (AME) states and, more generally, $k$-uniform states in $(\C^q)^{\otimes n}$ are central objects in multipartite entanglement theory, with applications to quantum secret sharing, quantum masking, and quantum error correction. In the extremal case $k=\lfloor n/2\rfloor$, Scott (2004) proved a sharp nonexistence bound showing that AME states cannot exist once the number of parties $n$ exceeds a threshold of order $2q^{2}$ (with a parity dependence on $n$), where $q$ is the local dimension. Recently, Ning et al.\ studied \emph{defective} AME states (i.e., $k=\lfloor n/2\rfloor-l$ with $l>0$), gave explicit Scott-type bounds for defects $l=1,2$ and conjectured a general $(2l+2)q^{2}+o(q^{2})$ behavior. In this paper, we solve this conjecture and establish a fully explicit Scott-type upper bound for AME states with arbitrary defect $l\ge 0$, yielding Scott's bound for $l=0$ and Ning et al.'s bounds for $l=1,2$ as special cases. Equivalently, this gives nonexistence bounds for one-dimensional pure quantum error-correcting codes near the quantum Singleton regime. The proof uses a truncated MacWilliams linear-programming system and an explicit infeasibility certificate. As a direct application, we derive explicit asymptotic upper bounds on $k/n$ for fixed local dimension $q$, improving the implicit upper bounds given by Ning et al.

AI.title_translation: 具有任意缺陷的绝对最大纠缠态的显式Scott型界限
AI.tldr: 本文推导出了具有任意缺陷的绝对最大纠缠（AME）态的通用显式存在性界限，证明了相关领域的猜想并改进了量子纠错码的性能评估。
AI.motivation: 为了解决关于具有任意缺陷的AME态存在性的猜想，并推广Scott（2004）针对极端情况（k=⌊n/2⌋）提出的非存在性界限。
AI.method: 采用截断的MacWilliams线性规划系统，并构建了显式的不可行性证明（infeasibility certificate）。
AI.result: 建立了针对任意缺陷l≥0的AME态的完全显式Scott型上界，证明了Ning等人关于(2l+2)q²+o(q²)行为的猜想，并导出了固定局部维度q下k/n的显式渐近上界。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功证明了关于任意缺陷AME态存在性的猜想，给出了完整的显式上界，并改进了固定局部维度下的渐近界限，完善了该领域的理论框架。
AI.translation: 绝对最大纠缠（AME）态，以及更广义的(C^q)^{⊗n}中的k-一致态，是多方纠缠理论的核心对象，在量子秘密共享、量子掩蔽和量子纠错中有着重要应用。在极端情况k=⌊n/2⌋下，Scott（2004）证明了一个尖锐的非存在性界限，表明当参与方数量n超过约2q²（具有n的奇偶性依赖）的阈值时，AME态不存在，其中q是局部维度。最近，Ning等人研究了“有缺陷的”AME态（即k=⌊n/2⌋-l，其中l>0），给出了缺陷l=1,2的显式Scott型界限，并猜想其具有(2l+2)q²+o(q²)的通用行为。在本文中，我们解决了这一猜想，并为具有任意缺陷l≥0的AME态建立了完全显式的Scott型上界，从而将l=0时的Scott界限和l=1,2时的Ning等人界限作为特例包含在内。等价地，这为接近量子Singleton区的一维纯量子纠错码提供了非存在性界限。证明过程使用了截断的MacWilliams线性规划系统和一个显式的不可行性证明。作为直接应用，我们推导出了固定局部维度q下k/n的显式渐近上界，改进了Ning等人给出的隐式上界。
AI.summary: 本文针对多方纠缠理论中的绝对最大纠缠（AME）态，推广了Scott关于非存在性的经典界限。作者解决了关于具有任意缺陷的AME态的猜想，给出了统一的显式上界，不仅涵盖了已知特殊情况，还改进了相关量子纠错码的渐近界限。
AI.keywords: 绝对最大纠缠态, k-一致态, 量子纠错码, Scott型界限, MacWilliams恒等式
AI.comments: 该论文解决了量子纠缠理论中一个长期存在的猜想，通过提供任意缺陷下绝对最大纠缠态（AME）的显式Scott型界限，弥补了之前研究在缺陷推广上的不足。其技术手段（截断MacWilliams线性规划）具有较强的理论价值，并对量子纠错码的研究具有直接意义。

title: High-order synchrosqueezed wavelet-chirplet transform for instantaneous frequency and chirprate estimation
summary: The separation of multicomponent signals with crossing instantaneous frequency (IF) curves remains a fundamental challenge in time-frequency analysis. Although the synchrosqueezed wavelet-chirplet transform (SWCT) enhances time-frequency readability by introducing a chirprate variable, its effectiveness is constrained by the underlying assumption of local linear chirp. Consequently, this method does not perform well when analyzing signals characterized by strong frequency modulation. This paper extends the SWCT framework by relaxing the linear chirp assumption. We model signal components as having polynomial phase behavior over short intervals and derive compact expressions for high-order IF and chirprate reassignment operators. The proposed high-order synchrosqueezed wavelet-chirplet transform (HSWCT) enables accurate estimation of both IF and chirprate, and supports robust mode retrieval even with intersecting IF curves. Another key contribution is a rigorous mathematical analysis of the approximation errors of arbitrary-order reassignment operators for IF and chirprate estimation. When the chirprate vanishes, HSWCT simplifies to the traditional high-order synchrosqueezed wavelet transform. To our best knowledge, no theoretical analysis exists in the literature on the approximation of arbitrary-order SST IF reassignment operators to the IF. As a by-product of this work, our established theorem provides such an analysis, thereby filling a gap in the theoretical framework of high-order SSTs.

AI.title_translation: 高阶同步压缩小波-चिरप्लेट变换用于瞬时频率和चिरप्लेट率估计
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种高阶同步压缩小波-चिरप्लेट变换（HSWCT），用于解决多分量信号中瞬时频率（IF）曲线交叉的问题。与现有的SWCT方法不同，HSWCT放宽了局部线性चिरप्的假设，允许信号分量具有多项式相位行为，从而能够更准确地估计IF和चिरप्率，并能鲁棒地提取模式。此外，该研究还对任意阶重分配算子估计IF和चिरप्率的近似误差进行了严格的数学分析，填补了高阶同步压缩小波变换（SST）理论分析的空白。
AI.motivation: 现有的同步压缩小波-चिरप्लेट变换（SWCT）在分析具有强频率调制的信号时效果不佳，因为它假设局部चिरप्是线性的。因此，需要一种新的方法来处理非线性चिरप्信号。
AI.method: 提出了一种高阶同步压缩小波-चिरप्लेट变换（HSWCT），它通过模拟具有多项式相位行为的信号分量来放宽线性चिरप्假设，并推导出高阶瞬时频率（IF）和चिरप्率重分配算子的紧凑表达式。此外，还对任意阶重分配算子估计IF和चिरप्率的近似误差进行了严格的数学分析。
AI.result: 所提出的HSWCT能够准确估计瞬时频率（IF）和चिरप्率，即使在IF曲线交叉的情况下也能鲁棒地提取模式。该研究还为高阶SST IF重分配算子的近似误差提供了理论分析。
AI.conclusion: HSWCT能够准确估计IF和चिरप्率，并能鲁棒地提取模式，解决了现有SWCT方法的局限性。此外，该研究对高阶SST IF重分配算子的近似误差进行了理论分析，填补了该领域的理论空白。
AI.translation: 在具有交叉瞬时频率（IF）曲线的多分量信号分离在时频分析中仍然是一个基本挑战。尽管同步压缩小波-चिरप्लेट变换（SWCT）通过引入चिरप्率变量增强了时频可读性，但其有效性受到局部线性चिरप्的潜在假设的限制。因此，该方法在分析具有强频率调制的信号时效果不佳。本文扩展了SWCT框架，放宽了线性चिरप्假设。我们在短区间内将信号分量建模为具有多项式相位行为，并推导出高阶IF和चिरप्率重分配算子的紧凑表达式。所提出的高阶同步压缩小波-चिरप्लेट变换（HSWCT）能够准确估计IF和चिरप्率，并支持在具有相交IF曲线的情况下进行鲁棒的模式检索。另一项关键贡献是对任意阶重分配算子估计IF和चिरप्率的近似误差进行了严格的数学分析。当चिरप्率消失时，HSWCT简化为传统的二阶同步压缩小波变换。据我们所知，文献中不存在关于任意阶SST IF重分配算子对IF的近似的理论分析。作为这项工作的一个副产品，我们建立的定理提供了这样的分析，从而填补了高阶SSTs理论框架中的空白。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种高阶同步压缩小波-चिरप्लेट变换（HSWCT），用于解决多分量信号中瞬时频率（IF）曲线交叉的问题。与现有的SWCT方法不同，HSWCT放宽了局部线性चिरप्的假设，允许信号分量具有多项式相位行为，从而能够更准确地估计IF和चिरप्率，并能鲁棒地提取模式。此外，该研究还对任意阶重分配算子估计IF和चिरप्率的近似误差进行了严格的数学分析，填补了高阶同步压缩小波变换（SST）理论分析的空白。
AI.keywords: 同步压缩小波-चिरप्लेट变换, 瞬时频率估计, चिरप्率估计, 高阶分析, 时间频率分析
AI.comments: 这项研究在时间频率分析领域取得了重要进展，通过提出HSWCT解决了现有方法的局限性。对近似误差的严格数学分析也增加了该方法的理论基础。然而，该方法在处理非常高阶或复杂相位信号时的实际性能仍有待进一步验证。

title: Provable Data Scaling Law for Meta Learning via Complexity Minimization
summary: Pre-training has become a fundamental paradigm in modern machine learning, with one of its key empirical benefits being reduced downstream sample complexity as the scale of pre-training data increases. However, existing theoretical frameworks for pre-training do not fully explain this phenomenon. In this paper, we introduce complexity minimization, a novel meta-representation learning framework designed to enable theoretical analysis of this scaling behavior, which learns representations by evaluating the downstream model complexity best suited to each domain and minimizing the worst-case such complexity across source domains. Our end-to-end theoretical analysis, spanning pre-training through downstream regression, shows that this framework provably captures this scaling behavior; in particular, we show that the error rate of few-shot adaptation improves as the amount of meta-training data grows. Empirically, we demonstrate that incorporating complexity regularization into existing meta-learning methods consistently improves downstream sample efficiency.

AI.title_translation: 通过最小化复杂性实现元学习的可证明数据缩放定律
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个名为“复杂度最小化”的新型元表示学习框架，用于理论分析预训练中的数据缩放现象。该框架通过评估下游模型复杂度并最小化源域上的最坏情况复杂度来学习表示。研究表明，该框架能够证明数据缩放行为，即随着元训练数据量的增加，少样本适应的误差率会提高。实验也证实了该方法能提高下游样本效率。
AI.motivation: 现代机器学习中，预训练的样本复杂度随着预训练数据量的增加而降低，但现有理论框架未能完全解释这一现象。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“复杂度最小化”的新型元表示学习框架，通过评估下游模型复杂度并最小化源域上的最坏情况复杂度来学习表示，并进行了端到端的理论分析。
AI.result: 研究表明，该框架能够证明数据缩放行为，即随着元训练数据量的增加，少样本适应的误差率会提高。实验证实了该方法能提高下游样本效率。
AI.conclusion: 复杂度最小化框架能够理论上证明预训练中的数据缩放行为，并且在实践中能够提高下游样本效率。
AI.translation: 预训练已成为现代机器学习的一个基本范例，其关键的经验优势之一是随着预训练数据规模的增加，下游样本复杂度降低。然而，现有的预训练理论框架并未完全解释这种现象。在本文中，我们引入了复杂度最小化，一个新颖的元表示学习框架，旨在实现对这种缩放行为的理论分析，该框架通过评估最适合每个域的下游模型复杂度并通过最小化跨源域的最坏情况复杂度来学习表示。我们从预训练到下游回归的端到端理论分析表明，该框架能够证明这种缩放行为；特别是，我们表明随着元训练数据的增长，少样本适应的误差率会提高。在经验上，我们证明了将复杂度正则化纳入现有的元学习方法能够持续提高下游样本效率。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了复杂度最小化框架，用于解决预训练中数据缩放现象的理论解释问题。该框架通过最小化下游模型在不同域上的最坏情况复杂度来学习表示，并被证明能够理论上解释数据缩放行为，即增加预训练数据可以降低下游任务的样本复杂度。实验结果也验证了该框架的有效性。
AI.keywords: 元学习, 数据缩放, 复杂度最小化, 样本效率, 预训练
AI.comments: 该研究在理论上为预训练中的数据缩放现象提供了解释，并提出了一个实用的框架。然而，对于“复杂度”的具体度量和在不同应用场景下的普适性仍需进一步探讨。

title: Branch-Aware Quantum Constant Propagation for Dynamic Quantum Circuits
summary: Compile-time optimization is important for improving the efficiency and reliability of quantum circuits on current noisy hardware. While many existing methods simplify circuits using structural patterns or quantum-state information, most of them target only unitary circuits and do not support dynamic circuits with mid-circuit measurements and classical feedforward. In this work, we present Branch-Aware Quantum Constant Propagation (BQCP), a compile-time analysis for dynamic circuits. BQCP extends Quantum Constant Propagation (QCP) by tracking the classical information produced by mid-circuit measurements together with the corresponding post-measurement quantum states across different execution branches. This enables path-sensitive reasoning inside conditional blocks and more precise information propagation than QCP. To keep the analysis scalable, we bound both the size of the quantum-state representation and the number of tracked branches. Using the information inferred by the analysis, we apply semantics-preserving simplifications to circuit operations. We prove the soundness of both the analysis and the simplifications. Experimental results on both application-driven and synthetic benchmarks show that, on dynamic circuits, our method consistently achieves larger reductions than other existing passes including QCP.

AI.title_translation: 动态量子电路的感知分支量子常数传播
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种名为BQCP的编译时分析方法，用于优化动态量子电路。它通过跟踪测量产生的经典信息和相应的量子态，实现了比现有QCP方法更精确的信息传播，并在实验中证明了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有量子电路优化方法多针对酉电路，不支持包含测量和反馈的动态电路。需要一种能处理动态电路的优化方法。
AI.method: 提出分支感知量子常数传播（BQCP）方法，扩展了量子常数传播（QCP），跟踪测量产生的经典信息及相应的量子态，支持路径敏感推理，并通过限制量子态表示大小和分支数量来保证可扩展性。应用此信息进行语义保持的电路操作简化，并证明了分析和简化的正确性。
AI.result: 在动态电路的基准测试中，BQCP实现了比包括QCP在内的其他现有方法更大的电路缩减。
AI.conclusion: BQCP是一种有效的编译时分析方法，能够处理动态量子电路，并实现比现有方法更优的电路优化效果。
AI.translation: 编译时优化对于提高当前含噪声硬件上量子电路的效率和可靠性至关重要。虽然许多现有方法使用结构模式或量子态信息来简化电路，但大多数方法仅针对酉电路，并且不支持带有中途测量和经典前馈的动态电路。在这项工作中，我们提出了分支感知量子常数传播（BQCP），一种用于动态电路的编译时分析。BQCP通过跟踪中途测量产生的经典信息以及相应跨不同执行分支的测量后量子态来扩展量子常数传播（QCP）。这使得在条件块内进行路径敏感推理，并实现比QCP更精确的信息传播。为了保持分析的可扩展性，我们限制了量子态表示的大小和跟踪分支的数量。利用分析推断的信息，我们对电路操作应用了语义保持的简化。我们证明了分析和简化的正确性。在应用驱动和合成基准测试上的实验结果表明，在动态电路上，我们的方法比包括QCP在内的其他现有方法一致地实现了更大的缩减。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为分支感知量子常数传播（BQCP）的编译时优化技术，专门用于处理动态量子电路。与仅限于酉电路的传统方法不同，BQCP能够跟踪中途测量产生的经典信息及其对应的量子态，从而实现跨越不同执行分支的路径敏感分析。通过限制分析的复杂性，BQCP能够有效地进行优化，并在实验中证明其在动态电路上的性能优于现有的QCP等方法。
AI.keywords: 动态量子电路, 量子常数传播, 编译时优化, 中途测量, 分支感知分析
AI.comments: 该研究提出了BQCP方法，解决了动态量子电路优化中的关键挑战，特别是在处理中途测量和经典反馈方面。其路径敏感分析和可扩展性设计是该方法的创新点。然而，对于量子态表示大小和分支数量的限制策略的详细影响，以及在更复杂的动态电路场景下的实际性能表现，还需要进一步的探讨。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Graph Neural Reconstruction of Urban Temperature Fields from Sparse Sensors under Deployment Constraints
summary: Reconstructing spatially continuous daily temperature fields from sparse observations is important for urban climate monitoring and heat-risk analysis, but practical deployments are limited by sensor budgets and spacing constraints. This study proposes an uncertainty-aware graph neural network (GNN) framework for reconstructing daily maximum temperature fields from sparse sensors while supporting distance-constrained sensor placement and probabilistic exceedance mapping. The model predicts both the temperature field and a spatially varying predictive uncertainty field using a graph-attention-based mean-residual architecture trained with a Gaussian negative log-likelihood. Sensor placement is addressed using a Proper Orthogonal Decomposition with QR factorization (POD-QR) strategy with a 4 km minimum inter-sensor distance constraint and is compared with random feasible placement and farthest-point sampling. The framework is evaluated over a Montreal-area polygon using Daymet v4.1 daily temperature data (1 km resolution) under a strict temporal hold-out protocol (training: 2020-2023; testing: 2024). Across sensor budgets (10-40 sensors), the proposed GNN consistently outperforms inverse distance weighting and ordinary kriging in RMSE and MAE on unobserved nodes. Sensor-placement effects are most pronounced at low budgets and diminish at higher budgets, with a practical saturation regime emerging around 30 sensors under the imposed spacing constraint. Probabilistic evaluation further shows improved uncertainty calibration with increasing sensor density and a better sharpness-calibration trade-off than kriging. These results support the proposed framework as an effective tool for uncertainty-aware temperature field reconstruction and decision-oriented heat-risk mapping.

AI.title_translation: 来自稀疏传感器在部署约束下的城市温度场的不确定性感知图神经网络重建
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种不确定性感知图神经网络（GNN）框架，用于从稀疏传感器重建城市日最高温度场，同时考虑了传感器预算和间距限制。该模型通过图注意力机制预测温度场及其预测不确定性场。研究还采用了一种带约束的传感器放置策略，并与随机放置和最远点采样进行了比较。实验结果表明，该GNN框架在RMSE和MAE方面优于传统方法，并且在传感器密度增加时，不确定性校准得到改善。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏观测中重建空间连续的城市日温度场对于城市气候监测和热风险分析至关重要，但实际部署受到传感器预算和间距的限制。
AI.method: 提出了一种不确定性感知图神经网络（GNN）框架，采用基于图注意力的均值残差架构，并使用高斯负对数似然进行训练。传感器放置采用带4公里最小间距约束的POD-QR策略。
AI.result: 在蒙特利尔地区进行的实验表明，该GNN框架在RMSE和MAE方面优于IDW和OK方法，尤其是在传感器数量较少时。传感器放置策略的影响在低预算时最明显，随着传感器数量的增加而减弱。增加传感器密度可以改善不确定性校准和锐度-校准权衡。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的框架是一种有效的不确定性感知温度场重建工具，可用于面向决策的热风险制图。
AI.translation: 从稀疏观测中重建空间连续的每日温度场对于城市气候监测和热风险分析很重要，但实际部署受到传感器预算和间距约束的限制。本研究提出了一种不确定性感知的图神经网络（GNN）框架，用于从稀疏传感器重建每日最高温度场，同时支持距离约束的传感器放置和概率超额制图。该模型预测温度场和空间变化的预测不确定性场，采用基于图注意力的均值残差架构，并使用高斯负对数似然进行训练。传感器放置采用具有4公里最小传感器间距约束的QR分解（POD-QR）策略，并与随机可行放置和最远点采样进行比较。该框架在蒙特利尔地区使用Daymet v4.1每日温度数据（1公里分辨率）在严格的时间划分协议下（训练：2020-2023；测试：2024）进行了评估。在传感器预算（10-40个传感器）下，所提出的GNN在未观测节点的RMSE和MAE方面始终优于反距离加权和普通克里金法。传感器放置的影响在低预算时最为明显，在高预算时减弱，在约30个传感器下出现实际饱和状态，并施加了间距约束。概率评估进一步表明，随着传感器密度的增加，不确定性校准得到改善，并且与克里金法相比，锐度-校准权衡更好。这些结果支持所提出的框架作为不确定性感知的温度场重建和面向决策的热风险制图的有效工具。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种不确定性感知的图神经网络（GNN）框架，用于从稀疏传感器重建城市日最高温度场，同时考虑了传感器预算和间距约束。该模型通过图注意力机制预测温度场及其预测不确定性场。研究还采用了一种带约束的传感器放置策略，并与随机放置和最远点采样进行了比较。实验结果表明，该GNN框架在RMSE和MAE方面优于传统方法，并且在传感器密度增加时，不确定性校准得到改善。
AI.keywords: 图神经网络, 温度场重建, 不确定性感知, 传感器放置, 城市气候
AI.comments: 该研究在解决城市温度场重建的实际挑战方面取得了进展，特别是在传感器部署受到限制的情况下。不确定性感知的方法对于理解重建结果的可靠性至关重要。然而，该方法在计算效率和处理大规模城市区域方面的扩展性有待进一步研究。

title: Convex Distance Operator Transport: A Convex and Geometry-Preserving Formulation
comments: This paper is 41 pages long, contains 6 figures, and has been accepted to ICML 2026
summary: We introduce Convex Distance Operator Transport (CDOT), the first convex optimal transport framework that aligns distributions across heterogeneous domains by jointly preserving feature correspondence and intrinsic geometric structure. Specifically, CDOT employs an operator-based regularization that aligns aggregated distance structures by introducing distance and conditional expectation operators. Consequently, the proposed regularization improves the robustness to local geometric variations. We further prove that the resulting CDOT discrepancy is a valid pseudometric on the space of attributed compact metric-measure spaces. In addition, we characterize the relationship between CDOT and Gromov--Wasserstein (GW) through a new notion of dispersion gap, formally elucidating the geometric source of non-convexity in GW compared to the convexity of CDOT. In the finite-sample regime, we derive a non-asymptotic risk bound decomposed into optimization and statistical errors, establishing risk consistency under a globally convergent Frank--Wolfe algorithm. Experiments on synthetic point clouds, brain connectomes, and graph classification benchmarks demonstrate better performance over existing methods, with stable and reliable behavior in practice.

AI.title_translation: 凸距离算子传输：一个凸几何保持框架
AI.tldr: CDOT是一个新颖的凸最优传输框架，通过联合保持特征对应和内在几何结构来对齐异构域上的分布，解决了GW的非凸性问题，并在各种基准测试中表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的最优传输方法在处理异构域分布对齐时，往往难以同时保持特征对应和内在几何结构，并且可能面临非凸性问题。CDOT旨在解决这些局限性。
AI.method: CDOT采用基于算子的正则化方法，通过引入距离和条件期望算子来对齐聚合距离结构，从而提高对局部几何变化的鲁棒性。此外，研究人员还证明了CDOT散度是一种有效的伪度量，并提出了“色散隙”的概念来阐明CDOT与Gromov-Wasserstein（GW）之间的关系。在有限样本情况下，推导了非渐进风险界限，并通过Frank-Wolfe算法建立了风险一致性。
AI.result: CDOT被证明是一种有效的伪度量，并且相比GW具有更好的凸性。算法在合成点云、大脑连接组和图分类基准测试中取得了优于现有方法的性能，并且在实践中表现稳定可靠。
AI.conclusion: CDOT是一种新颖的凸最优传输框架，能够有效地对齐异构域上的分布，同时保持特征对应和内在几何结构。该方法通过算子正则化提高了鲁棒性，并与GW框架进行了理论上的比较，证明了其优越性。实验结果证实了CDOT的有效性和稳定性。
AI.translation: 我们引入了凸距离算子传输（CDOT），这是第一个凸最优传输框架，通过联合保持特征对应和内在几何结构来对齐异构域上的分布。具体来说，CDOT采用基于算子的正则化方法，通过引入距离和条件期望算子来对齐聚合距离结构。因此，所提出的正则化提高了对局部几何变化的鲁棒性。我们进一步证明了所得的CDOT散度是属性紧致度量测空间上的有效伪度量。此外，我们通过一种新的色散隙概念来表征CDOT与Gromov--Wasserstein（GW）之间的关系，正式阐明了与CDOT的凸性相比，GW的非凸性的几何根源。在有限样本情况下，我们推导了分解为优化和统计误差的非渐进风险界限，并通过全局收敛的Frank--Wolfe算法建立了风险一致性。在合成点云、大脑连接组和图分类基准测试上的实验表明，其性能优于现有方法，并且在实践中表现稳定可靠。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为凸距离算子传输（CDOT）的新型凸最优传输框架，用于在异构域之间对齐分布。CDOT通过引入距离和条件期望算子来实现基于算子的正则化，从而联合保留特征对应和内在几何结构，提高了对局部几何变化的鲁棒性。研究人员证明了CDOT散度是一种有效的伪度量，并提出了“色散隙”的概念来阐明CDOT相对于Gromov-Wasserstein（GW）的凸性优势。在有限样本情况下，通过Frank-Wolfe算法推导了风险界限并建立了风险一致性。实验结果表明，CDOT在点云、大脑连接组和图分类等任务上优于现有方法，且表现稳定。
AI.keywords: 凸距离算子传输, 最优传输, 几何保持, 特征对应, Gromov-Wasserstein
AI.comments: CDOT框架在最优传输领域取得了显著进展，尤其是在处理异构域和保持几何结构方面。其理论上的严谨性和在多个基准测试中的实际表现都令人印象深刻。然而，对于大规模数据集的计算效率和可扩展性仍需进一步研究。

title: 3d Summation-by-Parts scheme for Linear Wave Equations on Hyperboloidal Slices
summary: We derive a fully 3-dimensional Summation-By-Parts scheme for a class of linear wave equations on hyperboloidal slices that meet future null infinity on a Minkowski background. The scheme is derived in spherical polar coordinates, with a major strength being that it is provably stable and allows having grid points at the origin and on the $z$-axis, despite coordinate singularities, and at infinity, by introducing compactification followed by rescaling. Reducing it to the standard Cauchy problem, or on finite spacelike slices with an outer boundary, will follow a similar procedure. Interesting relations are obtained between the rescaling and compactification factors that simplify the equations, and the conditions on constraint addition terms are discovered to maintain symmetric hyperbolicity. Numerical implementation is achieved using finite-difference methods at second-order accuracy, which can be generalized to higher-order or spectral accuracies as well. Dissipation operators are given a more abstract treatment, which makes it possible to define them everywhere in the domain, including at the boundary points, in curvilinear coordinates, such that they satisfy the dissipative property (DP) in our energy norms. These generalizations reduce to the well-known Kreiss-Oliger dissipation operators whenever defined on a Cartesian grid in the bulk and satisfy the DP in the standard $L^2$-norms. We also propose new norm convergence tests that produce more accurate outputs. Promising results are obtained, giving hope for application to fully nonlinear systems, like the Einstein Field Equations, and extracting the resulting gravitational waves free of systematic errors or gauge ambiguities.

AI.title_translation: 线性波动方程在双曲面切片上的三维逐和求积格式
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种用于未来类时无穷远处的线性波动方程的三维逐和求积（SBP）格式，该格式在球坐标系下推导，具有可证明的稳定性，并能处理坐标奇点和无穷远处的网格点。该方法通过有限差分法实现，具有二阶精度，并可推广到更高阶或谱精度。论文还提出了新的范数收敛性测试，并有望应用于爱因斯坦场方程等非线性系统。
AI.motivation: 在双曲面切片上为线性波动方程推导一种完全三维的、可证明稳定的逐和求积（SBP）格式，以处理坐标奇点和无穷远处的网格点，并为解决诸如爱因斯坦场方程等非线性系统提供基础。
AI.method: 在球坐标系下推导三维SBP格式，通过紧化和重缩放处理坐标奇点和无穷远处。使用二阶有限差分法进行数值实现，并提出新的范数收敛性测试。对耗散算子进行了抽象处理，使其在定义域内（包括边界点）都能满足耗散性质。
AI.result: 成功推导出一种在双曲面切片上可证明稳定的三维SBP格式，能够处理坐标奇点和无穷远处的网格点。数值实现达到二阶精度，并提出了新的范数收敛性测试。结果显示出良好的前景，有望应用于非线性系统。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出的三维SBP格式在处理线性波动方程时表现出良好的稳定性和准确性，并为未来应用于非线性系统（如爱因斯坦场方程）奠定了基础，有望提取无系统误差或规范模糊的引力波。
AI.translation: 我们为在米恩可夫斯基背景下的双曲面切片上的一类线性波动方程推导了一种完全三维的逐和求积（SBP）格式。该格式在球极坐标系中推导，其主要优点是可证明稳定，并允许在原点和z轴处存在网格点，尽管存在坐标奇点，并且通过引入紧化和随后的重缩放，允许在无穷远处存在网格点。通过类似的程序可以将其简化为标准的柯西问题，或在具有外边界的有限类时切片上。在重缩放和紧化因子之间获得了有趣的相互关系，简化了方程，并发现了保持对称双曲性所需的约束添加项的条件。使用二阶精度的有限差分法实现了数值实现，该方法也可以推广到更高阶或谱精度。耗散算子得到了更抽象的处理，这使得它们可以在定义域内的任何地方（包括边界点）定义，在曲线坐标系中，使得它们在我们的能量范数中满足耗散性质（DP）。当在本体中的笛卡尔网格上定义并且在标准L2范数中满足DP时，这些推广简化为众所周知的Kreiss-Oliger耗散算子。我们还提出了新的范数收敛性测试，可产生更准确的输出。获得了有希望的结果，预示着其在完全非线性系统（如爱因斯坦场方程）中的应用前景，并提取无系统误差或规范模糊的引力波。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于双曲面切片上线性波动方程的三维逐和求积（SBP）格式。该格式在球坐标系下推导，具有可证明的稳定性，并通过紧化和重缩放克服了坐标奇点和无穷远处网格点的处理难题。使用二阶有限差分法实现，并对耗散算子进行了通用化处理。新的范数收敛性测试被提出，结果显示出作为解决爱因斯坦场方程等非线性系统并提取引力波的潜力。
AI.keywords: 逐和求积格式, 线性波动方程, 双曲面切片, 有限差分法, 耗散算子
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的三维SBP格式，解决了在处理双曲面切片上的线性波动方程时存在的坐标奇点和无穷远处网格点的问题。其可证明的稳定性、对耗散算子的抽象处理以及新的收敛性测试是该方法的亮点。该工作为解决更复杂的非线性系统（如爱因斯坦场方程）提供了有前景的途径，但其在实际应用中的扩展性和效率仍有待进一步验证。

title: On gapped repeats in a cyclic Fibonacci word
summary: In this article, we consider the words with cyclic indices. For given $s$, we consider the pair $(ι,κ)$ of indices such that the word of length $s$ from $ι$ is equal to the word of length $s$ from $κ$. We give a characterization of such pairs for a cyclic Fibonacci word, and give the number of them.

AI.title_translation: 关于循环斐波那契词中的间隙重复
AI.tldr: 该研究对循环索引词进行了研究，特别是循环斐波那契词。研究人员给出了满足特定条件的索引对 (ι, κ) 的特征，其中长度为 s 的从 ι 开始的子词等于长度为 s 的从 κ 开始的子词，并给出了这些对的数量。

AI.method: 通过研究具有循环索引的词，特别是循环斐波那契词，来表征和计算满足特定条件的索引对 (ι, κ)，其中长度为 s 的从 ι 开始的子词等于长度为 s 的从 κ 开始的子词。
AI.result: 给出了循环斐波那契词中满足特定重复条件的索引对 (ι, κ) 的特征，并计算了它们的数量。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为循环斐波那契词中具有相同长度子词的索引对提供了明确的表征，并给出了它们的数量。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们考虑具有循环索引的词。对于给定的 s，我们考虑索引对 (ι, κ)，使得从 ι 开始的长度为 s 的词等于从 κ 开始的长度为 s 的词。我们给出了循环斐波那契词中这类对的特征，并给出了它们的数量。
AI.summary: 本文研究了具有循环索引的词，重点是循环斐波那契词。研究人员表征了满足特定条件的索引对 (ι, κ)，即从索引 ι 和 κ 开始的长度为 s 的子词相等，并计算了满足这些条件的索引对的数量。
AI.keywords: 循环索引, 斐波那契词, 重复, 索引对, 计数
AI.comments: 该研究为理解循环斐波那契词的结构提供了一个有趣的视角，特别是通过分析重复模式。然而，抽象的表述可能需要进一步的阐释才能完全理解其影响和潜在应用。

title: Integrated Sensing and Covert Communication In Low-Altitude Networks: A Smart Radio Environment Perspective
summary: The rise of low-altitude economies and 6G is driving the evolution of low-altitude networks (LANs), making communication security a pressing concern. Unlike traditional security approaches, covert communication offers enhanced protection by hiding the transmission behavior itself. Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC), a key technology of 6G, efficiently supports both sensing and communication tasks through hardware integration, thereby promising significant gains for covert communication. Nevertheless, the complexity and dynamics of urban environments pose critical challenges. Drawing on the latest advances in smart radio environment (SRE) technologies, this paper introduces them into integrated sensing and covert communication (ISACC) to suppress covert channel fading and counteract sensing precision loss in LANs. We first survey the applications and state-of-the-art findings of ISACC in LANs, highlighting key practical challenges. Subsequently, we introduce the core concept of SRE and elaborate on its enabling techniques across four dimensions. To deliver more insights, we explore potential pathways for integrating SRE into ISACC. To maximize covert throughput, a reinforcement learning-based case study is conducted by jointly optimizing flight trajectory, jamming power, movable antenna position, bandwidth allocation, and beamforming vectors. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme achieves superior performance compared to the benchmark. Finally, some open challenges and potential directions are discussed.

AI.title_translation: 低空网络中集成感知与隐蔽通信：智能无线电环境视角
AI.tldr: 本文提出将智能无线电环境（SRE）技术应用于低空网络（LANs）中的集成感知与隐蔽通信（ISACC），以克服城市环境的挑战，并通过强化学习优化系统参数，提升隐蔽吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 低空经济和6G的发展对通信安全提出了更高要求，而隐蔽通信能隐藏传输行为本身，集成感知与通信（ISAC）是6G关键技术，有望提升隐蔽通信性能，但城市环境复杂动态，给ISACC带来挑战。
AI.method: 本文首先调研了ISACC在LANs中的应用和挑战，然后介绍了SRE的核心概念和技术，并探讨了将SRE整合到ISACC的潜在途径。最后，通过一个基于强化学习的案例研究，联合优化了飞行轨迹、干扰功率、可移动天线位置、带宽分配和波束成形向量，以最大化隐蔽吞吐量。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提出的方案相比基准方案取得了更优越的性能。
AI.conclusion: 将SRE技术应用于ISACC是应对低空网络中隐蔽通信挑战的有效途径，通过强化学习优化系统参数可以显著提升隐蔽吞吐量。
AI.translation: 低空经济和6G的兴起正推动低空网络（LANs）的发展，通信安全已成为紧迫问题。与传统安全方法不同，隐蔽通信通过隐藏传输行为本身来提供增强的保护。集成感知与通信（ISAC）是6G的关键技术，通过硬件集成有效地支持感知和通信任务，有望为隐蔽通信带来显著的收益。然而，城市环境的复杂性和动态性带来了严峻的挑战。本文借鉴了智能无线电环境（SRE）技术的最新进展，将其引入集成感知与隐蔽通信（ISACC）中，以抑制隐蔽信道衰落并抵消LANs中感知的精度损失。我们首先调研了ISACC在LANs中的应用和最新研究成果，并强调了关键的实际挑战。随后，我们介绍了SRE的核心概念，并从四个维度阐述了其赋能技术。为了提供更多见解，我们探讨了将SRE整合到ISACC的潜在途径。为了最大化隐蔽吞吐量，我们进行了一项基于强化学习的案例研究，通过联合优化飞行轨迹、干扰功率、可移动天线位置、带宽分配和波束成形向量。仿真结果表明，所提出的方案相比基准方案取得了更优越的性能。最后，讨论了一些开放的挑战和未来可能的研究方向。
AI.summary: 本文将智能无线电环境（SRE）技术应用于低空网络（LANs）中的集成感知与隐蔽通信（ISACC），旨在克服城市环境带来的复杂性和动态性挑战，抑制隐蔽信道衰落并提高感知精度。通过调研ISACC在LANs中的应用和挑战，并介绍SRE技术，文章探讨了SRE与ISACC的融合路径。最后，通过强化学习优化关键系统参数，仿真结果显示所提方案性能优于基准方案。
AI.keywords: 集成感知与通信, 隐蔽通信, 低空网络, 智能无线电环境, 强化学习
AI.comments: 本文将SRE技术引入ISACC领域，为解决低空网络通信安全问题提供了一个新颖的视角。强化学习的应用也为系统优化提供了有效的手段。然而，实际部署中SRE技术的成熟度和成本可能是一个限制因素。

title: LALE: Lightweight-Transformer Architecture for Land-Cover Estimation
summary: Semantic segmentation of remote sensing imagery requires models that capture both global context and local detail under tight computational budgets. Prior work typically optimizes for one of these axes: attention for global context, convolution for local detail, or compactness for efficiency. While hybrid approaches aim to capture both, they require architectural changes and encoder backbones with computational overhead, limiting efficiency and performance. We present LALE (Lightweight-transformer Architecture for Land-cover Estimation), an end-to-end remote sensing image segmentation architecture, that bifurcates its encoder by resolution: lightweight ConvMixer stages handle high-resolution local features, while transformer stages handle low-resolution global context, confining the quadratic cost of self-attention to deep, downsampled feature maps. An all-MLP multi-scale decoder, together with RMSNorm and StarReLU throughout, further reduces compute and parameter count. On the large-scale ARAS400k remote-sensing segmentation benchmark, LALE establishes a strong efficiency-performance trade-off against CNN, transformer, and hybrid baselines. Our smallest variant, (just 1.6M parameters), reaches within 2.6 F1 points of the best baseline (UPerNet) while using 4.5x fewer parameters, 7x less storage, 17x fewer GMACs, and delivering 1.8x higher throughput.

AI.title_translation: LALE：轻量级Transformer架构用于土地覆盖估算
AI.tldr: 提出LALE，一种轻量级Transformer架构，用于遥感影像的语义分割，通过按分辨率分离编码器（ConvMixer处理高分辨率局部特征，Transformer处理低分辨率全局上下文）和使用全MLP多尺度解码器来优化计算效率和性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的遥感影像语义分割模型在计算预算有限的情况下，难以同时捕捉全局上下文和局部细节。现有方法要么侧重于全局上下文（如注意力机制），要么侧重于局部细节（如卷积），要么侧重于效率（如紧凑模型）。混合方法虽然试图兼顾两者，但通常需要复杂的架构和计算开销大的骨干网络。
AI.method: 提出LALE（轻量级Transformer架构用于土地覆盖估算），一种端到端的遥感影像分割架构。其编码器按分辨率进行分支：轻量级ConvMixer阶段处理高分辨率局部特征，Transformer阶段处理低分辨率全局上下文，将自注意力机制的二次成本限制在深层、下采样后的特征图上。此外，采用全MLP多尺度解码器，并全程使用RMSNorm和StarReLU，进一步降低计算量和参数数量。
AI.result: 在ARAS400k遥感影像分割基准测试中，LALE在效率-性能权衡方面优于CNN、Transformer和混合基线。其最小变体（仅160万参数）在参数量、存储空间、GMACs和吞吐量方面表现出色，F1分数仅比最佳基线（UPerNet）低2.6个点，同时参数量减少4.5倍，存储空间减少7倍，GMACs减少17倍，吞吐量提高1.8倍。
AI.conclusion: LALE提供了一种在计算资源受限的情况下实现高效遥感影像语义分割的有效方法，通过新颖的架构设计在效率和性能之间取得了良好的平衡。
AI.translation: 语义分割遥感图像需要能够捕捉全局上下文和局部细节，同时满足严格的计算预算的模型。现有工作通常在这些方面进行优化：使用注意力机制捕捉全局上下文，使用卷积捕捉局部细节，或使用紧凑模型以提高效率。虽然混合方法旨在兼顾两者，但它们需要架构上的改变和具有计算开销的编码器骨干，这限制了效率和性能。我们提出了LALE（轻量级Transformer架构用于土地覆盖估算），一种端到端的遥感图像分割架构，它按分辨率将其编码器进行分支：轻量级的ConvMixer阶段处理高分辨率的局部特征，而Transformer阶段处理低分辨率的全局上下文，将自注意力的二次成本限制在深层、下采样的特征图上。全MLP多尺度解码器，以及贯穿始终的RMSNorm和StarReLU，进一步降低了计算量和参数量。在大型ARAS400k遥感分割基准上，LALE在效率-性能权衡方面优于CNN、Transformer和混合基线。我们最小的变体（仅160万参数）比最佳基线（UPerNet）低2.6个F1点，同时使用的参数量减少了4.5倍，存储空间减少了7倍，GMACs减少了17倍，吞吐量提高了1.8倍。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为LALE（轻量级Transformer架构用于土地覆盖估算）的新型遥感影像语义分割架构。LALE通过将编码器按分辨率进行划分，利用ConvMixer处理高分辨率的局部细节，利用Transformer处理低分辨率的全局上下文，有效解决了计算预算限制下的效率与性能的权衡问题。此外，该架构还采用了全MLP多尺度解码器以及RMSNorm和StarReLU激活函数，进一步降低了计算复杂度和参数量。实验结果表明，LALE在ARAS400k基准测试中取得了优异的效率-性能表现，即使是最小的变体，在显著减少计算资源消耗的同时，也能接近现有最优模型的性能。
AI.keywords: LALE, 遥感影像分割, 轻量级Transformer, 语义分割, 效率-性能权衡
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种在计算效率和性能之间取得良好平衡的遥感影像语义分割新方法。通过将不同分辨率的特征处理任务分配给不同的模块（ConvMixer和Transformer），并采用轻量化的解码器和激活函数，LALE在参数量、存储、计算量和吞吐量方面都取得了显著的改进，这对于资源受限的应用场景具有重要意义。然而，与最优基线在F1分数上仍有2.6个点的差距，未来的工作可以进一步探索如何缩小这一差距，同时保持其轻量化的优势。

title: It does what it says on the tin: safe synthetic data from coarsened margins
summary: This paper proposes a method of creating synthetic data (SD) that will have two important advantages for the user compared to other methods currently available. The first is transparency; unlike other methods, the person in receipt of the SD will know which of the relationships between variables in the original data will be approximately maintained in the SD. The second is a guarantee that the SD is derived from information that has already been judged to be free of disclosure risk. This is achieved by first defining and calculating the margins where relationships between variables will be maintained in the SD. Each margin will then be subject to statistical disclosure control (SDC) to the standards defined by the data custodian, e.g. top-coding and bottom-coding, combination of small categories and/or modifying small counts. Further adjustment of the curated margins is advised by coarsening all counts in the table to multiples of the disclosure limit. These adjusted margins are used to create SD by the Iterative Proportional Fitting (IPF) algorithm. The practical steps involved in creating such SD are illustrated using data from the 1901 Census of Scotland.

AI.title_translation: 它名副其实：来自粗粒化边际的安全合成数据
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种生成合成数据（SD）的新方法，该方法具有透明度和保证数据安全的优点。通过定义和计算边际，对边际进行统计披露控制（SDC），然后对所有计数进行粗粒化处理，最后使用迭代比例拟合（IPF）算法生成SD。
AI.motivation: 现有合成数据（SD）方法缺乏透明度，用户不清楚哪些变量关系会在SD中保持。此外，现有方法不能保证SD来自已评估为无泄露风险的信息。
AI.method: 首先定义和计算边际，然后对边际进行统计披露控制（SDC），包括顶码、底码、合并小类别和修改小计数等。接着，通过将所有计数粗粒化至披露限制的倍数来调整边际。最后，使用迭代比例拟合（IPF）算法，根据调整后的边际生成SD。
AI.result: 该方法能够生成具有以下两个优点的合成数据：1. 透明度：用户可以了解SD中近似保持的原始数据变量关系。2. 安全性：SD源于已经过披露风险评估的信息。
AI.conclusion: 通过对边际进行粗粒化处理和统计披露控制，然后使用IPF算法生成合成数据，可以实现安全且透明的合成数据生成。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种创建合成数据（SD）的方法，与目前可用的其他方法相比，该方法具有两个重要的优点。第一个是透明度；与其它方法不同，接收SD的人将知道原始数据中变量之间的哪些关系将在SD中得到近似保持。第二个是保证SD来源于信息已经被判定为没有泄露风险。这是通过首先定义和计算变量之间关系将在SD中得到保持的边际来实现的。然后，每个边际将根据数据保管者定义的标准进行统计披露控制（SDC），例如顶码和底码、合并小类别和/或修改小计数。建议通过将所有计数粗粒化至披露限制的倍数来进一步调整已处理好的边际。这些调整后的边际用于通过迭代比例拟合（IPF）算法创建SD。使用1901年苏格兰人口普查数据来说明创建此类SD所涉及的实际步骤。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了一种新的合成数据生成方法，该方法通过对边际进行统计披露控制和粗粒化处理，然后利用迭代比例拟合算法生成合成数据。该方法解决了现有技术中存在的透明度和数据安全问题，确保用户了解数据关系的同时，也保证了数据的隐私性。
AI.keywords: 合成数据, 统计披露控制, 边际, 迭代比例拟合, 透明度
AI.comments: 该研究提出的方法在合成数据生成领域具有重要意义，尤其是在解决隐私保护和透明度方面。通过对边际进行精细化处理，并结合成熟的IPF算法，为生成安全可靠的合成数据提供了一种有效的途径。然而，进一步的研究可以探讨该方法在处理更复杂数据结构和大规模数据集时的性能表现，以及不同SDC策略对最终合成数据质量的影响。

title: Switched Event-Triggered Adaptive Control of Reaction-Diffusion PDE-ODE with Neural Operator Implementation
summary: This paper develops a switched event-triggered adaptive boundary control for a class of reaction-diffusion PDE-ODE cascade systems, where the system and input matrices in the ODE as well as the spatially-varying reaction coefficient in the PDE are uncertain. A two-step backstepping transformation is constructed to derive the continuous-time control law. Then a novel dynamic event-triggered control strategy for the PDE-ODE cascade is proposed based on a switched event-triggering mechanism, ensuring global exponential stability of the closed-loop system in place of the exponential convergence commonly achieved with backstepping-based classical dynamic ETC, while inherently excluding Zeno behavior. To address the uncertainties in the PDE-ODE cascade, adaptive update laws are developed, leading to time-varying gain kernels that are adaptively scheduled through the event-triggered control mechanism. Furthermore,to facilitate efficient real-time implementation, deep neural operators (DeepONet) are employed to approximate the backstepping kernels as mappings from the estimated parameters to kernel functions, thereby eliminating the need to repeatedly solve kernel PDEs online. Through a Lyapunov analysis that incorporates the effects of the event-triggering mechanism, parameter adaptation, and kernel approximation errors, we prove the $L^2$ global asymptotic regulation of the resulting closed-loop system. In summary, the key contributions of the paper are threefold: (i) developing an adaptive DeepONet-based framework for reaction-diffusion PDE-ODE cascade systems; (ii) extending the existing adaptive event-triggered control design for reaction-diffusion PDEs to the case with more complex uncertainties; and (iii) generalizing switched dynamic ETC with global exponential stability to PDE-ODE cascades. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is demonstrated through numerical simulations.

AI.title_translation: 带神经算子实现的反应扩散偏微分方程-常微分方程的开关事件触发自适应控制
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种用于反应扩散偏微分方程-常微分方程耦合系统的开关事件触发自适应边界控制方法。该方法通过两步反步法设计了连续时间控制律，并引入了一种新颖的动态事件触发机制，实现了闭环系统的全局指数稳定性并避免了Zeno行为。为了处理系统不确定性，开发了自适应更新律，并通过事件触发机制调度时变增益核。此外，利用深度神经网络算子（DeepONet）来近似反步核，以实现高效的实时实现。通过Lyapunov分析证明了闭环系统的L2全局渐近调节性。主要贡献包括：1. 提出基于DeepONet的自适应框架；2. 将事件触发控制扩展到更复杂的PDE-ODE系统；3. 将开关动态事件触发控制推广到PDE-ODE耦合系统，实现了全局指数稳定性。仿真结果验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 开发一种用于具有不确定性的反应扩散偏微分方程-常微分方程（PDE-ODE）耦合系统的开关事件触发自适应边界控制方法，以实现全局指数稳定性并提高实时实现效率。
AI.method: 1. 构建两步反步变换推导连续时间控制律。 2. 提出一种基于开关事件触发机制的新型动态事件触发控制策略。 3. 开发自适应更新律处理不确定性，并通过事件触发机制调度时变增益核。 4. 利用深度神经网络算子（DeepONet）近似反步核，以实现高效的实时实现。 5. 结合事件触发机制、参数适应和核近似误差进行Lyapunov分析，证明L2全局渐近调节性。
AI.result: 证明了所提出的闭环系统具有L2全局渐近调节性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功开发了一种基于深度神经网络算子实现的开关事件触发自适应边界控制方法，用于解决具有不确定性的反应扩散偏微分方程-常微分方程耦合系统。该方法实现了全局指数稳定性，避免了Zeno行为，并通过近似反步核提高了实时实现效率。研究结果通过数值模拟得到验证。
AI.translation: 本论文开发了一种用于一类反应扩散偏微分方程-常微分方程（PDE-ODE）耦合系统的开关事件触发自适应边界控制方法，其中常微分方程中的系统和输入矩阵以及偏微分方程中的空间变化反应系数是不确定的。构建了一个两步反步变换来推导连续时间控制律。然后，提出了一种基于开关事件触发机制的新型动态事件触发控制策略，用于PDE-ODE耦合系统，确保闭环系统的全局指数稳定性，而不是像基于反步法的经典动态事件触发控制（ETC）那样通常实现的指数收敛，同时固有地排除了Zeno行为。为了处理PDE-ODE耦合系统中的不确定性，开发了自适应更新律，从而产生了通过事件触发控制机制自适应调度的时变增益核。此外，为了便于高效的实时实现，采用了深度神经网络算子（DeepONet）来近似反步核，作为从估计参数到核函数的映射，从而无需在线重复求解核偏微分方程。通过结合事件触发机制、参数适应和核近似误差的Lyapunov分析，我们证明了所得闭环系统的L2全局渐近调节性。总而言之，本文的关键贡献有三方面：（i）为反应扩散PDE-ODE耦合系统开发了基于DeepONet的自适应框架；（ii）将现有的反应扩散PDE自适应事件触发控制设计扩展到具有更复杂不确定性的情况；（iii）将具有全局指数稳定性的开关动态事件触发控制推广到PDE-ODE耦合系统。通过数值模拟证明了所提出方法的有效性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的开关事件触发自适应边界控制方法，用于解决具有不确定性的反应扩散偏微分方程-常微分方程（PDE-ODE）耦合系统。该方法利用两步反步变换推导控制律，并引入了一种动态事件触发机制，实现了全局指数稳定性并避免了Zeno行为。通过开发自适应更新律处理不确定性，并采用深度神经网络算子（DeepONet）近似反步核，提高了实时实现效率。Lyapunov分析证明了闭环系统的L2全局渐近调节性。主要贡献包括基于DeepONet的自适应框架、扩展的事件触发控制设计以及开关动态事件触发控制的推广。数值模拟验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 反应扩散方程, 常微分方程, 事件触发控制, 自适应控制, 深度神经网络算子
AI.comments: 该研究在控制理论领域具有重要意义，特别是在处理复杂耦合系统（如PDE-ODE）的不确定性和实时性方面。DeepONet的应用是该研究的一大亮点，为解决偏微分方程相关的控制问题提供了一种高效的计算方法。然而，对于实际应用中的计算资源需求和DeepONet训练的鲁棒性仍需进一步探讨。

title: Error Bounds for a Diffusion Model-Based Drift Estimator
summary: Parameter estimation in stochastic differential equations is a classical statistical problem of much importance in many scientific fields. Recent work of Tapia Costa et al. (2026) introduced a novel technique for estimating the drift when the diffusion parameter is known, using discrete samples from multiple trajectories. Their method treats drift estimation as a denoising problem, and leverages tools from (conditional) score-matching diffusion models. Although their experiments showed promising results across different drift classes, the question of theoretical guarantees for their estimator was left unanswered. In this note, we address this gap by exploiting techniques from diffusion model theory. More concretely, we derive an explicit risk bound for the time-averaged mean-squared error of said drift estimator. Our bound decomposes the risk into the (i) Euler-Maruyama discretization, (ii) score/denoiser approximation, (iii) noise initialization, and (iv) sampling variance, revealing the trade-offs between the different hyperparameters and sources of error in the estimator.

AI.title_translation: 基于扩散模型的漂移估计器的误差界限
AI.tldr: 该论文为扩散模型驱动的漂移估计器提供了理论保证，推导了风险界限，并分析了误差来源。
AI.motivation: 填补了Tapia Costa等人（2026）提出的扩散模型驱动的漂移估计器在理论保证方面的空白。
AI.method: 利用扩散模型理论的技术，推导出所提出的漂移估计器的时间平均均方误差的显式风险界限。
AI.result: 推导出了风险界限，并将风险分解为欧拉-丸山离散化、分数/去噪器近似、噪声初始化和采样方差四个部分。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了扩散模型驱动的漂移估计器在理论保证方面的空白，并提供了风险分解，以了解不同超参数和误差来源之间的权衡。
AI.translation: 随机微分方程中的参数估计是一个经典的统计问题，在许多科学领域都具有重要意义。Tapia Costa等人（2026）近期的工作引入了一种估计漂移的新技术，当扩散参数已知时，可以使用来自多个轨迹的离散样本。他们的方法将漂移估计视为一个去噪问题，并利用（条件）分数匹配扩散模型的工具。尽管他们的实验在不同的漂移类别中显示出有希望的结果，但他们的估计器的理论保证问题仍未得到解答。在本说明中，我们利用扩散模型理论的技术来解决这一差距。更具体地说，我们推导出了上述漂移估计器的时间平均均方误差的显式风险界限。我们的界限将风险分解为（i）欧拉-丸山离散化、（ii）分数/去噪器近似、（iii）噪声初始化和（iv）采样方差，揭示了估计器中不同超参数和误差来源之间的权衡。
AI.summary: 本研究针对Tapia Costa等人（2026）提出的基于扩散模型的漂移估计器，推导了其时间平均均方误差的显式风险界限。该界限将总风险分解为离散化误差、模型近似误差、噪声初始化误差和采样误差，为理解和优化该估计器的性能提供了理论依据。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 漂移估计, 随机微分方程, 风险界限, 分数匹配
AI.comments: 这项工作为新兴的基于扩散模型的统计估计方法提供了重要的理论基础。风险分解的分析非常有价值，有助于指导未来的研究和实际应用。

title: ProbRes: Volatility Learning for Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Probabilistic time series forecasting has attracted increasing attention in financial applications due to the need to quantify risk and uncertainty in future observations. We propose ProbRes, a post-hoc probabilistic calibration method that explicitly learns and incorporates volatility dynamics into probabilistic forecasting, enabling effective handling of heteroskedastic data. During training, ProbRes employs two architecture-agnostic modules to separately model the conditional mean and conditional volatility. At the inference stage, it generates predictive distributions by resampling normalized residuals. ProbRes is applicable to both univariate and multivariate time series and remains robust under a wide range of error distributions, including non-Gaussian innovations with conditional heteroskedasticity. Theoretical results demonstrate ProbRes's validity and experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets show that ProbRes accurately captures predictive distributions and produces well-calibrated prediction intervals.

AI.title_translation: 概率残差：用于概率时间序列预测的波动率学习
AI.tldr: ProbRes是一种后验概率校准方法，通过学习和整合波动率动态来改进概率时间序列预测，适用于单变量和多变量时间序列，并在合成和真实世界数据上表现良好。
AI.motivation: 金融应用中需要量化未来观测值的风险和不确定性，这促使了概率时间序列预测的关注。由于数据通常具有异方差性，需要一种能有效处理此问题的方法。
AI.method: ProbRes在训练时使用两个独立于架构的模块分别建模条件均值和条件波动率。在推理时，通过重采样归一化残差来生成预测分布。
AI.result: 实验表明，ProbRes能够准确捕捉预测分布并生成校准良好的预测区间。它适用于单变量和多变量时间序列，并且在各种误差分布下都表现稳健。
AI.conclusion: ProbRes通过显式学习和整合波动率动态，成功地改进了概率时间序列预测，能够有效处理异方差数据，并在各种设置下提供准确且校准良好的预测。
AI.translation: 概率时间序列预测因量化未来观测值的风险和不确定性的需求而在金融应用中引起了越来越多的关注。我们提出了ProbRes，一种后验概率校准方法，它显式地学习并将波动率动态融入概率预测中，从而能够有效处理异方差数据。在训练过程中，ProbRes采用两个独立于架构的模块来分别建模条件均值和条件波动率。在推理阶段，它通过重采样归一化残差来生成预测分布。ProbRes适用于单变量和多变量时间序列，并且在包括具有条件异方差的非高斯创新在内的各种误差分布下保持稳健。理论结果证明了ProbRes的有效性，并且在合成和真实世界数据集上的实验表明，ProbRes能够准确捕捉预测分布并生成校准良好的预测区间。
AI.summary: ProbRes是一种新颖的后验概率校准方法，专门用于概率时间序列预测。它通过两个独立的模块显式地学习条件均值和条件波动率，从而有效地处理异方差数据。该方法在推理时通过重采样归一化残差来生成预测分布，并已证明适用于单变量和多变量时间序列，以及多种误差分布。实验结果表明，ProbRes在合成和真实世界数据集上都能准确地捕捉预测分布并生成校准良好的预测区间。
AI.keywords: 概率时间序列预测, 波动率学习, 异方差性, 后验校准, 预测区间
AI.comments: 该方法在处理金融等领域的异方差时间序列数据时具有重要意义，能够提供更可靠的风险量化。其架构无关性和对多种误差分布的稳健性是其主要优势。

title: Localizing broadband noise sources using the Loève spectrum and a 2.5D approach
summary: The localization of moving sound sources using a microphone array is typically based on modifying the signal to compensate for the Doppler effect. In the time domain this compensation is done on a sample-by-sample basis. In the frequency domain short time segments need to be used in which the Doppler effect is assumed to be approximately constant and a discrete Fourier transform is done on each segment. In contrast, the authors developed an inverse 2.5D localization method for uniformly moving single-frequency sources that works in the spectral domain and allows for the use of longer windows. This was achieved by modifying the 2.5D forward model to directly compute the effect of the motion in the static observer position. The method does neither require to modify the measured signal nor does it require quasi-stationary of the measurements within the window used. Unfortunately, this approach is not directly suitable for broad-band stochastic sources, and in the present work we will investigate how the statistical properties of a uniformly moving stochastic source change when observed at a static observer. Using a 2.5D setting, the relation between the power spectral density of the moving source and the Loève spectrum, which is a generalization of the cross-spectral density at the static receivers, was derived. Based on simulated data with speeds up to 100 m\,s$^{-1}$, the work presented here provides a proof of concept for a method based on multi-taper estimates for the Loève spectrum to localize moving broad-band stochastic sources . Currently, the method requires a stationary source signal and that the spectral density is flat within a certain range around the frequency of interest. Also, correlations between sources are currently not considered.

AI.title_translation: 使用Loève谱和2.5D方法对宽带噪声源进行定位
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于Loève谱和2.5D方法的定位移动宽带随机声源的技术，解决了传统方法在处理宽带信号和长观测窗口时的局限性。
AI.motivation: 传统方法在定位移动声源时需要补偿多普勒效应，通常在时域逐样本处理或在频域使用短时窗。作者之前提出的逆2.5D方法适用于单频源，但不能直接用于宽带随机源。本研究旨在将该方法扩展到宽带随机源的定位。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于多锥估计Loève谱的2.5D方法，用于定位移动的宽带随机声源。该方法推导了移动声源功率谱密度与静态接收器处的Loève谱（广义互功率谱密度）之间的关系，并通过模拟数据进行了验证。
AI.result: 通过模拟数据（速度高达100 m/s）验证了所提出方法的概念可行性。该方法能够定位移动的宽带随机声源。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功地提出并验证了一种基于Loève谱和2.5D方法的定位移动宽带随机声源的概念。该方法克服了传统方法的局限性，但仍需满足源信号平稳且在感兴趣频率范围内频谱密度平坦的假设，且未考虑声源间的相关性。
AI.translation: 使用麦克风阵列对移动声源进行定位通常基于修改信号以补偿多普勒效应。在时域中，这种补偿是逐样本进行的。在频域中，需要使用短时段，假设多普勒效应近似恒定，并对每个段进行离散傅里叶变换。相比之下，作者开发了一种用于均匀移动的单频源的逆2.5D定位方法，该方法在频谱域工作，并允许使用更长的窗口。这是通过修改2.5D正向模型来实现的，以直接计算运动对静态观测者位置的影响。该方法既不需要修改测量信号，也不需要测量在所用窗口内的准平稳性。不幸的是，这种方法不直接适用于宽带随机源，在目前的工作中，我们将研究当在静态观测者处观测时，均匀移动的随机源的统计特性如何变化。使用2.5D设置，推导了移动源的功率谱密度与静态接收器处的Loève谱（广义互功率谱密度）之间的关系。基于速度高达100 m/s 的模拟数据，本文提出的工作为一种基于多锥估计 Loève 谱的方法提供了概念验证，用于定位移动的宽带随机声源。目前，该方法要求源信号平稳，并且在感兴趣频率周围的某个范围内频谱密度是平坦的。此外，目前不考虑声源之间的相关性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新的定位移动宽带随机声源的方法，该方法利用Loève谱和2.5D模型。与传统方法需要补偿多普勒效应并使用短时窗不同，该方法在频谱域工作，允许使用更长的观测窗口，并且无需修改测量信号或假设测量信号的准平稳性。通过推导移动声源功率谱密度与Loève谱之间的关系，并利用多锥估计，该方法在模拟数据上得到了验证，证明了其定位宽带移动声源的可行性。
AI.keywords: Loève谱, 2.5D方法, 宽带噪声源定位, 移动声源, 频谱分析
AI.comments: 该研究在定位移动宽带随机声源方面取得了重要进展，克服了传统方法的局限性。然而，该方法仍存在一些假设条件，如信号平稳性和频谱平坦性，以及未考虑声源间的相关性，这些限制了其在复杂实际场景中的应用。未来的研究可以关注如何放松这些假设，以提高方法的鲁棒性和普适性。

title: Predicting the risk of colorectal anastomotic leak based on preoperative mapping of the blood supply of the bowel
summary: Anastomotic leak remains one of the most serious complications following colorectal cancer surgery, substantially affecting patient outcomes, recovery trajectories, and healthcare costs. Despite advances in imaging technology, current preoperative assessment relies only on clinical assessment, a process that is subjective, error-prone, and highly dependent on individual expertise. To date, no validated CT-based method exists to predict anastomotic leak risk prior to surgery. This protocol paper outlines a comprehensive framework for developing and validating an AI-driven system for preoperative risk assessment using pre- and post-contrast CT imaging. The study describes the stages of data collection, ethical handling, and preprocessing of patient data in accordance with GDPR, image preprocessing, and the exploration of deep learning architectures designed to generate clinically interpretable outputs. Two integrated tools constitute the main deliverables of this workflow: 1) a risk assessment module, which quantifies the likelihood of leakage by analyzing vascular and tissue features in CT scans, and 2) a Content-Based Medical Image Retrieval (CBMIR) module, which identifies and displays similar historical cases to support evidence-based surgical decision making. The protocol paper requires close collaboration between hospitals and universities; this protocol demonstrates that such a system is technically feasible and clinically implementable within existing healthcare infrastructures. By following the proposed methodological stages and regulatory principles, other institutions can reproduce this workflow to develop analogous decision-support tools. Ultimately, this interdisciplinary framework aims to enhance surgical planning, reduce leak incidence, and contribute to a broader paradigm shift toward explainable, data-driven precision surgery.

AI.title_translation: 基于肠道血供术前评估预测结直肠吻合口漏风险
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个基于人工智能的框架，利用术前CT影像分析肠道血供，以预测结直肠手术吻合口漏的风险，并提供相似病例检索功能，旨在提高手术规划和减少并发症。
AI.motivation: 目前结直肠手术吻合口漏的风险评估主要依赖主观的临床评估，缺乏客观、可验证的术前预测方法。
AI.method: 开发并验证一个人工智能驱动的系统，利用术前和术后增强CT影像，分析血管和组织特征来量化漏风险，并结合内容检索模块提供相似病例参考。
AI.result: 该协议论文展示了一个技术上可行且临床上可实施的框架，能够开发出用于预测结直肠吻合口漏风险的决策支持工具。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的多学科框架在技术上是可行的，并且可以在现有的医疗基础设施中实施，有望通过提高手术规划和减少漏发生率，推动精准外科向可解释、数据驱动的范式转变。
AI.translation: 吻合口漏仍然是结直肠癌手术后最严重的并发症之一，严重影响患者的预后、恢复轨迹和医疗成本。尽管影像技术取得了进展，但目前的术前评估仅依赖临床评估，这是一个主观、易出错且高度依赖个体专业知识的过程。迄今为止，尚无经验证的基于CT的方法可以在术前预测吻合口漏的风险。本方案论文概述了一个全面的框架，用于开发和验证一个人工智能驱动的系统，该系统使用术前和术后增强CT影像进行术前风险评估。该研究描述了数据收集、伦理处理和患者数据预处理的阶段，符合GDPR要求，以及图像预处理，并探索了旨在生成临床可解释输出的深度学习架构。该工作流程的主要可交付成果包括两个集成工具：1）一个风险评估模块，通过分析CT扫描中的血管和组织特征来量化泄漏的可能性；2）一个内容检索模块（CBMIR），用于识别和显示相似的既往病例，以支持循证手术决策。本方案论文需要医院和大学之间的密切合作；本方案表明，此类系统在技术上是可行的，并且可以在现有的医疗保健基础设施中进行临床实施。通过遵循所提出的方法阶段和监管原则，其他机构可以复制此工作流程来开发类似的决策支持工具。最终，这个跨学科框架旨在加强手术规划，减少漏的发生率，并为可解释的、数据驱动的精准外科做出更广泛的范式转变。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种基于人工智能的框架，用于术前预测结直肠手术吻合口漏的风险。该框架利用术前和术后增强CT影像，分析肠道的血管和组织特征，量化漏的风险。此外，该系统还包括一个内容检索模块，用于查找相似的既往病例，以辅助临床决策。研究表明，该框架在技术上可行，并可在现有医疗体系中实施，旨在提高手术规划的准确性，减少吻合口漏的发生率，并推动精准外科的发展。
AI.keywords: 结直肠吻合口漏, 术前风险评估, 人工智能, CT影像分析, 精准外科
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一个创新的人工智能框架，用于解决结直肠手术中一个重要的临床挑战——吻合口漏的预测。利用CT影像和深度学习技术，该方法有望提供比传统临床评估更客观、更准确的风险评估。特别是，内容检索模块的加入，能够为外科医生提供相似病例的参考，进一步支持循证决策。该研究的优势在于其全面性，涵盖了从数据收集到模型验证的完整流程，并强调了多学科合作和临床可实施性。然而，文章也提到需要进一步的验证和临床实践来评估其长期影响和推广价值。

title: A New Method for Finding the Schulze Winner Set
summary: We propose a new voting algorithm based on the pairwise majority-comparison matrix derived from voters' preference profiles. We show that this algorithm induces exactly the winner set of the Schulze rule (Schulze, 1997). Our algorithm successively eliminates weaker candidates in terms of all-pairs comparisons, thereby reflecting a dual spirit to Condorcet's original idea of splitting preference cycles (de Condorcet, 1785). We further show that the direct sum of the survival sets obtained at each elimination round coincides with the Schwartz set (Schwartz, 1972). These two equivalence results provide a formal mathematical foundation for the ``folklore'' relationship between the Schulze winner set and the Schwartz set, as well as a new Condorcetian interpretation of the Schulze winner set.

title: Bayesian meta-learning for modeling Alzheimer's disease progression
summary: Predicting whether an individual with Alzheimer's disease will experience mild or severe disease progression is essential for personalized treatment. Typically, practitioners seek to predict the distribution of a discrete disease score, conditional on an individual's current MRI volume and their historical disease trajectory. Classical statistical regression models and single-task neural networks are not well-suited for this purpose because fitting separate models is infeasible (since each individual typically has few observations), while ignoring individual-level correlation leads to poor generalization. Meta-learning, in contrast, provides a natural avenue to dynamically predict distributions without retraining and model nonlinear relationships between the outcome and covariates. Motivated by this, we propose a Bayesian meta-learner that is trained on multiple individuals but tailors the predictive disease score distribution to each individual's historical data. Our model predicts on unseen individuals without retraining, scales linearly with the number of historical observations, and is guaranteed to be less overconfident when predicting long-term disease scores compared to its deterministic counterpart. On real-world data from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) database, our model achieves performance competitive with both single-task models and deterministic meta-learners, while substantially improving performance when predicting long-term disease progression.

title: Identifiable Markov Switching Models with Instantaneous Effects and Exponential Families
summary: Temporal systems often exhibit non-stationary behaviour, such as seasonal climate variation or glucose fluctuations in patients with type-1 diabetes. One way to model non-stationarity is through discrete latent regimes, i.e., stationary segments of time. Such systems induce a Markov Switching Model (MSM), a class of Hidden Markov Models with autoregressive dependencies among latent regimes and observed variables. Identifying latent regimes is challenging in the presence of frequent regime switches and nonlinear and non-Gaussian dynamics, particularly when there are instantaneous effects between the variables, e.g., due to slow rates of measurements. In this work, we establish the identifiability of both latent regimes and regime-dependent causal structures under temporal regime dependencies, nonlinear lagged and instantaneous effects, and independent noise from the exponential family. Our identifiability theory subsumes non-temporal mixtures of causal models. Furthermore, we introduce FlowMSM, a regime detection framework that can be paired with any stationary causal discovery method to recover regime-dependent causal structures. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks and a financial economics dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach to detect latent regimes and discover causal structures from non-stationary time series.

title: ShaplEIG: Bayesian Experimental Design for Shapley Value Estimation
comments: Accepted at the Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Shapley values are a principled attribution measure widely used in interpretable machine learning, but their exact computation scales exponentially with the number of players, motivating a wide range of approximation methods based on value function evaluations of sampled coalitions. This raises the question of whether approximation accuracy can be improved by adaptively selecting coalitions for evaluation based on previous evaluations. This is particularly relevant in settings where the value function is costly and the number of evaluations is severely limited, such as retraining-based feature importance, data valuation, and hyperparameter importance. For this purpose, we propose ShaplEIG, a Bayesian experimental design approach that approximates the expensive value function using a Gaussian process surrogate and adaptively selects coalitions based on their expected information gain about the Shapley values. By the linearity of the Shapley values in the value function, we show that the expected information gain is available in closed form. Furthermore, we propose an efficient computation scheme that reduces the complexity from exponential to polynomial in the number of players via elementary symmetric polynomials. In extensive experiments across diverse costly applications, our method consistently improves sample efficiency in the low-budget regime over state-of-the-art baselines.
comment: Accepted at the Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)

title: Mapping Whisper Representations to Human ECoG Responses with Interpretable Time-Resolved Neural Encoding
comments: Presented at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Representational Alignment (Re-Align)
summary: Understanding how speech foundation models relate to human cortical activity is a key challenge for computational neuroscience. Here, we investigate how internal representations from Whisper predict intracranial ECoG responses during naturalistic speech perception. We introduce a time-resolved neural encoder that combines speech embeddings with a recurrent temporal model and soft attention, allowing us to examine layer-wise brain alignment. Intermediate Whisper layers provide the strongest correspondence with neural activity, supporting a hierarchical match between model representations and cortical speech processing. Comparisons with baselines show that high-resolution ECoG responses benefit from temporally structured modelling beyond linear mappings from the same speech representations. In addition, attention maps reveal temporally local alignment between speech embeddings and neural responses, while a phonemic interpretability analysis identifies anatomically coherent phoneme-category organization among encoding-informative electrodes. Together, these results suggest that speech foundation models offer a useful framework for studying time-resolved cortical speech representations.

title: Doing well with less! On Sampling Techniques for Empirical Pairwise Loss Estimation/Minimization
summary: Many machine learning problems, including similarity learning, ranking, and clustering, rely on empirical pairwise loss functions whose quadratic computational cost quickly becomes prohibitive at scale. We demonstrate how a frugal approach that retains only a fraction of the available information on pairs can achieve estimation or optimization performance comparable to that obtained by using all pairs, by leveraging survey sampling techniques. A central finding, supported by both theory and experiments, is that such sampling plans must target pairs directly rather than individual observations. In particular, for pairwise losses between high-dimensional vectors such as embeddings in vision or graph learning, assigning higher inclusion probabilities to informative pairs using suitable auxiliary information yields performance close to full pairwise evaluation, providing a principled and theoretically grounded trade-off between accuracy and computational cost.

title: Privacy-preserving Information Sharing in Oligopoly Competitions
summary: Information sharing among competing suppliers can improve decision-making under uncertainty, yet strategic concerns regarding rival exploitation often deter voluntary disclosure. We study information-sharing mechanisms in a Cournot oligopoly with uncertain demand, where a platform aggregates suppliers' signals through privacy-preserving channels and may also possess an exogenous external signal. The central challenge is to balance strategic safety with informational utility: privacy noise reduces the exposure of individual signals, but also lowers the value of the shared information pool. We first characterize a baseline setting in which access to aggregated information is contingent on participation. In a two-firm market without an external signal, firms refuse to share regardless of the privacy level. In an \(n\)-firm market, sharing may arise even without privacy safeguards because non-participating firms lose access to the aggregated signal. Building on this baseline, we show that privacy protection alone is insufficient to incentivize disclosure; it must be combined with a sufficiently informative external signal. We further show that firms with more accurate private signals require stronger privacy protection. Overall, our results characterize the sharing-feasible region and highlight the complementarity between privacy design and the external information environment.

title: Lossy Microwave Linear Analog Computer (MiLAC) for Future MIMO: Learning-based Architecture Designs for Spectral and Energy Efficiency Maximization
comments: 15 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. This paper has been submitted to IEEE journal for possible publication
summary: Microwave linear analog computers (MiLACs) offer a transformative paradigm for future multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems by shifting complex signal processing into the analog domain, thereby significantly reducing computational complexity, radio-frequency chains, and analog-digital converters, while speeding up computation. However, the practical deployment of MiLACs is severely constrained by the inherent hardware losses of the tunable admittance components (TACs) interconnecting MiLAC ports, which introduce severe inter-stream interference and fundamentally limit the spectral efficiency (SE) of the system. In addition, while denser architectures offer greater spatial degrees of freedom to mitigate inter-stream interference, the cumulative hardware losses and power consumption of massive TACs severely degrade the system's energy efficiency (EE). Consequently, designing architectures for lossy MiLACs emerges as a critical yet unresolved challenge, as it necessitates striking a delicate tradeoff between interference suppression and cumulative hardware losses/power consumption. To address this challenge, this paper investigates the joint MiLAC architecture design and performance (SE/EE) maximization in lossy MiLAC-aided MIMO systems. We propose a novel learning-based joint architecture and performance optimization framework (LJAPOF) that unifies the design of MiLAC architectures and analog beamforming configurations for lossy MiLACs under both SE- and EE-oriented objectives. Numerical results demonstrate that by intelligently navigating the fundamental tradeoff between interference suppression and hardware/power consumption, the proposed LJAPOF can design optimal MiLAC architectures that consistently outperform stem-connected and fully-connected MiLACs in maximizing the system's SE and EE.

title: How Optimality Structures Sparse Dictionaries: A Theory for Understanding SAE Representations
summary: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have found success parsing neural representations into interpretable concepts, providing a basis for understanding and control. However, what exactly SAEs extract, and, correspondingly, the scientific conclusions we can draw from them, are not obvious. Empirically, the proof is in the pudding: SAEs learn interpretable features. Theoretically, we lack a clear account of what properties a 'concept' must satisfy for an SAE to extract it. There has been extensive identifiability work studying the conditions under which sparse coding recovers ground-truth features; however, these approaches tends to focus on simple data-generating models (e.g. sparse independent features) which poorly approximate the internet-swallowing language-model representations on which SAEs are trained. Here, avoiding data-generating models, we ask simply what properties any dictionary learning optimum must satisfy. Concretely, we extend local optimality analyses (Gribonval & Schnass, 2010) to the nonnegative joint-optimisation problem that vanilla SAEs approximate, and derive constraints relating optimal SAE features to their distributions. We use these constraints to explain a range of observed SAE behaviours - hierarchical splitting & absorption, the structure of residuals, and dense antipodal features - each reflecting how L1+nonnegativity interact with data to structure optimal dictionaries. Finally, we construct a novel large-dictionary convex problem and explore the wide atom-per-datapoint limit. In sum, we hope to tease model assumptions from unexpected observations, letting us learn more from SAEs' successes and provide principles for designing their successors.

title: Evolutionary Discovery of Bivariate Bicycle Codes with LLM-Guided Search
summary: Quantum LDPC code discovery requires searching large algebraic design spaces while reliably certifying the parameters and equivalence classes of any candidates found. We introduce an LLM-guided evolutionary workflow in which language models mutate Python programs that generate bivariate-bicycle and perturbed bivariate-bicycle code ansätze. Across five campaigns, the system performed approximately 1{,}650 evolutionary iterations, screened about $2 \times 10^5$ candidate codes, and required ${\sim}140$ hours of computation and ${\sim}$US\$400 in LLM inference cost. Candidate codes are evaluated through a staged validation pipeline combining $\mathrm{GF}(2)$ rank computation, distance estimation and certification, mixed-integer linear programming, BLISS Tanner-graph deduplication, decomposability analysis, and local-Clifford equivalence checks. At block length $n \leq 360$, the workflow identifies 465 distinct candidate codes: 97 CSS bivariate-bicycle codes and 368 non-CSS perturbed variants. The CSS search recovers known high-performing codes and finds new finite-length representatives, including an indecomposable [[288,16,12]] code and higher-weight codes with up to $k = 50$ at distance $d = 8$. The non-CSS search produces perturbed codes matching the gross-code figure of merit at [[144,12,12]], along with additional high-distance candidates reported as certified values or upper bounds according to MILP status. Overall, these results show that LLM-guided program evolution can serve as a practical tool for structured quantum-code discovery when paired with independent evaluation.

title: Diffusion-Based Heart Sound Generation: Evaluation with Physiological Signal Metrics, Classifiers, and Expert Listening
summary: Publicly available phonocardiogram (PCG) datasets remain limited in size and pathological diversity, constraining both auscultation training and the generalisation of automated heart-sound classifiers. A class-conditional diffusion model for PCG generation is developed in the log-mel domain and synthetic fidelity is assessed using complementary (i) physiology-inspired plausibility metrics, (ii) downstream label-consistency evaluation, and (iii) expert listening. Experiments use the Phy-sioNet/Computing in Cardiology Challenge 2016 dataset (3240 recordings) with recording-level splits. After preprocessing and quality control, 16,749 non-overlapping 4 s clips are mapped to a normalised 1 x 128 x 128 log-mel representation to train a conditional 2D U-Net denoiser with classifier-free guidance. Signal-level plausibility is quantified on reconstructed waveforms using three lightweight metrics: an envelope-autocorrelation rhythm score, an amplitude-based explosion score, and the dominant cycle lag. Synthetic clips preserve similar dominant cycle durations but exhibit reduced envelope periodicity and increased transient burstiness relative to real clips. For downstream evaluation, a ResNet-50 classifier achieves 92.24% accuracy on the held-out real test set and 82.8% accuracy on class-balanced synthetic batches, indicating that generated signals retain discriminative structure relevant to normal/abnormal classification. In a pilot expert listening study (60 clips, two clinicians), most synthetic clips are judged as heart-sound-like, while abnormality sensitivity is low for both real and synthetic 4 s excerpts. Overall, the results provide a practical baseline for diffusion-based PCG generation while highlighting remaining challenges in retaining abnormal acoustic cues and reducing reconstruction-induced artefacts.

title: Correlated uniform attachment trees
summary:
We introduce and study a new model of correlated uniform attachment (UA) trees, where correlation is sprinkled throughout the time evolution of the process. In this model, two UA trees are grown in parallel, and at each time step a new node is added to each tree, with an edge between it and a uniformly chosen existing vertex in the respective tree. The two choices of attachment are correlated: with probability $α$, the edges attach to nodes with the same time label in both trees, and with probability $1-α$, the choices are made independently. We study fundamental detection and estimation questions for this model, given two \emph{unlabeled} trees. In our main result, we construct a consistent estimator of the correlation parameter $α$, as the size of the trees goes to infinity.
  The construction of our statistic relies on two key ideas. First, we use Jordan centrality to identify subsets of vertices of each tree whose intersection has a sufficient number of common early vertices. The second idea is that, across multiple time scales, it is possible to approximately determine the labels of vertices that have attached to these early vertices, using the sizes of fringe subtrees. Our analysis includes novel quantitative bounds on the fraction of early vertices that remain central, which are of independent interest in the network archaeology literature.

title: Towards Automated Discovery: A Review of Generative Models, Multimodal Learning and Closed-Loop Workflows in Inverse Materials Design
summary: Inverse materials design is shifting materials discovery from forward prediction to targeted proposal of candidates that satisfy objectives under physical constraints. Here, we review recent advances in generative crystal structure modeling, multimodal learning, and closed-loop design pipelines for crystalline solids. We survey how modern generators learn chemical-structural priors from large databases to enable controllable sampling of periodic structures, and compare leading model classes including variational autoencoders, normalizing flows, autoregressive formulations, and diffusion models. Particular attention is given to how feasibility constraints and physical priors are enforced across the workflow, through representation choices, training objectives, sampling-time guidance, and post-generation screening and relaxation. We also discuss how multimodal learning fuses diverse materials modalities, including crystal structures, thermodynamic, electronic information, microscopy, spectroscopy, processing context, and scientific text, to construct a more universal, transferable representation of chemical space. In addition, diverse inverse-design strategies are examined, particularly those that integrate conditional generation with latent optimization, Bayesian optimization, reinforcement learning, and active learning. Finally, we highlight recurring failure modes, such as surrogate exploitation, diversity collapse, distribution shift, and the stability-synthesizability gap, and outline discovery-grade evaluation practices based on staged reporting of validity, novelty, uniqueness, stability, and cost.

title: Auditing Asset-Specific Preferences in Financial Large Language Models: Evidence from Bitcoin Representations and Portfolio Allocation
summary:
Large language models now power robo-advisors and trading agents, yet whether they carry built-in biases toward specific assets is largely untested. We ask three questions: do LLMs systematically prefer certain financial instruments; can an internal representation with causal leverage over those preferences be identified; and does that representation affect downstream financial decisions?
  We develop a three-level audit protocol and apply it to Bitcoin. First, a behavioral audit of eight frontier LLMs shows that Bitcoin's ranking among money-like instruments is frame-dependent: models place it around rank 5 of 8 as "reliable money" but near the top under crisis and autonomous-agent frames, and an attribute-swap experiment confirms rankings track functional properties, not names. Second, we open a model's internals: a search across thousands of sparse-autoencoder features in Gemma 3 identifies a dominant Bitcoin-selective feature. Amplifying it shifts the model toward the asset and suppressing it shifts the model away, even when "Bitcoin" never appears in the prompt. Third, we test financial consequences: amplification raises Bitcoin's portfolio share by 5.2 percentage points while suppression lowers it by 4.6 pp, with amplification reallocating within crypto and suppression cutting total crypto exposure.
  We characterize this as bounded behavioral leverage (leverage meaning causal influence over outputs, not financial leverage): an identifiable internal feature can be perturbed to move financial choices, but only within measurable limits. The framework links internal representations to external recommendations, validated with random controls and mechanism boundaries. As LLMs become autonomous financial agents, this is a first step toward a behavioral layer for emerging know-your-agent (KYA) standards: knowing what an agent prefers, and how far that preference can be moved.

title: A No-Regret Framework for Adaptive Incentive Design
summary: Incentive design studies how a central authority can influence strategic agents through payments, subsidies, or taxes, so that individual objectives align with collective welfare. This paper introduces a No-Regret Adaptive Incentive Design (RAID) framework for nonlinear games with continuous action spaces and private agent costs. In this framework, the authority (planner) designs incentives that regulate the Nash equilibrium toward a socially optimal action profile, while simultaneously learning agents' unknown preferences from repeated strategic responses. We formulate the RAID problem and construct a least-squares estimator whose strong consistency requires only diminishing excitation. Leveraging this weak excitation requirement, we propose a switching incentive policy that alternates between probing (exploration) and estimate-based (exploitation) incentives. The resulting policy achieves an $O(t^{-0.5})$ parameter estimation rate and accumulates $O(t^{0.5}\log t)$ squared social-cost regret, almost surely. We further extend the framework to an endogenous-noise response model, where standard least-squares estimation is biased due to an error-in-variables correlation between the noise and agent responses. We utilize a repeated-sampling estimator and corresponding switching policy that retain the same almost-sure convergence and regret rates. Numerical experiments validate the effectiveness and predicted convergence rates of the method.

title: A Guide to Higher-Order Homophily
summary: Homophily, the overrepresentation of interactions among similar individuals, and heterophily, the elevated prevalence of interactions among dissimilar ones, are frequently observed mixing patterns in social networks. As hypergraphs are increasingly used to represent social systems, a higher-order perspective on homophily and heterophily becomes ever more relevant. Here, we provide two complementary perspectives on this problem: First, we survey measures that can be used to quantify homophily (or heterophily) in hypergraphs -- emphasizing conceptual differences to existing pairwise measures -- and explain each measure through in-depth examples. Second, we provide an overview of hypergraph models for higher-order mixing patterns, distinguishing several model families with distinct use cases. By providing a guide to existing methods and synthesizing the current body of knowledge on higher-order homophily and heterophily, we lay the basis for informed methodological choices and future developments.

title: Strong Polarization and Entropy
summary:
We show that for any set of $n$ unit vectors $v_1,\ldots,v_n$ in a real Hilbert space and positive numbers $p_1,\ldots,p_n$ satisfying $\sum_j p_j = 1$, there exists a unit vector $u$ such that
  \[
  \sum_{j=1}^n \frac{p_j^2}{\langle v_j, u\rangle^2}\leq 1.
  \]
  This inequality is a weighted version of the strong polarization inequality. As immediate corollaries, it yields a polarization inequality for products of powers of linear functionals and a strengthening of Bang's classical plank theorem for Hilbert spaces. The proof follows the approach introduced by Martínez and Ortega-Moreno in their recent solution to the strong polarization conjecture posed by Ball and Frenkel. We further note that our weighted inequality admits a Shannon-entropy interpretation: in a random sensing model, the entropy of the weights controls the minimum expected logarithmic loss.

title: Handbook of Network Analysis [KONECT -- the Koblenz Network Collection]
summary: This is the handbook for the KONECT project, the \emph{Koblenz Network Collection}, a scientific project to collect, analyse, and provide network datasets for researchers in all related fields of research, by the Namur Center for Complex Systems (naXys) at the University of Namur, Belgium, with web hosting provided by the Institute for Web Science and Technologies (WeST) at the University of Koblenz--Landau, Germany.

title: Beyond Outerplanarity
comments: Has appeared in the Proceedings of the 25th International Symposium on Graph Drawing and Network Visualization (GD 2017)
summary:
We study straight-line drawings of graphs where the vertices are placed in convex position in the plane, i.e., \emph{convex drawings}. We consider two families of graph classes with convex drawings: \emph{outer $k$-planar} graphs, where each edge is crossed by at most $k$ other edges; and \emph{outer $k$-quasi-planar} graphs, where no $k$ edges can mutually cross.
  We show that the outer $k$-planar graphs are $\lfloor3.5\sqrt{k}\rfloor$-degenerate, and consequently that every outer $k$-planar graph can be colored with $\lfloor3.5\sqrt{k}\rfloor + 1$ colors. We further show that every outer $k$-planar graph has a balanced vertex separator of size at most $2k+3$. For each fixed $k$, these small balanced separators allow us to test outer $k$-planarity in quasi-polynomial time, e.g., this implies that none of these recognition problems is NP-hard unless the Exponential Time Hypothesis fails. We also show that the class of outer 3-quasi-planar graphs and the class of planar graphs are incomparable.
  Finally, we restrict outer $k$-planar and outer $k$-quasi-planar drawings to \emph{full} drawings (where no crossing appears on the boundary of the outer face) and to \emph{closed} drawings (where the vertex sequence on the boundary of the outer face is a Hamiltonian cycle in the graph). For each $k$, we express \emph{closed outer $k$-planarity} and \emph{closed outer $k$-quasi-planarity} in extended monadic second-order logic. Since every outer $k$-planar graph has treewidth $O(k)$, Courcelle's theorem implies that closed outer $k$-planarity is linear-time testable. We leverage this result to further show that full outer $k$-planarity can also be tested in linear time.
